name: Barbell Flat Bench Press
how_to_1: Lie on a flat bench, eyes under the bar, feet planted, grip slightly wider than shoulders.
how_to_2: Unrack, lower the bar under control to mid-chest with elbows about 45° from your body.
how_to_3: Press back up to straight arms over your shoulders.
watch_for: Flaring elbows to 90°. Bouncing the bar off the chest. Hips lifting off the bench.

name: Barbell Incline Bench Press
tags: Upper chest · Front delts · Triceps · Barbell
how_to_1: Set the bench to 30–45°, grip slightly wider than shoulders, shoulder blades pinched.
how_to_2: Lower the bar to the upper chest just below the collarbone.
how_to_3: Press up and slightly back until arms are straight.
watch_for: Bench set too steep. Bar touching the neck. Lower back arching off the pad.

name: Barbell Decline Bench Press
how_to_1: Hook your legs on a decline bench and grip slightly wider than shoulders.
how_to_2: Lower the bar to the lower chest with control.
how_to_3: Press back up to lockout over the chest.
watch_for: Bar drifting towards the neck. Unracking without a spotter. Bouncing off the chest.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench and grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
how_to_2: Lower to the lower chest, keeping elbows tucked close to the body.
how_to_3: Press up by straightening the elbows.
watch_for: Grip so narrow the wrists bend. Elbows flaring. Bar landing too high.

name: Wide-Grip Bench Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench and take a grip clearly wider than a normal bench grip.
how_to_2: Lower the bar to mid-chest with a short range of motion.
watch_for: Shoulder pain from going too wide. Elbows flaring to 90°. Losing upper-back tightness.

name: Reverse-Grip Bench Press
tags: Upper chest · Triceps · Front delts · Bench
how_to_1: Grip the bar underhand, shoulder-width apart, ideally with a spotter.
how_to_2: Unrack and lower the bar to the lower chest.
how_to_3: Press up, keeping wrists stacked over elbows.
watch_for: Wrists bending back. Unracking without a spotter. Bar sliding out of the hands.

name: Paused Bench Press
how_to_1: Set up as for a normal bench press.
how_to_2: Lower the bar to the chest and hold it still for 1–3 seconds while staying tight.
how_to_3: Press up explosively from the pause.
watch_for: Letting the bar sink into the chest. Relaxing during the pause. Hips lifting off.

name: Spoto Press
how_to_1: Set up as for a normal bench press.
how_to_2: Lower the bar and stop it 2–3 cm above the chest, holding for 1–2 seconds.
how_to_3: Press back up from the hover position.
watch_for: Touching the chest. Losing tightness in the hover. Bar path drifting.

name: Board Press
how_to_1: Place a board (or stacked boards) on your chest, held by a partner or strapped on.
how_to_2: Lower the bar until it touches the board.
how_to_3: Pause briefly and press to lockout.
watch_for: Bouncing off the board. Elbows flaring. Using too much weight too soon.

name: Pin Press (Bench)
how_to_1: Set safety pins in a rack at the height you want to press from and lie under the bar.
how_to_2: Start with the bar resting on the pins, upper back tight.
how_to_3: Press the bar up from a dead stop, then lower back to the pins.
watch_for: Bouncing off the pins. Losing setup between reps. Pins set unevenly.

name: Floor Press
how_to_1: Lie on the floor under a racked bar (or have it handed to you), knees bent or legs straight.
how_to_2: Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor.
how_to_3: Pause briefly, then press back up.
watch_for: Slamming the elbows into the floor. Flaring elbows. Wrists bending back.

name: Larsen Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench with legs straight out and feet off the floor.
how_to_2: Lower the bar to the chest without leg drive.
how_to_3: Press back up while keeping the torso stable.
watch_for: Wobbling side to side. Arching the back. Going too heavy without leg support.

name: Feet-Up Bench Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench with knees bent and feet resting on the bench end or in the air.
how_to_2: Lower the bar to mid-chest.
how_to_3: Press up without any leg drive.
watch_for: Lower back arching. Rocking on the bench. Losing shoulder-blade position.

name: Guillotine Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench with a wide grip, elbows flared, using light weight and a spotter.
how_to_2: Lower the bar slowly towards the neck/upper chest.
watch_for: Using heavy weight. Training without a spotter. Shoulder pain — stop if felt.

name: Tempo Bench Press
how_to_1: Set up as for a normal bench press.
how_to_2: Lower the bar slowly over a set count (e.g. 3–5 seconds).
how_to_3: Pause briefly on the chest, then press up.
watch_for: Rushing the lowering phase. Losing tightness. Holding the breath too long.

name: Dead Bench Press
how_to_1: Set safety pins just above chest height with the bar resting on them.
how_to_2: Get tight under the bar on the pins.
how_to_3: Press from a dead stop to lockout, then lower back to the pins.
watch_for: Bouncing off the pins. Setting pins too low. Loose upper back.

name: Barbell Pullover
how_to_1: Lie across or along a bench holding a barbell over your chest with a narrow grip and slightly bent elbows.
how_to_2: Lower the bar back behind your head in an arc until you feel a stretch.
how_to_3: Pull it back over your chest in the same arc.
watch_for: Bending the elbows too much. Overstretching the shoulders. Arching the lower back.

name: Bench Press with Chains
how_to_1: Hang chains on each sleeve so they rest partly on the floor at the bottom.
how_to_2: Lower the bar to the chest as the chains pile up and lighten the load.
how_to_3: Press up through the increasing resistance to lockout.
watch_for: Chains swinging. Uneven chain setup. Losing bar path.

name: Bench Press with Bands
tags: Chest · Triceps · Front delts · Resistance band
how_to_1: Attach bands from the bar sleeves to the rack base or bench.
how_to_2: Lower the bar to the chest under control.
how_to_3: Press explosively against the increasing band tension.
watch_for: Band pulling the bar forward. Uneven bands. Losing control at the top.

name: Slingshot Bench Press
how_to_1: Put the Slingshot band on your upper arms, sitting across the chest.
how_to_2: Lower the bar to the chest, letting the band stretch.
how_to_3: Press back up, using the band's assistance out of the bottom.
watch_for: Band slipping. Relying on it for all heavy work. Elbows flaring.

name: Overhead Press (Standing Military Press)
tags: Front delts · Side delts · Triceps · Barbell
how_to_1: Stand with the bar on the front of your shoulders, hands just outside shoulder width.
how_to_2: Brace your core and squeeze glutes, then press the bar straight up, moving your head back slightly.
how_to_3: Lock out overhead with the bar over mid-foot, then lower to the shoulders.
watch_for: Leaning back excessively. Pressing the bar forward. Soft core.

name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
tags: Front delts · Side delts · Triceps · Barbell
how_to_1: Sit on an upright bench with the bar on your upper chest.
how_to_2: Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
watch_for: Arching the lower back off the pad. Bar drifting forward. Locking out too hard.

name: Push Press
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Dip and drive.

name: Behind-the-Neck Press
tags: Side delts · Front delts · Triceps · Barbell
how_to_1: Sit or stand with the bar resting on your upper traps, wider grip.
how_to_2: Press the bar straight up overhead.
how_to_3: Lower slowly back behind the head to ear level.
watch_for: Lack of shoulder mobility. Going too heavy. Pushing the head forward.

name: Z Press
how_to_1: Sit on the floor with legs straight out and the bar on the front of the shoulders.
how_to_2: Brace your core and press the bar overhead.
how_to_3: Lower back to the shoulders under control.
watch_for: Leaning back. Rounding the lower back. Pressing forward.

name: Bradford Press
how_to_1: Stand with the bar on the front of your shoulders.
how_to_2: Press it just over your head and lower it behind the neck.
how_to_3: Press it back over and lower to the front; repeat alternating.
watch_for: Pressing too high. Going heavy. Losing control behind the neck.

name: Barbell Front Raise
how_to_1: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip at thigh level.
how_to_2: Raise the bar in front with straight arms to shoulder height.
how_to_3: Lower slowly back to the thighs.
watch_for: Swinging the body. Raising above eye level. Bending the elbows.

name: Barbell Upright Row
how_to_1: Stand holding the bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
how_to_2: Pull the bar up along your body, leading with the elbows, to chest height.
watch_for: Pulling too high. Grip too narrow. Shoulder pinching.

name: Wide-Grip Upright Row
how_to_1: Hold the bar with a grip wider than shoulders.
how_to_2: Pull up leading with elbows to lower-chest height.
watch_for: Going too heavy. Shrugging instead of pulling. Wrists bending.

name: Barbell High Pull
how_to_1: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a clean or snatch-width grip.
how_to_2: Extend hips and knees explosively and shrug.
how_to_3: Pull the bar to chest height with elbows high and outside.
watch_for: Pulling with arms early. Not finishing hip extension. Bar swinging away from the body.

name: Barbell Shrug
how_to_1: Stand holding the bar at thighs, arms straight.
how_to_2: Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
how_to_3: Pause at the top, then lower fully.
watch_for: Rolling the shoulders. Bending the elbows. Nodding the head forward.

name: Behind-the-Back Shrug
how_to_1: Hold the bar behind your thighs with straight arms.
how_to_2: Shrug your shoulders straight up.
watch_for: Bending the elbows. Leaning forward. Short range of motion.

name: Snatch-Grip Behind-the-Neck Press
tags: Side delts · Front delts · Triceps · Barbell
how_to_1: Hold the bar on the upper back with a wide snatch grip.
how_to_2: Press it straight up to lockout overhead.
how_to_3: Lower slowly back to the traps.
watch_for: Poor shoulder mobility. Going heavy. Head pushing forward.

name: Viking Press (Barbell)
how_to_1: Load one end of a bar in a landmine or use a Viking press handle attachment.
how_to_2: Stand facing it with handles at shoulder height.
how_to_3: Press up to lockout and lower back.
watch_for: Leaning back. Locking the knees. Pressing unevenly.

name: Barbell Overhead Hold
how_to_1: Press or jerk the bar overhead to lockout.
how_to_2: Hold it with arms locked and core braced.
how_to_3: Hold for the set time, then lower safely.
watch_for: Bent elbows. Ribs flaring. Bar drifting forward.

name: Pin Press (Overhead)
how_to_1: Set pins in a rack at forehead or chin height with the bar resting on them.
how_to_2: Get under the bar and brace.
how_to_3: Press from a dead stop to lockout and lower back to the pins.
watch_for: Bouncing off pins. Leaning back. Pins uneven.

name: Conventional Deadlift
muscles_worked: Hamstrings · Glutes · Lower back · Upper back · Grip
tags: Hamstrings · Glutes · Lower back · Upper back · Grip · Barbell
how_to_1: Stand with mid-foot under the bar, hip-width stance, grip just outside the legs.
how_to_2: Push hips back, flat back, chest up; push the floor away and stand up with the bar close.
how_to_3: Lock hips and knees at the top, then lower by hinging.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Bar drifting away. Jerking the bar off the floor.

name: Sumo Deadlift
how_to_1: Take a wide stance with toes turned out, grip inside the knees.
how_to_2: Push knees out, chest up, then drive the floor apart to stand up.
how_to_3: Lock out with glutes, then lower under control.
watch_for: Knees caving in. Hips shooting up first. Rounding the back.

name: Romanian Deadlift
how_to_1: Stand holding the bar at hips with soft knees.
how_to_2: Push hips back, sliding the bar down the thighs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
how_to_3: Drive hips forward to stand up.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Bending the knees too much. Bar drifting forward.

name: Stiff-Legged Deadlift
how_to_1: Stand with the bar and knees almost straight.
how_to_2: Hinge at the hips, lowering the bar toward the floor with a flat back.
how_to_3: Return to standing by driving the hips forward.
watch_for: Rounding the spine. Locking knees hard. Going too low with poor mobility.

name: Deficit Deadlift
tags: Hamstrings · Glutes · Lower back · Quads · Barbell
how_to_1: Stand on a 2–10 cm plate or platform with the bar over mid-foot.
how_to_2: Set up and pull as in a conventional deadlift from the lower start.
how_to_3: Lock out and lower to the floor.
watch_for: Rounding the back from the deeper start. Too high a deficit. Hips rising early.

name: Rack Pull
muscles_worked: Upper back · Traps · Glutes · Lower back
tags: Upper back · Traps · Glutes · Lower back · Barbell
how_to_1: Set the bar on pins or blocks at knee height.
how_to_2: Grip, brace and pull the bar up to lockout.
how_to_3: Lower back to the pins under control.
watch_for: Hitching the bar up the thighs. Leaning back. Rounding the back.

name: Block Pull
tags: Upper back · Glutes · Lower back · Barbell
how_to_1: Set the plates on blocks so the bar starts above the floor.
how_to_2: Set up as for a deadlift and stand up.
how_to_3: Lock out and lower to the blocks.
watch_for: Bouncing off the blocks. Hips rising first. Losing back position.

name: Snatch-Grip Deadlift
tags: Upper back · Traps · Hamstrings · Glutes · Barbell
how_to_1: Take a wide snatch grip on the bar.
how_to_2: Drop hips lower than a normal deadlift and pull with a flat back.
how_to_3: Stand tall and lower under control.
watch_for: Rounding the upper back. Grip slipping. Hips shooting up.

name: Paused Deadlift
how_to_1: Set up as for a conventional deadlift.
how_to_2: Pull the bar just off the floor (or to below the knee) and pause 1–2 seconds.
watch_for: Losing back tightness in the pause. Bar drifting forward. Shifting weight to toes.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row (Overhand)
muscles_worked: Upper back · Lats · Rear delts · Biceps
tags: Upper back · Lats · Rear delts · Biceps · Barbell
how_to_1: Hinge forward to about 45° with a flat back, holding the bar overhand.
how_to_2: Pull the bar to your lower chest/upper stomach.
how_to_3: Lower with control until arms are straight.
watch_for: Using body swing. Rounding the back. Standing up during the pull.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row (Underhand / Yates Row)
how_to_1: Hold the bar underhand, hinge forward to about 30–45°.
how_to_2: Pull the bar to your lower stomach, elbows close.
watch_for: Standing too upright. Jerking the weight. Biceps doing all the work.

name: Pendlay Row
tags: Upper back · Lats · Rear delts · Barbell
how_to_1: Hinge until your torso is close to parallel, bar on the floor.
how_to_2: Pull the bar explosively to the lower chest.
how_to_3: Return it to the floor and reset each rep.
watch_for: Lifting the torso. Rounding the back. Not resetting on the floor.

name: Seal Row
tags: Upper back · Lats · Rear delts · Barbell
how_to_1: Lie face down on a high bench with the bar underneath.
how_to_2: Pull the bar up to the bench underside.
how_to_3: Lower until arms are fully straight.
watch_for: Lifting the chest off the bench. Jerking. Short range of motion.

name: T-Bar Row (Barbell in Corner)
tags: Upper back · Lats · Rear delts · Barbell
how_to_1: Wedge one end of the bar in a corner, straddle it and grip the bar behind the plates with a V-handle or hands.
how_to_2: Hinge with a flat back and pull the plates toward your chest.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Standing up during pulls. Using momentum.

name: Meadows Row
tags: Lats · Upper back · Rear delts · Barbell
how_to_1: Stand side-on to a landmine bar, staggered stance, grip the fat end overhand.
how_to_2: Pull the bar end toward your hip, elbow high.
how_to_3: Lower slowly to a full stretch.
watch_for: Twisting the torso. Rounding the back. Too much weight.

name: Barbell Good Morning
how_to_1: Rest the bar on your upper back, feet hip-width, knees soft.
how_to_2: Hinge forward at the hips, keeping the back flat until near parallel.
how_to_3: Return to standing by driving hips forward.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Bending the knees too much. Going too heavy.

name: Seated Good Morning
how_to_1: Sit on a bench with the bar on your upper back.
how_to_2: Lean forward with a flat back as far as control allows.
watch_for: Rounding the spine. Using heavy weight. Bouncing at the bottom.

name: Jefferson Curl
how_to_1: Stand on a box holding a light barbell.
how_to_2: Tuck the chin and roll down one vertebra at a time, letting the bar lower.
how_to_3: Roll back up slowly to standing.
watch_for: Going heavy. Moving fast. Locking the knees hard.

name: Jefferson Deadlift
how_to_1: Straddle the bar with one foot in front and one behind, hands front and back.
how_to_2: Squat down, flat back, and grip.
how_to_3: Stand up, keeping hips square, then lower.
watch_for: Twisting the torso. Rounding the back. Uneven foot stance.

name: Kroc Row (Barbell)
how_to_1: Stand side-on to a landmine or bar end, supporting yourself with one hand.
how_to_2: Pull the bar end hard toward your hip with some body English.
watch_for: Excessive twisting. Losing control. Rounding the back.

name: Barbell Inverted Row (Rack)
how_to_1: Set a bar at hip height in a rack and hang underneath, heels on the floor.
how_to_2: Keep the body straight and pull your chest to the bar.
watch_for: Sagging hips. Chin poking forward. Half reps.

name: Helms Row
how_to_1: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding the bar.
how_to_2: Row the bar up without your chest leaving the pad.

name: Zercher Deadlift
tags: Glutes · Hamstrings · Upper back · Core · Barbell
how_to_1: Set the bar at knee height, squat down and hook it in the crook of your elbows.
how_to_2: Stand up with the bar locked in your elbows.
how_to_3: Lower back down with a flat back.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Elbow pain from no padding. Going too heavy.

name: Suitcase Deadlift (Barbell)
how_to_1: Stand beside a barbell, grip it in the centre with one hand.
how_to_2: Hinge and stand up without leaning to the loaded side.
how_to_3: Lower with control and switch sides.
watch_for: Leaning sideways. Rotating the torso. Bar tipping.

name: Hip Hinge with Barbell
how_to_1: Hold a light barbell at your hips.
how_to_2: Push your hips back with a flat back, bar along the thighs.
watch_for: Bending the knees too much. Rounding the back. Going too low.

name: Back Squat (High Bar)
how_to_1: Rest the bar on your upper traps, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
how_to_2: Brace, then sit down between your hips, knees tracking over toes, to at least parallel.
how_to_3: Drive up through mid-foot to stand.
watch_for: Knees caving in. Heels lifting. Rounding the lower back at the bottom.

name: Back Squat (Low Bar)
tags: Glutes · Hamstrings · Quads · Lower back · Barbell
how_to_1: Rest the bar lower on your rear delts, slightly wider stance.
how_to_2: Push hips back and down with more forward lean, to parallel.
how_to_3: Drive up with hips and chest rising together.
watch_for: Bar rolling up the back. Hips rising first. Wrist pain from bent wrists.

name: Front Squat
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack, elbows high.
how_to_2: Squat down, torso upright.

name: Box Squat
how_to_1: Set a box behind you at parallel height, bar on your back.
how_to_2: Sit back onto the box under control and pause.
how_to_3: Drive up off the box without rocking.
watch_for: Plopping onto the box. Relaxing on the box. Rocking back to build momentum.

name: Pause Squat
how_to_1: Set up as for a back squat.
how_to_2: Squat to the bottom and hold still for 1–3 seconds.
how_to_3: Drive up out of the hole.
watch_for: Relaxing at the bottom. Losing brace. Bouncing out.

name: Pin Squat
how_to_1: Set safety pins at the bottom of your squat with the bar on them.
how_to_2: Get under the bar from the bottom position.
how_to_3: Stand up from a dead stop, then lower back to the pins.
watch_for: Bouncing off the pins. Poor bottom position. Pins uneven.

name: Anderson Squat
how_to_1: Start with the bar on pins at your bottom squat height.
how_to_2: Get set under the bar.
how_to_3: Squat it up to standing and return to the pins.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Not resetting each rep. Pins too low.

name: Zercher Squat
tags: Quads · Glutes · Upper back · Core · Barbell
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the crook of your elbows close to the body.
how_to_2: Squat down keeping the torso upright.
watch_for: Rounding the upper back. Elbows dropping. Bar slipping.

name: Overhead Squat
how_to_1: Hold the bar overhead with a wide grip.
how_to_2: Squat down keeping the bar over mid-foot.
watch_for: Bar drifting forward. Elbows bending. Heels lifting.

name: Safety-Style Hands-Free Front Squat
how_to_1: Hold a front squat bar or use a harness-style setup that frees the hands.
how_to_2: Squat to depth keeping the torso upright.

name: Half Squat
how_to_1: Set up with the bar on your back.
how_to_2: Squat down until knees are at roughly 90°.
watch_for: Overloading the weight. Leaning forward. Knees caving.

name: Quarter Squat
how_to_1: Set up with the bar on your back.
how_to_2: Bend knees and hips a quarter of the way down.
watch_for: Excessive load. Knee pain. Poor bracing.

name: Barbell Hack Squat (Behind Legs)
how_to_1: Stand in front of a barbell and grip it behind your legs.
how_to_2: Squat down until the bar is near the floor, chest up.
how_to_3: Stand up, keeping the bar close to the legs.
watch_for: Bar scraping the calves. Rounding the back. Heels lifting.

name: Barbell Lunge (Forward)
how_to_1: Stand with the bar on your back.
how_to_2: Step forward and lower until both knees are near 90°.
how_to_3: Push back to the start and alternate legs.
watch_for: Front knee caving. Leaning forward. Short steps.

name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
how_to_1: Stand with the bar on your back.
how_to_2: Step one foot back and lower the back knee towards the floor.
how_to_3: Drive through the front heel to return.
watch_for: Losing balance. Torso leaning. Knee crashing to the floor.

name: Barbell Walking Lunge
how_to_1: Hold the bar on your back.
how_to_2: Step forward into a lunge.
how_to_3: Bring the back foot forward into the next lunge and keep walking.
watch_for: Narrow, tightrope steps. Knee caving. Bar shifting.

name: Barbell Lateral Lunge
how_to_1: Stand with the bar on your back, feet together.
how_to_2: Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip, other leg straight.
watch_for: Knee caving in. Heel lifting. Rounding the back.

name: Barbell Curtsy Lunge
how_to_1: Hold the bar on your back.
how_to_2: Step one leg diagonally behind the other and lower.
watch_for: Twisting the hips. Knee caving. Losing balance.

name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
how_to_1: Place the rear foot on a bench with the bar on your back.
how_to_2: Lower straight down until the front thigh is near parallel.
how_to_3: Drive up through the front foot.
watch_for: Front foot too close. Leaning forward. Knee caving.

name: Barbell Split Squat
how_to_1: Stand in a split stance with the bar on your back.
how_to_2: Lower straight down until the back knee is near the floor.
how_to_3: Push back up without moving the feet.
watch_for: Narrow stance. Knee caving. Leaning forward.

name: Front-Rack Lunge
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Step into a lunge keeping elbows up.
watch_for: Elbows dropping. Leaning forward. Short steps.

name: Barbell Step-Up
how_to_1: Hold the bar on your back facing a sturdy box.
how_to_2: Step up with one foot and drive through it to stand on the box.
watch_for: Pushing off the back foot. Knee caving. Box too high.

name: Barbell Calf Raise (Standing)
how_to_1: Stand with the bar on your back, balls of the feet on a plate.
how_to_2: Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
how_to_3: Lower the heels slowly below the plate.

name: Seated Barbell Calf Raise
how_to_1: Sit with the balls of your feet on a plate and a padded bar across your knees.
how_to_2: Raise your heels as high as possible.

name: Barbell Tibialis Raise
how_to_1: Stand with heels on a platform, a light bar or plate resting across the toes (or use a tib bar).
how_to_2: Lift your toes up towards your shins.
watch_for: Using momentum. Too heavy. Knees bending.

name: Sissy Squat with Barbell Plate
how_to_1: Hold a plate on your chest, rise onto your toes, holding support if needed.
how_to_2: Lean back and bend your knees forward as you lower.
how_to_3: Push back up by straightening the knees.
watch_for: Knee pain. Bending at the hips. Going too deep too soon.

name: Barbell Cossack Squat
how_to_1: Hold a light bar on your back in a very wide stance.
how_to_2: Shift into one leg and sit deep, keeping the other leg straight, toe up.
how_to_3: Push back up and shift to the other side.
watch_for: Heel lifting. Rounding the back. Losing balance.

name: Tempo Squat
how_to_1: Set up as for a back squat.
how_to_2: Lower slowly over a set count (e.g. 3–5 seconds).
watch_for: Rushing the descent. Losing position. Holding breath too long.

name: 1.5-Rep Squat
how_to_1: Set up as for a squat.
how_to_2: Squat to the bottom, rise halfway, then return to the bottom.
how_to_3: Stand all the way up — that's one rep.
watch_for: Cutting depth. Losing balance. Not bracing.

name: Squat with Chains
how_to_1: Hang chains from the sleeves so they rest on the floor at the bottom.
how_to_2: Squat to depth.

name: Squat with Bands
how_to_1: Attach bands from the sleeves to the rack base.
how_to_2: Squat down under control.
how_to_3: Drive up fast against the band tension.
watch_for: Bands pulling you forward. Uneven tension. Losing balance at the top.

name: Belt-Style Barbell Squat
how_to_1: Attach a loaded barbell or plates to a dip belt and stand on two boxes.
how_to_2: Squat down with the weight hanging between your legs.
watch_for: Boxes unstable. Leaning forward. Weight swinging.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
how_to_1: Sit with your upper back on a bench, bar padded across your hips.
how_to_2: Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
watch_for: Arching the lower back. Pushing through the toes. Chin up instead of tucked.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
how_to_1: Lie on the floor with the bar padded across your hips.
how_to_2: Push through your heels and lift your hips.
how_to_3: Squeeze at the top, then lower.
watch_for: Overextending the back. Feet too far away. Rushing.

name: Single-Leg Barbell Hip Thrust
how_to_1: Set up for a hip thrust with a light bar, one foot planted, other leg raised.
how_to_2: Drive up through the planted heel.
how_to_3: Lower under control and switch sides.
watch_for: Hips tilting. Arching the back. Too heavy.

name: B-Stance Hip Thrust
how_to_1: Set up for a hip thrust with one foot forward and the other slightly back on its toes.
how_to_2: Drive mostly through the front heel to lift the hips.
watch_for: Pushing equally with both feet. Hips rotating. Arching.

name: Paused Hip Thrust
how_to_1: Set up for a hip thrust.
how_to_2: Lift your hips and hold the top for 2–3 seconds.
watch_for: Arching in the pause. Relaxing the glutes. Short range.

name: Barbell Frog Pump
how_to_1: Lie on your back, soles of the feet together, knees out, bar across hips.
how_to_2: Thrust your hips up by squeezing the glutes.
watch_for: Using the lower back. Feet too far from the body. Too heavy.

name: Barbell Kas Glute Bridge
how_to_1: Set up for a hip thrust with your back on a bench.
how_to_2: Raise your hips only from a hip-height start, through a short range.
how_to_3: Keep the torso still and lower slightly.
watch_for: Moving the upper back. Arching. Losing tension at the top.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust (Feet Elevated)
how_to_1: Set up for a hip thrust with feet on a low step.
how_to_2: Drive your hips up to full extension.
watch_for: Feet slipping. Overextending. Too high a step.

name: Barbell Curl
how_to_1: Stand holding the bar underhand at shoulder width, arms straight.
how_to_2: Curl the bar to your shoulders, keeping elbows by your sides.
watch_for: Swinging the torso. Elbows drifting forward. Half reps.

name: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl
how_to_1: Hold the bar underhand wider than shoulders.
how_to_2: Curl the bar up with elbows fixed.

name: Close-Grip Barbell Curl
how_to_1: Hold the bar underhand with hands close together.
how_to_2: Curl up keeping the elbows tucked.

name: Reverse Barbell Curl
how_to_1: Hold the bar overhand, shoulder-width.
how_to_2: Curl the bar up with wrists straight.

name: Drag Curl
how_to_1: Hold the bar underhand at thighs.
how_to_2: Curl it up while dragging it along your body, elbows moving back.
watch_for: Elbows drifting forward. Swinging. Bar moving away from the body.

name: Barbell Preacher Curl
how_to_1: Sit at a preacher bench with upper arms on the pad, bar underhand.
how_to_2: Curl the bar up to shoulder height.
how_to_3: Lower until arms are nearly straight.
watch_for: Lifting the elbows off the pad. Dropping the weight. Hyperextending at the bottom.

name: Spider Curl (Barbell)
how_to_1: Lie chest-down on the vertical side of a preacher bench or incline bench, arms hanging.
how_to_2: Curl the bar up towards your face.

name: Barbell Cheat Curl
how_to_1: Hold the bar underhand at thighs with a heavier load.
how_to_2: Use a slight hip drive to start the curl to the top.
how_to_3: Lower very slowly with strict form.
watch_for: Excessive swing. Rounding the back. Dropping on the way down.

name: 21s (Barbell)
how_to_1: Hold the bar underhand at thighs.
how_to_2: Do 7 reps from bottom to halfway, then 7 from halfway to top.

name: Barbell Skull Crusher
how_to_1: Lie on a bench holding the bar over your chest with a narrow grip.
how_to_2: Bend the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
how_to_3: Extend back up to straight arms.
watch_for: Elbows flaring. Upper arms moving. Bouncing near the head.

name: JM Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench with a close grip, bar over your chest.
how_to_2: Lower the bar toward your chin/upper chest, letting elbows move forward slightly.
watch_for: Elbows flaring. Bar crashing to the face. Too heavy.

name: Barbell Overhead Triceps Extension
how_to_1: Sit or stand holding the bar overhead with a narrow grip.
how_to_2: Bend the elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
how_to_3: Straighten your arms back to the top.
watch_for: Elbows flaring. Arching the back. Too heavy.

name: Barbell Tate Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench holding the bar over your chest.
how_to_2: Bend the elbows outward to lower the bar to your chest.
how_to_3: Press back up with the triceps.
watch_for: Losing control. Wrist strain. Too heavy.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
how_to_1: Sit with forearms on your thighs, palms up, holding the bar.
how_to_2: Curl your wrists up.
how_to_3: Lower slowly, letting the bar roll to your fingertips if desired.
watch_for: Moving the forearms. Going too heavy. Bouncing.

name: Reverse Barbell Wrist Curl
how_to_1: Sit with forearms on thighs, palms down, holding the bar.
how_to_2: Lift the back of your hands up.
watch_for: Using too much weight. Moving forearms. Jerking.

name: Behind-the-Back Wrist Curl
how_to_1: Stand holding the bar behind your thighs, palms facing back.
how_to_2: Curl your wrists up.

name: Barbell Finger Roll
how_to_1: Hold the bar with palms up, forearms supported.
how_to_2: Let the bar roll down to your fingertips.
how_to_3: Curl it back up into the palm.
watch_for: Dropping the bar. Too heavy. Rushing.

name: Barbell Rollout
how_to_1: Kneel holding a loaded bar with small plates in front of you.
how_to_2: Roll the bar forward keeping your hips and back straight.
how_to_3: Pull back with your abs to the start.
watch_for: Hips sagging. Lower back arching. Going too far.

name: Barbell Landmine Rotation (Corner)
how_to_1: Wedge one end of the bar in a corner, hold the other end overhead with both hands.
how_to_2: Rotate the bar down to one hip in an arc.
how_to_3: Bring it over to the other hip.
watch_for: Rotating the hips too much. Bending the arms. Losing control.

name: Barbell Russian Twist
how_to_1: Sit holding a light bar (or plate on bar end) with feet down or raised.
how_to_2: Rotate the bar to one side.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Moving only the arms. Too fast.

name: Barbell Overhead Carry
how_to_1: Press the bar overhead to lockout.
how_to_2: Walk forward holding it locked out.
how_to_3: Walk the set distance, then lower safely.
watch_for: Elbows bending. Ribs flaring. Bar drifting.

name: Barbell Front-Rack Carry
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack with elbows up.
how_to_2: Walk forward with a tall posture.
watch_for: Elbows dropping. Leaning back. Short choppy steps.

name: Barbell Suitcase Hold
how_to_1: Hold a barbell in one hand at its centre at your side.
how_to_2: Stand tall without leaning.
how_to_3: Hold for time and switch sides.

name: Barbell Side Bend
how_to_1: Hold the bar on your upper back.
how_to_2: Bend to one side slowly.
how_to_3: Return to upright and repeat other side.
watch_for: Leaning forward. Going too heavy. Twisting.

name: Barbell Good Morning Twist
how_to_1: Hold a light bar on your upper back.
how_to_2: Hinge forward and rotate the torso to one side.
how_to_3: Return to center and stand; alternate sides.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Heavy load. Jerky rotation.

name: Barbell Thruster
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Front squat to depth.
how_to_3: Drive up and use the momentum to press the bar overhead in one movement.
watch_for: Pressing before standing. Elbows dropping. Bar drifting forward.

name: Barbell Complex
how_to_1: Choose 4–6 barbell moves (e.g. deadlift, row, clean, press, squat).
how_to_2: Perform the reps of each back to back without putting the bar down.
watch_for: Weight too heavy for the weakest move. Rushing form. Holding breath.

name: Bear Complex
how_to_1: Hold a barbell on the floor.
how_to_2: Do a power clean, front squat, push press, back squat and push press as one rep.
how_to_3: Return the bar to the floor and repeat.
watch_for: Too heavy. Skipping full depth. Poor rack position.

name: Barbell Burpee Deadlift
how_to_1: Stand over a barbell.
how_to_2: Do a burpee with hands next to or on the bar.
how_to_3: Stand up and complete a deadlift.
watch_for: Rounding back on the deadlift. Sloppy burpee. Bar rolling.

name: Barbell Clean and Press
how_to_1: Stand over the bar with a deadlift-width grip.
how_to_2: Clean the bar to the shoulders.
how_to_3: Press it overhead, then lower to the floor.
watch_for: Reverse curling the bar. Leaning back on the press. Rounding back.

name: Barbell Ground-to-Overhead
how_to_1: Stand over the bar.
how_to_2: Get it from the floor to overhead by any method (clean & jerk, snatch).
how_to_3: Show full lockout, then return it to the floor.
watch_for: Pressing out of a bad position. Rounding back. Not locking out.

name: Barbell Shoulder-to-Overhead
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Get it overhead with a press, push press or jerk.
how_to_3: Lock out and return to the shoulders.
watch_for: Not locking out. Leaning back. Bar forward.

name: Barbell Bear Crawl Drag
how_to_1: Get into a bear crawl position with one hand on a barbell.
how_to_2: Drag the bar along as you crawl forward.
watch_for: Hips rising. Twisting. Knees touching the floor.

name: Snatch (Full / Squat Snatch)
tags: Full body · Power · Quads · Shoulders · Barbell
how_to_1: Start with the bar over mid-foot, wide snatch grip, hips above knees, back flat.
how_to_2: Pull smoothly past the knees, then explode through hips and knees and pull under the bar.
how_to_3: Catch it overhead in a full squat with arms locked, then stand up.
watch_for: Bar swinging away from the body. Pulling early with the arms. Soft elbows in the catch.

name: Power Snatch
how_to_1: Set up as for the snatch.
how_to_2: Extend explosively and pull yourself under the bar.
how_to_3: Catch it overhead above parallel with arms locked, then stand.
watch_for: Pressing out. Catching too low or forward. Jumping feet too wide.

name: Hang Snatch
how_to_1: Stand holding the bar at the hang (just above the knee) with a snatch grip.
how_to_2: Hinge slightly, then extend explosively.
how_to_3: Pull under and catch in a full overhead squat.
watch_for: Dipping with the knees too far forward. Early arm bend. Bar looping out.

name: Hang Power Snatch
how_to_1: Hold the bar at the hang with a snatch grip.
how_to_2: Dip and drive explosively through the hips.
how_to_3: Catch overhead above parallel with locked arms.
watch_for: Using the arms to lift. Bar crashing. Feet landing too wide.

name: Muscle Snatch
how_to_1: Hold the bar with a snatch grip at mid-thigh.
how_to_2: Extend the hips and knees, then pull the bar up with elbows high.
how_to_3: Turn the arms over and press to lockout without re-bending the knees.
watch_for: Re-bending the knees. Bar moving away. Pausing at the turnover.

name: Block Snatch
how_to_1: Set the bar on blocks at the chosen height.
how_to_2: Set up and extend explosively from the blocks.
watch_for: Bumping the blocks. Starting too soon. Poor balance.

name: Snatch Balance
how_to_1: Hold the bar on your back with a snatch grip.
how_to_2: Dip slightly and drive the bar up, dropping fast under it.
how_to_3: Catch in a deep overhead squat, arms locked, then stand.
watch_for: Pressing yourself down slowly. Elbows bending. Heels lifting.

name: Drop Snatch
how_to_1: Hold the bar on your back with a snatch grip, feet in receiving stance.
how_to_2: Drop straight into a full squat while pushing the bar overhead.
how_to_3: Lock out in the bottom, then stand.
watch_for: Dipping first. Soft elbows. Losing balance.

name: Heaving Snatch Balance
how_to_1: Hold the bar on your back with a snatch grip, feet in receiving stance.
how_to_2: Dip and drive the bar up, then sit down fast under it.
how_to_3: Catch in a deep overhead squat, then stand.
watch_for: Moving the feet. Pressing out. Bar drifting.

name: Snatch Pull
how_to_1: Set up as for the snatch.
how_to_2: Pull the bar from the floor through full extension of hips, knees and ankles.
how_to_3: Finish with a shrug, then lower.
watch_for: Bending the arms. Hips rising first. Leaning back too much.

name: Snatch High Pull
how_to_1: Set up as for the snatch.
how_to_2: Extend fully, then pull the bar to chest height with elbows high and out.
watch_for: Arms bending early. Bar swinging. Not finishing extension.

name: Snatch Deadlift
how_to_1: Set up with a snatch grip.
how_to_2: Lift the bar to standing slowly, keeping the snatch start positions.
watch_for: Hips shooting up. Rounding. Bar drifting forward.

name: Halting Snatch Deadlift
how_to_1: Set up with a snatch grip.
how_to_2: Lift the bar to just above the knees and hold 2–3 seconds.
watch_for: Shoulders behind the bar. Losing back tension. Weight on toes.

name: Snatch Push Press
how_to_1: Hold the bar on your back with a snatch grip.
how_to_2: Dip and drive to push the bar overhead.
how_to_3: Lock out and lower to the back.
watch_for: Pressing too early. Bar forward. Elbows soft.

name: Sots Press
how_to_1: Sit in the bottom of a squat with the bar on your back or front.
how_to_2: Press the bar overhead while staying in the squat.
watch_for: Losing depth. Leaning forward. Elbows bending at the top.

name: Tall Snatch
how_to_1: Stand tall, on toes, bar at hips with a snatch grip.
how_to_2: Pull the bar up and drop under it fast, feet moving to receiving stance.
how_to_3: Catch in a full overhead squat.
watch_for: Bending the knees before pulling. Slow turnover. Bar looping.

name: No-Feet Snatch
how_to_1: Set your feet in the receiving stance.
how_to_2: Snatch the bar without moving your feet.
watch_for: Feet shifting. Jumping forward. Bar out front.

name: No-Contact Snatch
how_to_1: Set up as for the snatch.
how_to_2: Pull without bumping the bar against the hips.
watch_for: Bar swinging. Hitting the hips. Pulling early.

name: Pause Snatch
how_to_1: Set up as for the snatch.
how_to_2: Pause for 2–3 seconds at a set position (e.g. knee).
watch_for: Losing position in the pause. Rushing after. Shoulders behind the bar.

name: Split Snatch
how_to_1: Set up as for the snatch.
how_to_2: Extend and drop into a split stance.
how_to_3: Catch overhead with arms locked, recover feet together.
watch_for: Back knee crashing. Short split. Bar drifting.

name: Snatch from Low Hang
how_to_1: Hold the bar just below the knee with a snatch grip.
how_to_2: Extend explosively.
watch_for: Swinging the bar. Shoulders behind. Arm pulling.

name: Snatch from High Hang
how_to_1: Hold the bar at the hip crease or upper thigh.
how_to_2: Dip and drive explosively.
watch_for: Too much knee bend. Slow turnover. Feet too wide.

name: Snatch Grip Romanian Deadlift
how_to_1: Hold the bar with a snatch grip at the hips.
how_to_2: Hinge back, sliding the bar down your thighs.
watch_for: Rounding the upper back. Knees bending too much. Bar forward.

name: Snatch Shrug
how_to_1: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a snatch grip.
how_to_2: Explosively shrug the shoulders up as you extend.
watch_for: Bending elbows. Rolling shoulders. Partial extension.

name: Clean (Full / Squat Clean)
how_to_1: Start with the bar over mid-foot, shoulder-width grip, back flat.
how_to_2: Pull past the knees, extend explosively and pull under.
how_to_3: Catch the bar on your shoulders in a front squat, then stand.
watch_for: Elbows low in the catch. Reverse curling. Bar looping away.

name: Power Clean
how_to_1: Set up as for the clean.
how_to_2: Extend explosively and pull under.
how_to_3: Catch in a quarter squat on the shoulders, elbows high.
watch_for: Catching on the hands with low elbows. Jumping forward. Arms early.

name: Hang Clean
how_to_1: Hold the bar at the hang with a clean grip.
how_to_2: Dip and extend explosively.
how_to_3: Catch in a full front squat.
watch_for: Knees forward in the dip. Early arm bend. Soft front rack.

name: Hang Power Clean
how_to_1: Hold the bar at the hang.
how_to_2: Dip and drive through the hips.
how_to_3: Catch above parallel with elbows high.
watch_for: Arm curling. Bar swinging. Landing on toes.

name: Muscle Clean
how_to_1: Hold the bar at mid-thigh.
how_to_2: Extend and pull high, elbows up.
how_to_3: Turn the elbows around into the rack without re-bending the knees.
watch_for: Re-bending knees. Bar away from body. Slow turnover.

name: Block Clean
how_to_1: Set the bar on blocks.
how_to_2: Extend explosively from the blocks.
watch_for: Starting too early. Hitting the blocks. Pulling with arms.

name: Clean Pull
how_to_1: Set up as for the clean.
how_to_2: Pull the bar through full extension.
how_to_3: Shrug at the top and lower.
watch_for: Bending the arms. Hips first. Leaning back.

name: Clean High Pull
how_to_1: Set up as for the clean.
how_to_2: Extend fully and pull to chest height, elbows high.
watch_for: Arm pulling early. Bar away. Partial extension.

name: Clean Deadlift
how_to_1: Set up with a clean grip.
how_to_2: Lift slowly keeping clean positions to standing.
watch_for: Hips rising first. Rounding. Bar forward.

name: Halting Clean Deadlift
how_to_1: Set up with a clean grip.
how_to_2: Lift to just above the knee and hold 2–3 seconds.
watch_for: Shoulders behind. Losing tension. Weight shifting.

name: Tall Clean
how_to_1: Stand tall on toes, bar at the hips.
how_to_2: Pull under fast, feet moving to receiving stance.
how_to_3: Catch in a full front squat.
watch_for: Bending knees first. Slow elbows. Landing forward.

name: No-Feet Clean
how_to_1: Set feet in the receiving stance.
how_to_2: Clean without moving the feet.
watch_for: Feet shifting. Jumping forward. Elbows low.

name: Pause Clean
how_to_1: Set up as for the clean.
how_to_2: Pause 2–3 seconds at a set position.
watch_for: Losing position. Rushing. Weight on toes.

name: Split Clean
how_to_1: Set up as for the clean.
how_to_2: Extend and drop into a split stance.
how_to_3: Catch on the shoulders, recover feet together.
watch_for: Short split. Back knee hitting floor. Low elbows.

name: Clean from Low Hang
how_to_1: Hold the bar below the knee.
how_to_2: Extend explosively.
watch_for: Swinging the bar. Arms pulling. Shoulders behind.

name: Clean Shrug
how_to_1: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a clean grip.
how_to_2: Explosively shrug as you extend hips.
watch_for: Bending elbows. Rolling shoulders. Partial range.

name: Squat Clean Thruster (Cluster)
how_to_1: Stand over the bar.
how_to_2: Squat clean the bar to a full front squat.
how_to_3: Drive up straight into a thruster overhead.
watch_for: Pausing at the bottom. Elbows dropping. Pressing early.

name: Hang Squat Clean
how_to_1: Hold the bar at the hang.
how_to_2: Dip and extend.
how_to_3: Catch in a full front squat and stand.
watch_for: Knees forward. Low elbows. Arm pulling.

name: Split Jerk
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Dip and drive, then split your feet front and back as you punch under the bar.
how_to_3: Lock out overhead, recover front foot then back foot.
watch_for: Short split. Pressing out. Bar landing forward of head.

name: Push Jerk
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Dip, drive, and re-dip under the bar.
watch_for: Pressing out. Forward dip. Soft elbows.

name: Power Jerk
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Dip and drive, feet jumping slightly outward.
how_to_3: Catch overhead in a quarter squat, then stand.
watch_for: Feet too wide. Pressing out. Dipping forward.

name: Squat Jerk
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Dip and drive, then drop into a full squat under the bar.
how_to_3: Catch locked out at the bottom, then stand.
watch_for: Mobility limits. Bar forward. Elbows bending.

name: Jerk Balance
how_to_1: Start in a short split stance, bar in front rack.
how_to_2: Dip and drive, stepping the front foot forward into a full split.
watch_for: Back foot moving. Leaning forward. Soft elbows.

name: Jerk Dip Squat
how_to_1: Hold a heavy bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Dip a few cm, keeping torso vertical.
watch_for: Leaning forward. Dipping too deep. Heels lifting.

name: Jerk Drive
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Dip and drive explosively, letting the bar leave the shoulders.
how_to_3: Catch it back in the rack.
watch_for: Pressing with arms. Forward dip. Poor rack.

name: Behind-the-Neck Jerk
how_to_1: Hold the bar on your back with a jerk grip.
how_to_2: Dip and drive, splitting or pushing under the bar.
watch_for: Mobility limits. Bar drifting. Soft elbows.

name: Jerk Recovery
how_to_1: Take the bar out of a rack into a split stance overhead.
how_to_2: Hold the bar overhead locked.
how_to_3: Step front foot back then back foot forward to recover.

name: Tall Jerk
how_to_1: Stand tall on toes with the bar on your shoulders.
how_to_2: Drop and punch under the bar into a split without a dip.
watch_for: Dipping first. Slow feet. Pressing out.

name: Pause Jerk
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Dip and pause 1–2 seconds at the bottom.
how_to_3: Drive and jerk the bar overhead.
watch_for: Losing torso position in pause. Leaning forward. Pressing out.

name: Jerk from Blocks / Rack
how_to_1: Set the bar on blocks or a rack at shoulder height.
how_to_2: Step under it into the front rack.
how_to_3: Jerk it overhead and return to blocks.
watch_for: Poor rack. Rushing setup. Bar forward.

name: Clean and Jerk
how_to_1: Clean the bar to the front rack.
how_to_2: Stand and reset.
watch_for: Poor rack. Rushing the jerk. Pressing out.

name: Clean and Push Jerk
how_to_1: Clean the bar to the front rack.
how_to_2: Stand up and reset.

name: Power Clean and Jerk
how_to_1: Power clean the bar to the front rack.
how_to_2: Reset your stance.

name: Clean + Front Squat + Jerk
how_to_1: Clean the bar.
how_to_2: Perform one front squat.
watch_for: Losing rack. Elbows dropping. Rushing jerk.

name: Snatch + Overhead Squat
how_to_1: Snatch the bar to overhead.
how_to_2: Stand up, then perform an overhead squat.
how_to_3: Stand up and lower the bar.
watch_for: Soft elbows. Bar forward. Heels lifting.

name: Power Snatch + Snatch
how_to_1: Do a power snatch and lower to the hang or floor.
how_to_2: Do a full snatch.

name: Clean + Hang Clean
how_to_1: Do a clean from the floor.
how_to_2: Lower the bar to the hang.
watch_for: Losing back position. Dropping the bar too fast. Arm pulling.

name: Snatch Balance + Overhead Squat
how_to_1: Do a snatch balance.
how_to_2: Stand up.
watch_for: Soft elbows. Losing balance. Heels up.

name: Dumbbell Flat Bench Press
how_to_1: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells at chest level, palms forward.
how_to_2: Press the dumbbells up until arms are straight over your chest.
how_to_3: Lower slowly until elbows are just below the bench.
watch_for: Clanking the weights at the top. Elbows flaring to 90°. Bouncing at the bottom.

name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
tags: Upper chest · Front delts · Triceps · Dumbbell
how_to_1: Lie on a 30–45° incline bench, dumbbells at shoulder level.
how_to_2: Press up and slightly together over the upper chest.
watch_for: Bench too steep. Arching off the bench. Uneven pressing.

name: Dumbbell Decline Bench Press
how_to_1: Lie on a decline bench with feet secured, dumbbells at chest.
how_to_2: Press up over the lower chest.
watch_for: Losing control of the weights. Arching. Getting in/out unsafely.

name: Neutral-Grip (Hammer) Dumbbell Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench with dumbbells, palms facing each other.
how_to_2: Press up keeping elbows close.
how_to_3: Lower to the sides of the chest.
watch_for: Elbows flaring. Wrists bending. Short range.

name: Squeeze Press (Crush Press)
how_to_1: Lie on a bench pressing two dumbbells together over your chest.
how_to_2: Lower them to the chest while squeezing them together.
how_to_3: Press back up while keeping them pressed together.
watch_for: Letting the dumbbells separate. Elbows flaring. Too heavy.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench with one dumbbell at chest level.
how_to_2: Press it up while keeping your torso flat.
how_to_3: Lower under control and switch sides.
watch_for: Torso rotating. Hips lifting. Losing balance.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench with both dumbbells pressed up.
how_to_2: Lower one dumbbell to the chest and press it back up.
watch_for: Rotating the torso. Lowering both. Rushing.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
how_to_1: Lie on the floor holding dumbbells over your chest, knees bent.
how_to_2: Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
watch_for: Slamming elbows down. Flaring. Wrists bending.

name: Dumbbell Flat Fly
how_to_1: Lie on a flat bench, dumbbells over your chest, palms facing, elbows slightly bent.
how_to_2: Open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a chest stretch.
how_to_3: Bring them back together over your chest.
watch_for: Bending elbows into a press. Going too deep. Too heavy.

name: Dumbbell Incline Fly
how_to_1: Lie on an incline bench, dumbbells over the upper chest.
how_to_2: Lower in a wide arc with soft elbows.
how_to_3: Bring them back together at the top.
watch_for: Overstretching. Bending arms too much. Arching.

name: Dumbbell Decline Fly
how_to_1: Lie on a decline bench, dumbbells over your chest.
how_to_2: Lower in a wide arc.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
how_to_1: Lie across a bench with one dumbbell held over your chest with both hands.
how_to_2: Lower it behind your head with slightly bent elbows.
how_to_3: Pull it back over your chest.
watch_for: Bending elbows too much. Hips dropping. Overstretching.

name: Reverse-Grip Dumbbell Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells with palms facing you.
how_to_2: Press up keeping elbows tucked.
watch_for: Wrists bending. Elbows flaring. Too heavy.

name: Low-to-High Dumbbell Fly
how_to_1: Stand or lie on an incline, dumbbells low by your hips.
how_to_2: Raise them up and together in an arc to eye level.
watch_for: Swinging. Shrugging. Bending elbows too much.

name: Svend Press (Dumbbell)
how_to_1: Stand holding one dumbbell (or plates) pressed between your palms at chest.
how_to_2: Push it straight out in front while squeezing.
how_to_3: Bring it back to the chest.
watch_for: Losing the squeeze. Shrugging. Leaning back.

name: Dumbbell Press on Stability Ball
how_to_1: Lie with your upper back on a stability ball, hips up, dumbbells at chest.
how_to_2: Press up over your chest.
watch_for: Hips sagging. Ball rolling. Too heavy.

name: Dumbbell Around-the-World
how_to_1: Lie on a bench holding light dumbbells at your thighs, palms up.
how_to_2: Sweep them out in a wide arc to over your head.
how_to_3: Reverse the arc back to the thighs.
watch_for: Too heavy. Bending elbows. Shoulder pain.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
tags: Front delts · Side delts · Triceps · Dumbbell
how_to_1: Sit on an upright bench, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
how_to_2: Press them overhead until arms are straight.
watch_for: Arching the lower back. Clanking at the top. Elbows too far back.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
muscles_worked: Front delts · Side delts · Triceps · Core
tags: Front delts · Side delts · Triceps · Core · Dumbbell
how_to_1: Stand with dumbbells at shoulder height.
how_to_2: Brace and press overhead.
watch_for: Leaning back. Locking knees. Uneven arms.

name: Arnold Press
tags: Front delts · Side delts · Triceps · Dumbbell
how_to_1: Sit holding dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
how_to_2: Rotate your palms forward as you press overhead.
how_to_3: Reverse the rotation as you lower.
watch_for: Rushing the rotation. Arching the back. Too heavy.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Press
how_to_1: Stand holding one dumbbell at the shoulder.
how_to_2: Press it overhead without leaning.

name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Shoulder Press
how_to_1: Sit with dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing in.
how_to_2: Press overhead.

name: Dumbbell Push Press
how_to_1: Stand with dumbbells at your shoulders.
how_to_2: Dip slightly and drive up with the legs.
how_to_3: Press the dumbbells overhead and lower.
watch_for: Dipping too deep. Pressing before driving. Leaning back.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
how_to_1: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
how_to_2: Raise them out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent.
watch_for: Swinging the torso. Shrugging. Raising above shoulders.

name: Seated Lateral Raise
how_to_1: Sit upright holding dumbbells at your sides.
how_to_2: Raise them out to shoulder height.

name: Leaning Single-Arm Lateral Raise
how_to_1: Hold a sturdy post and lean away, dumbbell in the free hand.
how_to_2: Raise the dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height.
watch_for: Using momentum. Shrugging. Bending the elbow too much.

name: Lying Incline Lateral Raise
how_to_1: Lie sideways on an incline bench, dumbbell in the top hand.
how_to_2: Raise the arm up and out to vertical.
watch_for: Rolling the torso. Too heavy. Shrugging.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
how_to_1: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
how_to_2: Raise them forward to shoulder height with straight arms.
watch_for: Swinging. Raising too high. Leaning back.

name: Alternating Front Raise
how_to_1: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs.
how_to_2: Raise one dumbbell to shoulder height.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly (Bent-Over)
how_to_1: Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells hanging below your chest.
how_to_2: Raise them out to the sides with slightly bent elbows.
watch_for: Rowing instead of flying. Standing up. Shrugging.

name: Chest-Supported Rear Delt Fly
how_to_1: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, dumbbells hanging.
how_to_2: Raise them out to the sides.

name: Dumbbell Y-Raise
tags: Side delts · Traps · Rotator cuff · Dumbbell
how_to_1: Lie chest-down on an incline bench or hinge, thumbs up.
how_to_2: Raise the dumbbells up and out in a Y shape.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
how_to_1: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
how_to_2: Pull them up along your body, elbows leading, to chest height.
watch_for: Pulling too high. Shoulder pinching. Swinging.

name: Cuban Press
how_to_1: Hold light dumbbells at your thighs.
how_to_2: Upright row to elbows at shoulder height, then rotate forearms up.
how_to_3: Press overhead, then reverse the movement.

name: Dumbbell External Rotation (Side-Lying)
how_to_1: Lie on your side, top elbow bent 90° and tucked to your side holding a light dumbbell.
how_to_2: Rotate the forearm up toward the ceiling.
watch_for: Lifting the elbow. Too heavy. Rolling back.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
how_to_1: Stand tall holding the weight with straight arms.
how_to_2: Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears.
how_to_3: Pause at the top, then lower all the way down.
watch_for: Rolling the shoulders in circles. Bending the elbows. Nodding the head forward.

name: Dumbbell Scaption
muscles_worked: Side delts · Front delts · Rotator cuff
tags: Side delts · Front delts · Rotator cuff · Dumbbell
how_to_1: Stand holding light dumbbells, thumbs up.
how_to_2: Raise them at about 30° in front of your body to shoulder height.

name: Lu Raise
tags: Side delts · Front delts · Traps · Dumbbell
how_to_1: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
how_to_2: Raise them out to the sides all the way overhead with straight arms.

name: Dumbbell W-Raise
muscles_worked: Rear delts · Rotator cuff · Upper back
tags: Rear delts · Rotator cuff · Upper back · Dumbbell
how_to_1: Lie chest-down on an incline or hinge, elbows bent, dumbbells by shoulders.
how_to_2: Squeeze shoulder blades and raise into a W shape.

name: Dumbbell Bus Driver (Plate/DB)
how_to_1: Hold a dumbbell or plate out in front with straight arms.
how_to_2: Rotate it like steering a wheel to one side.
watch_for: Bending arms. Dropping the weight. Shrugging.

name: Z Press (Dumbbell)
how_to_1: Sit on the floor, legs straight, dumbbells at shoulders.
how_to_2: Press overhead without leaning back.
watch_for: Rounding the lower back. Leaning. Uneven press.

name: Landmine-Style Single DB Press
tags: Front delts · Upper chest · Triceps · Landmine
how_to_1: Stand holding one dumbbell at the shoulder, palm in.
how_to_2: Press it up and forward at an angle.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
how_to_1: Place one knee and hand on a bench, flat back, dumbbell in the other hand.
how_to_2: Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, elbow close.

name: Two-Arm Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
tags: Upper back · Lats · Rear delts · Dumbbell
how_to_1: Hinge forward with a flat back holding dumbbells.
how_to_2: Pull both to your lower ribs.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Standing up. Using momentum.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row (Incline Bench)
tags: Upper back · Lats · Rear delts · Dumbbell
how_to_1: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
how_to_2: Row them up towards your hips.
watch_for: Lifting the chest. Shrugging. Short range.

name: Kroc Row
how_to_1: Brace one hand on a bench, staggered stance, heavy dumbbell in the other hand.
how_to_2: Row the dumbbell explosively to your hip.
how_to_3: Lower to a full stretch, high reps.

name: Renegade Row
how_to_1: Get into a high plank holding dumbbells, feet wide.
how_to_2: Row one dumbbell to your hip without rotating.
how_to_3: Lower and repeat on the other side.
watch_for: Hips rotating. Sagging. Feet too narrow.

name: Dumbbell Seal Row
how_to_1: Lie face down on a high bench with dumbbells below.
how_to_2: Row them up to the bench.
watch_for: Lifting the chest. Jerking. Short range.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
how_to_1: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
how_to_2: Push hips back, sliding the dumbbells down your legs to mid-shin.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Bending knees too much. Dumbbells drifting forward.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell RDL
how_to_1: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
how_to_2: Hinge forward, extending the free leg back until your body is nearly parallel.
watch_for: Hips rotating open. Rounding. Losing balance.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift
how_to_1: Stand with dumbbells on the floor beside or in front of your feet.
how_to_2: Hinge and squat down with a flat back to grip them.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Hips rising first. Dumbbells far from body.

name: Dumbbell Pullover (Lats)
how_to_1: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell over your chest.
how_to_2: Lower it behind your head with a slight bend in the elbows, focusing on the lats.
how_to_3: Pull back to over your chest.
watch_for: Bending elbows a lot. Overstretching. Hips rising.

name: Dumbbell Gorilla Row
how_to_1: Stand in a wide hinge with dumbbells on the floor between your feet.
how_to_2: Row one dumbbell up while pressing the other into the floor.

name: Dumbbell Pendlay Row
how_to_1: Hinge to near parallel with dumbbells on the floor.
how_to_2: Row them explosively to your ribs.
how_to_3: Return them to the floor each rep.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
how_to_1: Hinge forward holding dumbbells.
how_to_2: Raise them out to the sides.

name: Dumbbell Good Morning
how_to_1: Hold a dumbbell at your chest or behind your neck.
how_to_2: Hinge forward with a flat back.
watch_for: Rounding. Bending knees too much. Too heavy.

name: Dumbbell Snatch-Grip High Pull
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells at your thighs.
how_to_2: Extend hips explosively and pull the dumbbells up, elbows high.
watch_for: Arm pulling early. Swinging. Partial hip drive.

name: Goblet Squat
how_to_1: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest, feet shoulder-width.
how_to_2: Squat down between your knees with chest up.
watch_for: Rounding forward. Heels lifting. Knees caving.

name: Dumbbell Front Squat
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells on your shoulders.
how_to_2: Squat down keeping the torso upright.
watch_for: Elbows dropping. Heels lifting. Knees caving.

name: Dumbbell Back Squat (DBs at Sides)
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
how_to_2: Squat down keeping your chest up.
watch_for: Leaning forward. Heels lifting. Knees caving.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
how_to_1: Stand wide, toes out, holding one dumbbell between your legs.
how_to_2: Squat down, pushing knees out.
watch_for: Knees caving. Leaning forward. Heels lifting.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells, rear foot on a bench behind you.
how_to_2: Lower straight down until the front thigh is near parallel.
how_to_3: Drive up through the front foot.
watch_for: Front foot too close. Knee caving. Leaning.

name: Dumbbell Split Squat
how_to_1: Stand in a split stance holding dumbbells.
how_to_2: Lower the back knee toward the floor.

name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge
how_to_1: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
how_to_2: Step forward and lower until both knees are near 90°.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
how_to_1: Stand holding dumbbells.
how_to_2: Step back and lower the back knee.
how_to_3: Drive through the front heel to stand.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
how_to_2: Lunge forward.
how_to_3: Bring the back foot through into the next lunge.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells, feet together.
how_to_2: Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip.

name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
how_to_2: Step one leg diagonally behind the other and lower.
watch_for: Twisting hips. Knee caving. Losing balance.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells facing a box.
how_to_2: Step up with one foot and stand fully on the box.
watch_for: Pushing off the back foot. Knee caving. Box too high.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Step-Up
how_to_1: Stand side-on to a box holding dumbbells.
how_to_2: Step up sideways with the near leg.
watch_for: Pushing off the floor leg. Knee caving. Leaning.

name: Dumbbell Box Squat
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells and stand in front of a box.
how_to_2: Sit back to touch the box.
watch_for: Plopping down. Relaxing on the box. Knees caving.

name: Dumbbell Cossack Squat
how_to_1: Hold a dumbbell at your chest, wide stance.
how_to_2: Shift into one leg and squat deep, other leg straight.

name: Dumbbell Pistol Squat (Counterweight)
how_to_1: Stand on one leg, holding a light dumbbell out in front.
how_to_2: Squat down on one leg, free leg straight forward.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
how_to_1: Stand holding dumbbells, balls of feet on a step.
how_to_2: Rise onto your toes as high as possible.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
how_to_1: Stand on one foot on a step holding a dumbbell.
how_to_2: Rise onto your toes.

name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
how_to_1: Sit with dumbbells on your knees, balls of feet on a plate.
how_to_2: Raise heels.

name: Dumbbell Hamstring Curl (Lying)
how_to_1: Lie face down holding a dumbbell between your feet.
how_to_2: Curl your heels toward your glutes.

name: Dumbbell Heel-Elevated Squat
how_to_1: Stand with heels on a plate or wedge holding dumbbells.
how_to_2: Squat down deep with an upright torso.

name: Dumbbell Skater Squat
how_to_1: Stand on one leg holding dumbbells.
how_to_2: Lower the back knee toward the floor behind you.

name: Dumbbell Deficit Reverse Lunge
how_to_1: Stand on a low platform holding dumbbells.
how_to_2: Step back off the platform into a deep lunge.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift
how_to_1: Wide stance, one dumbbell on the floor between feet.
how_to_2: Hinge and squat to grip it with a flat back.

name: Dumbbell Jump Squat
how_to_1: Hold light dumbbells at your sides.
how_to_2: Squat down quickly.
how_to_3: Jump explosively and land softly into the next rep.
watch_for: Heavy weights. Stiff landings. Knees caving.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
how_to_1: Sit with upper back on a bench, dumbbell on your hips.
how_to_2: Drive your hips up until body is straight from shoulders to knees.
watch_for: Arching. Pushing through toes. Dumbbell rolling.

name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge
how_to_1: Lie on your back, dumbbell on your hips, knees bent.
how_to_2: Lift your hips.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Hip Thrust
how_to_1: Set up for a hip thrust with one foot planted.
how_to_2: Drive up through the planted heel.

name: Dumbbell Frog Pump
how_to_1: Lie on your back, soles together, dumbbell on hips.
how_to_2: Thrust hips up.
watch_for: Using lower back. Too heavy. Short range.

name: Dumbbell Donkey Kick
how_to_1: Kneel on all fours with a light dumbbell behind one knee.
how_to_2: Kick the leg up, heel toward the ceiling.
watch_for: Arching the back. Dropping the dumbbell. Rotating hips.

name: Dumbbell B-Stance RDL
how_to_1: Stand with one foot slightly behind on its toes, holding dumbbells.
how_to_2: Hinge mostly over the front leg.
watch_for: Back leg doing the work. Rounding. Rotating.

name: Dumbbell Kickstand RDL
how_to_1: Same as B-stance RDL with the back foot as a kickstand.
how_to_2: Hinge at the hips over the front leg.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl (Standing)
how_to_1: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
how_to_2: Curl them to your shoulders, elbows fixed.
watch_for: Swinging. Elbows moving forward. Half reps.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
how_to_1: Stand holding dumbbells.
how_to_2: Curl one dumbbell up.

name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
how_to_1: Sit upright holding dumbbells.
how_to_2: Curl up.

name: Hammer Curl
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
how_to_2: Curl them up keeping a neutral grip.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells with neutral grip.
how_to_2: Curl one across your body toward the opposite shoulder.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
how_to_1: Lie back on an incline bench, arms hanging.
how_to_2: Curl the dumbbells up.

name: Concentration Curl
how_to_1: Sit with elbow braced on your inner thigh holding a dumbbell.
how_to_2: Curl it toward your shoulder.
watch_for: Lifting the elbow. Swinging. Partial range.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
how_to_1: Rest your upper arm on a preacher pad holding a dumbbell.
how_to_2: Curl it up.

name: Spider Curl (Dumbbell)
how_to_1: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, arms hanging.
how_to_2: Curl the dumbbells up.

name: Zottman Curl
how_to_1: Curl dumbbells up with palms up.
how_to_2: Rotate palms down at the top.
how_to_3: Lower slowly palms down, then rotate back at the bottom.
watch_for: Rushing the rotation. Swinging. Too heavy.

name: Dumbbell Drag Curl
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
how_to_2: Curl them up along your body, elbows moving back.

name: Waiter Curl
how_to_1: Hold one dumbbell vertically with both palms under the top head.
how_to_2: Curl it up keeping it vertical.

name: Prone Incline Curl
how_to_1: Lie chest-down on an incline bench.
how_to_2: Curl dumbbells up.

name: Supinating Dumbbell Curl
how_to_1: Start with palms facing in.
how_to_2: Rotate palms up as you curl.

name: Dumbbell 21s
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
how_to_2: Do 7 bottom-half reps, then 7 top-half reps.

name: Bayesian-Style Dumbbell Curl (Lying)
how_to_1: Lie on an incline bench with arms hanging behind the body.
how_to_2: Curl the dumbbells up.
watch_for: Shoulders rolling forward. Swinging. Partial range.

name: Pinwheel Curl
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells with a neutral grip.
how_to_2: Curl one across the body toward the opposite chest.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension (Two-Hand)
how_to_1: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
how_to_2: Lower it behind your head by bending your elbows.

name: Single-Arm Overhead Extension
how_to_1: Hold a dumbbell overhead in one hand.
how_to_2: Lower it behind your head.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
how_to_1: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells over your chest.
how_to_2: Bend the elbows to lower them beside your head.
watch_for: Elbows flaring. Upper arms moving. Too heavy.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
how_to_1: Hinge forward, upper arm parallel to the floor, elbow bent.
how_to_2: Extend the forearm back until the arm is straight.
watch_for: Swinging. Upper arm dropping. Too heavy.

name: Tate Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench, dumbbells over chest, ends touching.
how_to_2: Bend elbows out to lower the dumbbells to your chest.
watch_for: Too heavy. Losing control. Wrist strain.

name: Dumbbell Close-Grip Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench with dumbbells touching, neutral grip.
how_to_2: Lower to your chest with elbows tucked.
watch_for: Elbows flaring. Dumbbells separating. Short range.

name: Dumbbell JM Press
how_to_1: Lie on a bench with dumbbells, neutral grip.
how_to_2: Lower toward your shoulders, elbows moving forward.
watch_for: Elbows flaring. Too heavy. Losing control.

name: Rolling Dumbbell Triceps Extension
how_to_1: Lie on a bench with dumbbells over chest.
how_to_2: Lower them beside your head while letting the elbows drift back.

name: Cross-Body Triceps Extension
how_to_1: Lie on a bench, one dumbbell over the chest.
how_to_2: Lower it across your body toward the opposite shoulder.
watch_for: Elbow moving. Too heavy. Hitting the chest.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
how_to_1: Sit with forearms on thighs, palms up, dumbbells in hand.
how_to_2: Curl the wrists up.

name: Reverse Dumbbell Wrist Curl
how_to_1: Sit with forearms on thighs, palms down.
how_to_2: Raise the backs of your hands.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Rotation (Pronation/Supination)
how_to_1: Hold a dumbbell by one end, forearm supported.
how_to_2: Rotate it palm up.
watch_for: Going fast. Too heavy. Moving the elbow.

name: Dumbbell Radial Deviation
how_to_1: Hold a dumbbell by one end, arm at your side, weight in front.
how_to_2: Tilt the wrist up, lifting the front end.
watch_for: Bending the elbow. Too heavy. Jerking.

name: Dumbbell Ulnar Deviation
how_to_1: Hold a dumbbell by one end, weight behind you.
how_to_2: Tilt the wrist back, lifting the rear end.

name: Dumbbell Farmer's Hold
how_to_1: Pick up heavy dumbbells and stand tall.
how_to_2: Hold them at your sides with straight arms.
how_to_3: Hold for time, then set down safely.

name: Dumbbell Plate-Pinch Style Head Hold
how_to_1: Grip a hex dumbbell by its head with your fingertips.
how_to_2: Lift and hold it at your side.
watch_for: Dropping on toes. Bending wrist. Too heavy.

name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
how_to_1: Sit with knees bent, leaning back, holding a dumbbell.
how_to_2: Rotate the dumbbell to one hip.
watch_for: Rounding. Moving only the arms. Rushing.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
how_to_1: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand.
how_to_2: Bend sideways toward the dumbbell.
how_to_3: Return to upright; switch sides after the set.
watch_for: Leaning forward. Twisting. Holding two dumbbells.

name: Dumbbell Woodchop
how_to_1: Hold a dumbbell with both hands above one shoulder.
how_to_2: Chop it diagonally down across your body to the opposite hip.
watch_for: Rounding. Using only the arms. Too fast.

name: Dumbbell Weighted Crunch
how_to_1: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell at your chest.
how_to_2: Curl your shoulders off the floor.
watch_for: Pulling the neck. Sitting all the way up. Rushing.

name: Dumbbell Weighted Sit-Up
how_to_1: Lie with knees bent, dumbbell at your chest.
how_to_2: Sit all the way up.
watch_for: Jerking. Feet lifting. Rounding the neck.

name: Dumbbell Dead Bug
how_to_1: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell over your chest, knees at 90°.
how_to_2: Extend one leg out while keeping your lower back flat.
watch_for: Lower back arching. Rushing. Holding breath.

name: Dumbbell Suitcase Carry
how_to_1: Hold one heavy dumbbell at your side.
how_to_2: Walk forward without leaning.

name: Dumbbell Farmer's Walk
how_to_1: Hold heavy dumbbells at your sides.
how_to_2: Walk forward with tall posture.
how_to_3: Walk the distance and set down safely.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Carry
how_to_1: Press dumbbells overhead to lockout.
how_to_2: Walk forward keeping them locked.

name: Dumbbell Waiter's Walk
how_to_1: Hold one dumbbell overhead.
how_to_2: Walk forward keeping the arm locked.

name: Dumbbell Plank Drag
how_to_1: Get into a high plank with a dumbbell beside one hand.
how_to_2: Reach under with the opposite hand and drag it across.
watch_for: Hips rotating. Sagging. Feet too narrow.

name: Dumbbell Turkish Get-Up
how_to_1: Lie down holding a dumbbell up in one hand, same-side knee bent.
how_to_2: Roll to the elbow, then hand, lift the hips, sweep the leg through to kneel and stand.
how_to_3: Reverse every step to lie back down.
watch_for: Taking eyes off the weight. Bent elbow. Rushing steps.

name: Dumbbell V-Up
how_to_1: Lie flat holding a dumbbell overhead.
how_to_2: Raise legs and torso together, reaching the dumbbell to your toes.
watch_for: Bending legs. Jerking. Arching on the way down.

how_to_2: Circle it around your head close to your hair.
watch_for: Arching. Moving the torso. Too heavy.

how_to_2: Press it straight out.

name: Dumbbell Thruster

how_to_2: Squat to depth.
how_to_3: Drive up and press them overhead in one motion.

name: Dumbbell Snatch (Single-Arm)
how_to_1: Stand over one dumbbell, hinge and grab it.
how_to_2: Explode upwards, pulling it close to your body.
how_to_3: Punch it to lockout overhead in one move, then lower.
watch_for: Swinging out wide. Pressing out. Rounding.

name: Dumbbell Clean
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
how_to_2: Hinge slightly, then extend explosively.

name: Dumbbell Hang Clean
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells at the hang.
how_to_2: Dip and drive.

name: Dumbbell Clean and Press
how_to_1: Clean the dumbbells to your shoulders.
how_to_2: Press them overhead.
watch_for: Rounding back. Leaning back on press. Rushing.

name: Dumbbell Clean and Jerk
how_to_1: Clean the dumbbells to shoulders.
how_to_2: Dip and drive into a jerk.

how_to_1: Place dumbbells on the floor; do a burpee with hands on them.

how_to_3: Swing them to overhead in one move.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Arms pressing. Sloppy burpee.

how_to_2: Do a push-up, row each arm, jump feet in.

name: Dumbbell Burpee

name: Dumbbell Squat to Press
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells at shoulders.
how_to_2: Squat down.

name: Dumbbell Box Step-Over
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells facing a box.
how_to_2: Step up onto it fully.
watch_for: Jumping down. Knee caving. Pushing off back foot.

name: Dumbbell Hang Power Snatch
how_to_1: Hold one dumbbell at the hang.
how_to_2: Dip and drive explosively.
how_to_3: Catch overhead in a quarter squat.
