how_to_1: Hold dumbbells on shoulders.
how_to_2: Dip and drive, dropping under them.

name: Dumbbell Lunge to Curl to Press
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells.
how_to_2: Lunge, return and curl.

name: Dumbbell Windmill
how_to_1: Hold a dumbbell overhead, feet turned slightly away.
how_to_2: Hinge sideways, sliding the free hand down your leg while eyes stay on the dumbbell.
watch_for: Bending the top elbow. Rounding. Too heavy.

name: Dumbbell Ground-to-Overhead
how_to_1: Stand over one or two dumbbells.
how_to_2: Lift them from the floor to overhead by any method.
watch_for: Rounding. Not locking out. Pressing out.

name: Two-Hand Kettlebell Swing (Russian)
how_to_1: Stand with feet shoulder-width, kettlebell slightly in front; hinge and grip it with both hands.
how_to_2: Hike it back between your legs, then snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
how_to_3: Let it fall back, hinging again, and repeat.
watch_for: Squatting instead of hinging. Lifting with the arms. Leaning back at the top.

name: American Kettlebell Swing
how_to_1: Set up as for a Russian swing.
how_to_2: Drive the hips hard and guide the bell all the way overhead.
how_to_3: Finish with the bell upside-down over your head, then swing back down.
watch_for: Arching the lower back. Bending the elbows overhead. Pulling with the arms.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Swing
how_to_1: Grip the bell in one hand, other arm free.
how_to_2: Hike and snap the hips to swing to chest height.
how_to_3: Let it fall back and repeat, then switch arms.
watch_for: Twisting with the bell. Shoulder pulling forward. Squatting.

name: Hand-to-Hand Swing
how_to_1: Start a one-arm swing.
how_to_2: At the top float, let go and catch with the other hand.
watch_for: Dropping the bell. Swinging too low to switch. Twisting.

name: Double Kettlebell Swing
how_to_1: Hold a kettlebell in each hand, wide stance.
how_to_2: Hike both back and drive the hips forward.
how_to_3: Swing to chest height and repeat.
watch_for: Bells banging the legs. Stance too narrow. Rounding.

name: Dead-Stop Swing
how_to_1: Place the bell in front of you on the floor.
how_to_2: Hike it back and do one powerful swing.
how_to_3: Park it back on the floor and reset each rep.
watch_for: Not resetting. Rounding. Lifting with arms.

name: Kettlebell Clean
how_to_1: Swing the bell back between your legs.
how_to_2: Drive the hips and keep the bell close, letting it rotate around your wrist.
how_to_3: Catch it in the rack position at your chest, then return.
watch_for: Bell flipping and hitting the forearm. Arm swinging away. Curling.

name: Double Kettlebell Clean
how_to_1: Hold two bells, wide stance.
how_to_2: Hike and drive, keeping the bells close.
how_to_3: Catch both in the rack position.
watch_for: Bells banging the forearms. Rounding. Narrow stance.

name: Kettlebell Dead Clean
how_to_1: Start with the bell on the floor between your feet.
how_to_2: Pull it up explosively from the floor.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
how_to_1: Swing the bell back between your legs.
how_to_2: Drive the hips and pull it up close to your body.
how_to_3: Punch your hand through as it flips over and lock out overhead.
watch_for: Bell crashing on the wrist. Pressing out. Arching.

name: Double Kettlebell Snatch
how_to_1: Hold two bells, wide stance.
how_to_2: Hike and drive both up close to the body.

name: Kettlebell High Pull
how_to_1: Swing the bell back.
how_to_2: Drive the hips and pull the bell to chest height, elbow high.
watch_for: Pulling with arm too early. Twisting. Squatting.

name: Kettlebell Long Cycle (Clean & Jerk)
how_to_1: Clean the bell(s) to the rack.
how_to_2: Jerk overhead to lockout.
how_to_3: Drop back to the rack, then to the swing, and repeat.
watch_for: Pressing instead of jerking. Poor rack rest. Rounding.

name: Kettlebell Jerk
how_to_1: Hold the bell in the rack.
how_to_2: Dip, drive, then dip again under the bell as you lock out.
how_to_3: Stand tall, then lower to the rack.
watch_for: Pressing out. Leaning back. Soft lockout.

name: Double Kettlebell Jerk

how_to_2: Dip and drive, re-dip under them.

name: Kettlebell Push Press

how_to_2: Dip and drive with the legs.
how_to_3: Press to lockout overhead and lower.

how_to_2: At the top, catch the bell in a goblet hold.
how_to_3: Squat down, stand and return to swinging.
watch_for: Bell hitting the chest. Rounding. Rushing.

name: Kettlebell Bottoms-Up Clean

how_to_2: Drive the hips and squeeze hard to catch it upside-down at shoulder height.
watch_for: Loose grip. Bell tipping. Wrist bending.

name: Kettlebell Hike Pass

how_to_2: Hike it back between your legs like a football.

watch_for: Plates slipping onto feet. Shrugging. Leaning.

name: Plate Good Morning

how_to_2: Hinge forward.

how_to_2: Circle it around your body.

watch_for: Legs dropping too far. Arching. Rushing.

how_to_2: Shift into one leg and squat.

name: Standard Push-Up
tags: Chest · Triceps · Front delts · Core · Bodyweight
how_to_1: Start in a high plank, hands just wider than shoulders, body in a straight line.
how_to_2: Lower your chest to just above the floor, elbows about 45° from the body.
how_to_3: Push back up to straight arms.
watch_for: Hips sagging or piking. Elbows flaring to 90°. Head dropping.

name: Wide-Grip Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank with hands well wider than shoulders.
how_to_2: Lower your chest.

name: Diamond Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank with hands together forming a diamond under your chest.
how_to_2: Lower your chest to your hands.

name: Close-Grip (Triceps) Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank with hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked.
how_to_2: Lower, keeping elbows by your ribs.

name: Incline Push-Up
how_to_1: Place hands on a bench or box.
how_to_2: Lower your chest to the edge.

name: Decline Push-Up
tags: Upper chest · Front delts · Triceps · Bodyweight
how_to_1: Place feet on a bench, hands on floor.
how_to_2: Lower your chest.

name: Knee Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank on your knees with body straight from knees to head.
how_to_2: Lower your chest.
watch_for: Bending at the hips. Flaring. Partial range.

name: Wall Push-Up
how_to_1: Stand facing a wall, hands on it at shoulder height.
how_to_2: Bend elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.

name: Pike Push-Up
tags: Front delts · Side delts · Triceps · Bodyweight
how_to_1: Get into a downward-dog shape, hips high.
how_to_2: Bend elbows to lower your head toward the floor.
watch_for: Hips dropping. Elbows flaring. Head going too far forward.

name: Elevated Pike Push-Up
how_to_1: Pike position with feet on a box.
how_to_2: Lower your head toward the floor.

name: Handstand Push-Up (Wall)
how_to_1: Kick up into a handstand against a wall, hands shoulder-width.
how_to_2: Lower your head to the floor (or a pad).
how_to_3: Press back up to straight arms.
watch_for: Arching the back. Elbows flaring. Crashing the head down.

name: Freestanding Handstand Push-Up
tags: Front delts · Triceps · Core · Balance · Bodyweight
how_to_1: Hold a freestanding handstand.
how_to_2: Lower your head toward the floor under control.

name: Deficit Handstand Push-Up
how_to_1: Place hands on plates or parallettes against a wall.
how_to_2: Lower below hand level.
watch_for: Crashing. Arching. Too deep too soon.

name: Archer Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank with hands very wide.
how_to_2: Lower toward one hand while the other arm straightens.
watch_for: Sagging. Rotating. Bending the straight arm.

name: One-Arm Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank with feet wide, one hand under your chest.
how_to_2: Lower with one arm.

name: Clap Push-Up
how_to_1: Start in a high plank.
how_to_2: Push up explosively so hands leave the floor and clap.
watch_for: Landing on locked arms. Sagging. Face-planting.

name: Superman Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank position.
how_to_2: Push explosively so hands and feet leave the floor, arms reaching forward.
watch_for: Poor landing. Sagging. Advanced — build up first.

name: Spiderman Push-Up
how_to_1: High plank.
how_to_2: Lower while bringing one knee to the same elbow.

name: Hindu Push-Up
how_to_1: Start in downward dog.
how_to_2: Dive your chest down and forward through to cobra.
how_to_3: Push hips back to downward dog.

name: Dive Bomber Push-Up
how_to_1: Start in downward dog.
how_to_2: Swoop forward through to upward dog.

name: T Push-Up
how_to_1: High plank.
how_to_2: Do a push-up, then rotate into a side plank with arm up.

name: Staggered Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank with one hand forward and one back.
how_to_2: Lower and push up.

name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank with hands by your waist, fingers turned out, leaning forward.
how_to_2: Lower while keeping the lean.
watch_for: Losing the lean. Sagging. Wrist pain.

name: Planche Push-Up
tags: Front delts · Chest · Triceps · Core · Bodyweight
how_to_1: Hold a planche (feet off floor).
how_to_2: Lower by bending the elbows.
watch_for: Advanced — use progressions. Sagging. Bent arms at top.

name: Typewriter Push-Up
how_to_1: Wide plank.
how_to_2: Lower, then shift chest side to side near the floor.

name: Knuckle Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank on your knuckles.
how_to_2: Lower.
watch_for: Wrists bending. Hard surface pain. Sagging.

name: Fingertip Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank on your fingertips.
how_to_2: Lower.
watch_for: Fingers collapsing. Too many reps. Sagging.

name: Plyometric Push-Up
how_to_1: High plank.
how_to_2: Push explosively so hands leave the floor.
watch_for: Locked elbows on landing. Sagging. Rushing.

name: Hand-Release Push-Up
how_to_1: Lower your chest to the floor.
how_to_2: Lift your hands briefly off the floor.
watch_for: Sagging on the way up. Hips first. Rushing.

name: Shoulder Tap Push-Up
how_to_1: Do a push-up.
how_to_2: At the top, tap one shoulder with the opposite hand.

name: Tiger Bend Push-Up
how_to_1: Start in a forearm plank.
how_to_2: Push up onto your hands.

name: Maltese Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank with hands far wide and back by the hips.
how_to_2: Lower under control.

name: Aztec Push-Up
how_to_1: Push up explosively.
how_to_2: Pike your body and touch your toes in the air.

name: Parallel Bar Dip
tags: Triceps · Chest · Front delts · Dip bars
how_to_1: Support yourself on parallel bars with arms straight.
how_to_2: Lower until shoulders are just below elbows.
watch_for: Shoulders rolling forward. Going too deep. Swinging.

name: Bench Dip
how_to_1: Hands on a bench behind you, legs out.
how_to_2: Bend elbows to lower your hips.
watch_for: Shoulders rolling forward. Going too deep. Elbows flaring.

name: Straight Bar Dip
how_to_1: Support yourself on a straight bar.
how_to_2: Lower until the bar is at your chest.

name: Korean Dip
tags: Triceps · Front delts · Chest · Dip bars
how_to_1: Support on a bar with it behind your back.
how_to_2: Lower down.
watch_for: Advanced — shoulder mobility needed. Rushing. Too deep.

name: Ring Dip
how_to_1: Support on rings with arms straight, rings turned out.
how_to_2: Lower to below shoulder height.

name: Russian Dip
how_to_1: Start in a dip at the bottom.
how_to_2: Lower onto your forearms on the bars.
how_to_3: Push back to hands and up.

name: Impossible Dip
how_to_1: Support on bars.
how_to_2: Lower onto your forearms keeping body upright.
how_to_3: Push back up from the forearms.

name: Sphinx Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank on your forearms.
how_to_2: Press the forearms into the floor to lift up onto hands.

name: Pull-Up (Overhand)
tags: Lats · Upper back · Biceps · Pull-up bar
how_to_1: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders.
how_to_2: Pull your chest up until your chin clears the bar.
watch_for: Swinging. Half reps. Shrugging at the top.

name: Chin-Up (Underhand)
how_to_1: Hang with an underhand grip, shoulder-width.
how_to_2: Pull until your chin clears the bar.
watch_for: Swinging. Half reps. Craning the neck.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang with palms facing each other.
how_to_2: Pull your chin over the handles.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang with a very wide overhand grip.
how_to_2: Pull up.

name: Close-Grip Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang with hands close.
how_to_2: Pull up.

name: Commando Pull-Up
how_to_1: Grip the bar with hands staggered, side-on.
how_to_2: Pull your head up to one side of the bar.

name: Archer Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang with a wide grip.
how_to_2: Pull toward one hand while the other arm straightens.
watch_for: Bending the straight arm. Swinging. Rushing.

name: Typewriter Pull-Up
how_to_1: Pull up with a wide grip.
how_to_2: At the top, shift side to side along the bar.

name: One-Arm Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang from one arm.
how_to_2: Pull up until your chin clears the bar.

name: One-Arm Chin-Up
how_to_1: Hang from one arm with underhand grip.
how_to_2: Pull up.

name: L-Sit Pull-Up
tags: Lats · Abs · Hip flexors · Pull-up bar
how_to_1: Hang and raise your legs straight to an L.
how_to_2: Pull up keeping the L.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
tags: Lats · Upper back · Biceps · Pull-up bar
how_to_1: Attach weight with a dip belt or vest.
how_to_2: Do a strict pull-up.

name: Negative (Eccentric) Pull-Up
how_to_1: Jump or step up so your chin is over the bar.
how_to_2: Lower yourself as slowly as possible.
watch_for: Dropping fast. Shrugging. Too many reps.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang with straight arms.
how_to_2: Pull your shoulder blades down, lifting slightly without bending the elbows.

name: Australian Pull-Up (Inverted Row)
tags: Upper back · Lats · Biceps · Pull-up bar
how_to_1: Hang under a low bar with a straight body, heels on the floor.
how_to_2: Pull your chest to the bar.
watch_for: Sagging hips. Chin forward. Half reps.

name: Feet-Elevated Inverted Row
how_to_1: Set up an inverted row with feet on a box.
how_to_2: Pull chest to bar.

name: Towel Pull-Up
how_to_1: Drape towels over the bar and grip them.
how_to_2: Pull up.

name: Kipping Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang and swing between arch and hollow positions.
how_to_2: Use the hip drive to pull your chin over the bar.
how_to_3: Push away and repeat the swing.
watch_for: No strict strength base. Shoulder strain. Losing rhythm.

name: Butterfly Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang from the bar.
how_to_2: Move in a circular kipping cycle, pulling up in each loop.
watch_for: Shoulder strain. Poor timing. No strict base.

name: Chest-to-Bar Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang from the bar.
how_to_2: Pull (strict or kipping) until your chest touches the bar.
watch_for: Only chin clearing. Swinging wildly. Shoulder strain.

name: Muscle-Up (Bar)
tags: Lats · Triceps · Chest · Power · Pull-up bar
how_to_1: Hang from the bar with a slightly false or regular grip.
how_to_2: Pull explosively high, then lean over and push up to the top of the bar.
watch_for: Chicken-winging one arm. Not enough pull height. Shoulder strain.

name: Strict Bar Muscle-Up
how_to_1: Hang with a false grip.
how_to_2: Pull very high without kipping.

name: Behind-the-Neck Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang with a wide grip.
how_to_2: Pull up so the bar goes behind your head.
watch_for: Poor shoulder mobility. Head forward. Too fast.

name: Clapping Pull-Up
how_to_1: Do an explosive pull-up.
how_to_2: Let go and clap at the top.

name: Explosive (High) Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang from the bar.
how_to_2: Pull as fast as possible to chest or waist height.

name: Dead Hang
how_to_1: Grip a bar and hang with straight arms.
how_to_2: Relax your shoulders and breathe.

name: Active Hang
how_to_1: Hang from a bar.
how_to_2: Pull shoulders down and away from ears.

name: One-Arm Dead Hang
how_to_1: Hang from one arm.
how_to_2: Keep the shoulder engaged.
watch_for: Fully relaxed shoulder. Swinging. Too long too soon.

name: Front Lever
how_to_1: Hang from a bar.
how_to_2: Lift your body until it is horizontal and face-up, arms straight.

name: Tuck Front Lever
how_to_1: Hang and tuck your knees to your chest.
how_to_2: Lift your back horizontal.
watch_for: Rounded back. Bent arms. Hips high.

name: Advanced Tuck Front Lever
how_to_1: Hang and hold a tuck with a flat back.
how_to_2: Hold horizontal.
watch_for: Rounded back. Bent arms. Hips dropping.

name: Straddle Front Lever
how_to_1: Hang and lift into a front lever with legs apart.
how_to_2: Keep your body horizontal.

name: Front Lever Raise
how_to_1: Hang from the bar.
how_to_2: Raise your straight body to horizontal.

name: Front Lever Row
how_to_1: Hold a front lever (or tuck).
how_to_2: Row your chest to the bar.
watch_for: Losing the lever. Hips dropping. Rushing.

name: Back Lever
tags: Lats · Chest · Biceps · Core · Pull-up bar
how_to_1: Hang and rotate backward.
how_to_2: Hold your body horizontal, face-down.

name: Tuck Back Lever
how_to_1: Hang, rotate back and tuck.
how_to_2: Hold your back horizontal.

name: Skin the Cat
how_to_1: Hang from a bar or rings.
how_to_2: Tuck and rotate your legs through your arms behind you.
watch_for: Going too far. Shoulder pain. Rushing.

name: Bodyweight Row (Table/Door)
how_to_1: Lie under a sturdy table or use a door strap.
how_to_2: Pull your chest up.

name: Air Squat (Bodyweight Squat)
how_to_1: Stand with feet shoulder-width, arms in front.
how_to_2: Squat down below parallel with chest up.

name: Jump Squat

how_to_1: Hold the landmine bar end overhead.
how_to_2: Rotate it in an arc to one hip.
watch_for: Arms bending. Excessive hip spin. Rushing.

name: Suitcase Carry
how_to_1: Hold a weight in one hand.
how_to_2: Walk without leaning.

name: Seated Oblique Twist
how_to_1: Sit with knees bent.
how_to_2: Rotate side to side.

name: Superman
tags: Lower back · Glutes · Upper back · Bodyweight
how_to_1: Lie face down, arms overhead.
how_to_2: Lift arms, chest and legs off the floor.
watch_for: Over-arching the neck. Bending knees. Rushing.

name: Back Extension (Floor)
how_to_1: Lie face down, hands by your ears.
how_to_2: Lift your chest off the floor.

name: Swimmer (Prone Flutter)
how_to_1: Lie face down, arms and legs extended.
how_to_2: Lift and flutter opposite arms and legs.

name: Prone Y-T-W Raise
muscles_worked: Rear delts · Upper back · Rotator cuff
tags: Rear delts · Upper back · Rotator cuff · Bodyweight
how_to_1: Lie face down.
how_to_2: Lift arms in a Y, then T, then W shape.

name: Reverse Hyperextension (Bench)
how_to_1: Lie face down on a high bench, hips at the edge.
how_to_2: Raise legs to straight.

name: Good Morning (Bodyweight)
how_to_1: Hands behind head.
how_to_2: Hinge forward with a flat back.

name: Cobra (Prone Press-Up)
how_to_1: Lie face down, hands under shoulders.
how_to_2: Press up lifting your chest, hips on the floor.

name: Bridge Hold
how_to_1: Lift into a glute bridge.
how_to_2: Hold the top.

name: Single-Leg Bridge Hold
how_to_1: Single-leg glute bridge.
how_to_2: Hold the top.

name: Quadruped Hip Extension
how_to_1: On all fours.
how_to_2: Extend one leg straight back.

name: Box Jump
how_to_1: Stand facing a sturdy box, feet hip-width.
how_to_2: Swing your arms and jump onto the box, landing softly in a squat.
watch_for: Jumping down (hard on Achilles). Landing with knees caving. Box too high.

name: Seated Box Jump
how_to_1: Sit on a bench facing a box.
how_to_2: Jump from seated onto the box.
watch_for: Rocking for momentum. Stiff landing. Box too high.

name: Depth Jump
how_to_1: Step off a low box.
how_to_2: Land and immediately jump as high as you can.
watch_for: Box too high. Long ground contact. Knees caving.

name: Drop Jump
how_to_1: Step off a box.
how_to_2: Land and absorb softly.
watch_for: Stiff landing. Knees caving. Box too high.

name: Broad Jump (Standing Long Jump)
how_to_1: Stand with feet hip-width.
how_to_2: Swing your arms and jump forward as far as possible.
watch_for: Landing stiff-legged. Knees caving. Falling backward.

name: Vertical Jump
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Dip and jump as high as possible.
watch_for: Stiff landing. Knees caving. Shallow dip.

name: Tuck Jump
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Jump and pull your knees to your chest.

name: Squat Jump
how_to_1: Squat down.
how_to_2: Jump explosively.

name: Split Squat Jump
how_to_1: Start in a split squat.
how_to_2: Jump straight up.

name: Jumping Lunge (Scissor Jump)
how_to_1: Lunge position.
how_to_2: Jump and switch legs.
watch_for: Stiff landing. Knee caving. Short stance.

name: Lateral Box Jump
tags: Quads · Glute medius · Power · Plyo box
how_to_1: Stand side-on to a box.
how_to_2: Jump sideways onto it.
watch_for: Box too high. Knee caving. Stiff landing.

name: Single-Leg Box Jump
how_to_1: Stand on one leg facing a low box.
how_to_2: Jump onto the box with one leg.
watch_for: Box too high. Knee caving. Losing balance.

name: Single-Leg Hop
how_to_1: Stand on one leg.
how_to_2: Hop forward.
how_to_3: Land softly on the same leg.
watch_for: Knee caving. Stiff landing. Losing balance.

name: Lateral Hop
how_to_1: Stand on one or both feet.
how_to_2: Hop side to side over a line.

name: Lateral Bound (Skater Jump)
how_to_1: Stand on one leg.
how_to_2: Bound sideways onto the other leg.
how_to_3: Stick the landing and bound back.
watch_for: Knee caving. Stiff landing. Short bounds.

name: Bounding
how_to_1: Run with exaggerated long, springy strides.
how_to_2: Drive the knee up and push off powerfully.
watch_for: Short strides. Heavy landings. Leaning back.

name: Pogo Jumps
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Bounce on the balls of your feet with stiff ankles.
watch_for: Bending knees too much. Heels touching. Heavy landings.

name: Ankle Hops
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Hop using only your ankles.
watch_for: Bending knees. Heels landing. Slow contacts.

name: Star Jump
how_to_1: Squat slightly.
how_to_2: Jump and spread arms and legs into a star.

name: Frog Jump
how_to_1: Deep squat, hands near floor.
how_to_2: Jump forward explosively.

name: Hurdle Hop
how_to_1: Line up small hurdles.
how_to_2: Jump over each with both feet.
watch_for: Hitting hurdles. Stiff landing. Long contacts.

name: Lateral Hurdle Hop
how_to_1: Stand beside a hurdle.
how_to_2: Jump sideways over it.
watch_for: Knee caving. Hitting hurdle. Stiff landing.

name: Knee Tuck Jump
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Jump and bring knees up.

name: Burpee Box Jump-Over
how_to_1: Do a burpee facing a box.
how_to_2: Jump onto or over the box.
watch_for: Jumping down. Sloppy burpee. Box too high.

name: Box Jump Over
how_to_1: Face a box.
how_to_2: Jump on and step or jump off the other side.
watch_for: Jumping down hard. Rushing. Box too high.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat Jump
how_to_1: Rear foot on a bench.
how_to_2: Jump up off the front leg.
watch_for: Knee caving. Stiff landing. Losing balance.

name: Hexagon Drill
how_to_1: Mark a hexagon on the floor.
how_to_2: Jump in and out of each side in order.
watch_for: Heavy landings. Turning the body. Rushing.

name: Triple Jump
how_to_1: Run in.
how_to_2: Hop, step and jump in sequence.
how_to_3: Land in the pit or softly.
watch_for: Poor rhythm. Heavy landings. Leaning back.

name: Continuous Broad Jump
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Broad jump, land and immediately jump again.

name: Single-Leg Broad Jump
how_to_1: Stand on one leg.
how_to_2: Jump forward and land on the same leg.
watch_for: Knee caving. Losing balance. Stiff landing.

name: Depth Jump to Broad Jump
how_to_1: Step off a box.
how_to_2: Land and immediately broad jump.
watch_for: Box too high. Long contact. Knees caving.

name: Pike Jump
how_to_1: Jump up.
how_to_2: Lift straight legs in front, reaching to touch toes.

name: Straddle Jump
how_to_1: Jump up.
how_to_2: Spread legs wide in the air.

name: 180-Degree Jump
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Jump and turn halfway around.
watch_for: Stiff landing. Knee caving. Losing balance.

name: 360-Degree Jump
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Jump and spin all the way around.

name: Speed Skater
how_to_1: Stand on one leg.
how_to_2: Leap sideways to the other leg, swinging arms.
watch_for: Knee caving. Short leaps. Heavy landings.

name: Ice Skater Hops
how_to_1: Stand on one leg.
how_to_2: Hop sideways to the other leg.

name: Kneeling Jump
how_to_1: Kneel on a mat.
how_to_2: Swing your arms and jump up to your feet.

name: Trap Bar Jump
how_to_1: Hold a light trap bar.
how_to_2: Dip and jump.

name: Weighted Squat Jump
how_to_1: Hold light dumbbells or a vest.
how_to_2: Squat and jump.
watch_for: Too heavy. Stiff landing. Knees caving.

name: Clap Push-Up
how_to_1: Start in a high plank.
how_to_2: Push up explosively so hands leave the floor and clap.
watch_for: Landing on locked arms. Sagging. Face-planting.

name: Plyo Push-Up (Box)
how_to_1: Hands on the floor between two boxes.
how_to_2: Push up explosively onto the boxes.
watch_for: Locked elbows on landing. Sagging. Boxes too high.

name: Depth Push-Up
how_to_1: Hands on two low boxes.
how_to_2: Drop down to the floor and immediately push back up.

name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
how_to_1: Hold a ball at your chest.
how_to_2: Push it explosively forward to a partner or wall.
watch_for: Throwing with arms only. Rounding. Weak follow-through.

name: Medicine Ball Overhead Throw
how_to_1: Hold a ball overhead.
how_to_2: Throw it forward forcefully.
watch_for: Arching. Throwing with arms only. Losing grip.

name: Plyometric Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang from a bar.
how_to_2: Pull explosively so your hands can briefly leave the bar.

name: Superman Push-Up
how_to_1: Plank position.
how_to_2: Push explosively so hands and feet leave the floor, arms reaching forward.
watch_for: Poor landing. Sagging. Advanced — build up first.

name: Explosive Incline Push-Up
how_to_1: Hands on a bench.
how_to_2: Push up explosively so hands leave the bench.

name: Drop Push-Up
how_to_1: Kneel tall.
how_to_2: Fall forward and catch in a push-up.

name: Push-Up Hand Hop (Lateral)
how_to_1: High plank.
how_to_2: Hop both hands to one side.

name: Burpee
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Squat, put hands down, jump feet back to plank, lower chest to floor.
how_to_3: Push up, jump feet in and jump up with a clap overhead.
watch_for: Sagging in plank. Landing stiff. Not standing fully.

name: Burpee Broad Jump
how_to_1: Do a burpee.
how_to_2: Instead of a vertical jump, broad jump forward.

name: Burpee Tuck Jump
how_to_1: Do a burpee.
how_to_2: Finish with a tuck jump.

name: Burpee Pull-Up
how_to_1: Do a burpee under a bar.
how_to_2: Jump and grab the bar.
how_to_3: Do a pull-up and drop down.
watch_for: Missing the bar. Sloppy burpee. Rushing.

name: Bar-Facing Burpee
how_to_1: Face a barbell on the floor.
how_to_2: Do a burpee facing the bar.
how_to_3: Jump over it with both feet and repeat.
watch_for: Hitting the bar. Sloppy burpee. Not two-foot takeoff.

name: Lateral Burpee Over Bar
how_to_1: Stand side-on to a bar.
how_to_2: Do a burpee beside the bar.

name: Half Burpee (Sprawl)
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Drop hands down and jump feet back.

name: Navy Seal Burpee
how_to_1: Do a burpee.
how_to_2: Add 3 push-ups and 3 alternating mountain climbers.

name: Devil Press
how_to_1: Place dumbbells on the floor; do a burpee with hands on them.
how_to_2: Jump feet in and swing the dumbbells from the floor.
how_to_3: Swing them to overhead in one move.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Arms pressing. Sloppy burpee.

name: Squat Thrust
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Squat, put hands down, jump feet back.

name: Sprawl
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Shoot legs back, dropping hips to the floor.

name: Up-Downs
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Drop to the floor chest down.

name: Jack Knife Jump
how_to_1: Jump up.
how_to_2: Pike legs forward and reach for toes.

name: Kipping Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang and swing between arch and hollow positions.
how_to_2: Use the hip drive to pull your chin over the bar.
how_to_3: Push away and repeat the swing.
watch_for: No strict strength base. Shoulder strain. Losing rhythm.

name: Butterfly Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang from the bar.
how_to_2: Move in a circular kipping cycle, pulling up in each loop.
watch_for: Shoulder strain. Poor timing. No strict base.

name: Chest-to-Bar Pull-Up
how_to_1: Hang from the bar.
how_to_2: Pull (strict or kipping) until your chest touches the bar.
watch_for: Only chin clearing. Swinging wildly. Shoulder strain.

name: Bar Muscle-Up
tags: Lats · Triceps · Chest · Power · Pull-up bar
how_to_1: Hang from the bar and build a kip swing.
how_to_2: Drive hips to the bar while pulling hard, then roll over the bar.
how_to_3: Press to straight arms on top, then drop down.
watch_for: Chicken-winging one arm. Not getting hips to the bar. Shoulder strain.

name: Ring Muscle-Up
tags: Lats · Triceps · Chest · Power · Gymnastic rings
how_to_1: Hang from rings with a false grip and build a kip.
how_to_2: Pull the rings to your chest and quickly turn over into a dip.
how_to_3: Press out to straight arms on top.
watch_for: Losing the false grip. Rings too wide. Slow transition.

name: Strict Ring Muscle-Up
how_to_1: Hang from rings with a false grip.
how_to_2: Pull strictly to the chest and transition.

name: Toes-to-Bar
tags: Abs · Hip flexors · Lats · Pull-up bar
how_to_1: Hang from a bar.
how_to_2: Raise your feet to touch the bar (strict or with a kip).
watch_for: Swinging wildly. Bending knees a lot. Not touching bar.

name: Knees-to-Elbows
how_to_1: Hang from a bar.
how_to_2: Raise your knees to touch your elbows.

name: Handstand Push-Up (Kipping)
how_to_1: Kick up to a wall handstand.
how_to_2: Lower your head to the mat, pull knees down, then kick legs up while pressing.
watch_for: Crashing on the head. Arching. No strict base.

name: Strict Handstand Push-Up
how_to_1: Kick up to a wall handstand.
how_to_2: Lower your head to the mat under control.

name: Deficit HSPU
how_to_1: Hands on plates or parallettes, wall handstand.
how_to_2: Lower below hand level.

name: Handstand Walk
how_to_1: Kick into a handstand.
how_to_2: Walk forward on your hands in small steps.
watch_for: Over-arching. Big steps. Looking at hands.

name: Wall Walk
how_to_1: Start in a plank with feet against a wall.
how_to_2: Walk your feet up the wall and hands toward it.

name: Ring Dip
how_to_1: Support on rings with arms straight, rings turned out.
how_to_2: Lower to below shoulder height.

name: Kipping Ring Dip
how_to_1: Support on rings.
how_to_2: Lower into a dip and use a hip pop to help press up.

name: Rope Climb (Legs)
how_to_1: Grab the rope high and wrap it around one leg, clamping with feet.
how_to_2: Stand up on the foot lock and reach higher.
how_to_3: Repeat to the top, then climb down hand under hand.
watch_for: Sliding down (rope burn). No foot lock. Jumping off from height.

name: Legless Rope Climb
how_to_1: Grab the rope with legs held off it.
how_to_2: Pull hand over hand using only your arms.

name: Pegboard Climb
how_to_1: Hang from pegs in the board.
how_to_2: Move one peg up at a time.
how_to_3: Climb to the top and back down.

name: GHD Sit-Up
how_to_1: Sit on the GHD with feet locked, hips on the pad.
how_to_2: Lean back until the torso is near parallel or below.
how_to_3: Snap your knees and sit up to touch the footplate.
watch_for: Going too far too soon. Neck pulling. Not building volume gradually.

name: GHD Back Extension
how_to_1: Set the GHD so hips are past the pad, ankles locked.
how_to_2: Lower your torso down with a flat back.

name: GHD Hip Extension
how_to_1: Set the GHD with hips on the pad.
how_to_2: Hinge down.
how_to_3: Lift with glutes and hamstrings to horizontal.

name: Pistols
how_to_1: Stand on one leg, other leg straight forward.
how_to_2: Squat to full depth on one leg.

name: L-Sit Hold
how_to_1: Support on parallettes or rings.
how_to_2: Lift straight legs to horizontal.

name: Hollow Rock
how_to_1: Hold a hollow body position.
how_to_2: Rock back and forth keeping the shape.
how_to_3: Keep the lower back pressed down.
watch_for: Losing the hollow shape. Bending knees. Neck strain.

name: Bar-Facing Burpee
how_to_1: Face a barbell on the floor.
how_to_2: Do a burpee facing the bar.
how_to_3: Jump over it with both feet and repeat.
watch_for: Hitting the bar. Sloppy burpee. Not two-foot takeoff.

name: Burpee Over Rower
how_to_1: Stand beside a rower.
how_to_2: Do a burpee.
how_to_3: Jump over the rower and repeat.
watch_for: Hitting the rower. Sloppy burpee. Rushing.

name: Kipping Swing (Kip Swing)
how_to_1: Hang from a bar.
how_to_2: Push your chest through to an arch, then pull into a hollow.
watch_for: Bending arms. Over-arching. Swinging from the legs only.

name: Strict Toes-to-Bar
tags: Abs · Hip flexors · Lats · Pull-up bar
how_to_1: Hang without swinging.
how_to_2: Lift straight legs to touch the bar.

name: Ring Row
tags: Upper back · Lats · Biceps · Gymnastic rings
how_to_1: Hold the rings and lean back, body straight.
how_to_2: Pull your chest to the rings.

name: Row (Concept2 Erg)
how_to_1: Strap in, grab the handle, knees bent.
how_to_2: Drive with legs, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your lower ribs.
how_to_3: Return arms, then body, then knees — and repeat.
watch_for: Pulling with arms first. Rounding the back. Shins too vertical at the catch.

name: Assault / Echo Bike
how_to_1: Sit and adjust the seat so the knee is slightly bent at the bottom.
how_to_2: Push and pull the handles while pedalling.
how_to_3: Keep a steady or sprint pace as set.
watch_for: Seat set too low. Using only the legs. Hunching forward.

name: Ski Erg
how_to_1: Stand facing the SkiErg holding both handles overhead.
how_to_2: Pull down by hinging at the hips and driving arms to your thighs.
how_to_3: Return to tall standing and repeat.
watch_for: Using only arms. Squatting too deep. Rounding.

name: Run (400 m / 800 m / 1 mile)
how_to_1: Start at a steady pace.
how_to_2: Run the set distance with relaxed shoulders.
watch_for: Starting too fast. Overstriding. Tense shoulders.

name: Double-Unders
how_to_1: Jump rope with a slightly higher bounce.
how_to_2: Spin the rope twice under your feet each jump.
watch_for: Piking or kicking the legs. Arms swinging wide. Jumping too high.

name: Single-Unders
how_to_1: Hold the rope handles at hip height.
how_to_2: Jump slightly as the rope passes once.
watch_for: Jumping too high. Arms wide. Landing on heels.

name: Triple-Unders
how_to_1: Jump higher with fast wrists.
how_to_2: Spin the rope three times per jump.
watch_for: Piking. Arms wide. Advanced — master doubles first.

name: Crossovers (Jump Rope)
how_to_1: Jump rope.
how_to_2: Cross your arms in front as the rope comes over.
watch_for: Arms not crossing enough. Tripping. Rushing.

name: BikeErg
how_to_1: Set seat height and pedal.
how_to_2: Keep a steady cadence at the set damper.
how_to_3: Ride the set distance or time.

name: Shuttle Run
how_to_1: Mark two lines a set distance apart.
how_to_2: Sprint to one line, touch it, turn and sprint back.
watch_for: Rounding the turn. Not touching the line. Slowing down early.

name: Thruster
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Front squat to depth.
how_to_3: Drive up and press the bar overhead in one move.
watch_for: Pressing before standing. Elbows dropping. Bar forward.

name: Wall Ball Shot
tags: Quads · Glutes · Shoulders · Conditioning · Medicine ball
how_to_1: Hold a medicine ball at your chest facing a wall target.
how_to_2: Squat below parallel.
how_to_3: Drive up and throw the ball to the target; catch and go into the next squat.
watch_for: Shallow squat. Throwing with arms only. Missing the target.

name: Cluster (Squat Clean Thruster)
how_to_1: Stand over the bar.
how_to_2: Squat clean into a full front squat.
how_to_3: Drive up straight into a thruster overhead.
watch_for: Pausing at the bottom. Elbows low. Pressing early.

name: Sumo Deadlift High Pull (SDHP)
how_to_1: Take a wide stance with a narrow grip on the bar or kettlebell.
how_to_2: Deadlift and extend hips explosively.
how_to_3: Pull the bar to chin height with elbows high, then lower.
watch_for: Pulling with arms early. Rounding. Bar swinging away.

name: Shoulder-to-Overhead
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Press, push press or jerk it overhead.
how_to_3: Lock out and return to the shoulders.
watch_for: Not locking out. Leaning back. Bar forward.

name: Ground-to-Overhead
how_to_1: Stand over the bar.
how_to_2: Move it from floor to overhead by any method.
how_to_3: Lock out, then return it to the floor.
watch_for: Rounding. Not locking out. Pressing from bad positions.

name: Clean and Jerk
how_to_1: Clean the bar to the front rack.
how_to_2: Stand and reset.
watch_for: Poor rack. Rushing the jerk. Pressing out.

name: Snatch
how_to_1: Start with a wide grip, bar over mid-foot.
how_to_2: Pull, extend and drop under the bar.
how_to_3: Catch overhead (power or squat) and stand.
watch_for: Bar swinging away. Pressing out. Soft elbows.

name: Power Clean
how_to_1: Set up as for the clean.
how_to_2: Extend explosively and pull under.
how_to_3: Catch in a quarter squat on the shoulders, elbows high.
watch_for: Catching on the hands with low elbows. Jumping forward. Arms early.

name: Hang Power Snatch
how_to_1: Hold the bar at the hang with a snatch grip.
how_to_2: Dip and drive explosively through the hips.
how_to_3: Catch overhead above parallel with locked arms.
watch_for: Using the arms to lift. Bar crashing. Feet landing too wide.

name: Overhead Squat
how_to_1: Hold the bar overhead with a wide grip.
how_to_2: Squat down keeping the bar over mid-foot.
watch_for: Bar drifting forward. Elbows bending. Heels lifting.

name: Front Squat
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack, elbows high.
how_to_2: Squat down, torso upright.

name: Deadlift
tags: Hamstrings · Glutes · Lower back · Grip · Barbell
how_to_1: Stand with the bar over mid-foot.
how_to_2: Hinge, grip and stand up with a flat back.
watch_for: Rounding. Bar drifting. Jerking off the floor.

name: Push Press
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Dip and drive.

name: Push Jerk
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Dip, drive, and re-dip under the bar.
watch_for: Pressing out. Forward dip. Soft elbows.

name: Dumbbell Snatch
how_to_1: Stand over one dumbbell.
how_to_2: Pull it explosively from the floor.

name: Devil Press
how_to_1: Place dumbbells on the floor; do a burpee with hands on them.
how_to_2: Jump feet in and swing the dumbbells from the floor.
how_to_3: Swing them to overhead in one move.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Arms pressing. Sloppy burpee.

name: Dumbbell Box Step-Over
how_to_1: Hold dumbbells facing a box.
how_to_2: Step up onto it fully.
watch_for: Jumping down. Knee caving. Pushing off back foot.

name: Kettlebell Swing (American)
how_to_1: Hike the bell back.
how_to_2: Snap hips and guide the bell overhead.

name: Overhead Walking Lunge
how_to_1: Lock a weight overhead.
how_to_2: Walk forward in lunges.

name: Front-Rack Lunge
how_to_1: Hold the bar in the front rack.
how_to_2: Step into a lunge keeping elbows up.
watch_for: Elbows dropping. Leaning forward. Short steps.

name: Sandbag Clean
how_to_1: Straddle the bag and grip it.
how_to_2: Explode up and pull it to your chest.
how_to_3: Catch it in a bear hug or on the shoulder.

name: D-Ball Over Shoulder
tags: Full body · Glutes · Upper back · Barbell
how_to_1: Squat over a D-ball and hug it.
how_to_2: Lap it, then extend hips explosively.
watch_for: Rounding with heavy loads. Arm lifting. Not finishing hips.

name: Sled Push
how_to_1: Grip the sled handles, lean in at about 45°.
how_to_2: Drive with short, powerful steps.

name: Sled Pull
how_to_1: Hold the rope attached to a sled.
how_to_2: Pull hand over hand toward you.
how_to_3: Pull until the sled reaches you.
watch_for: Rounding. Arm-only pulling. Standing too tall.

name: Yoke Carry
how_to_1: Set the yoke on your upper back and stand up.
how_to_2: Walk forward with short, fast steps.

name: Farmer's Carry
how_to_1: Lift heavy implements at your sides.
how_to_2: Walk tall.

name: Medicine Ball Clean
how_to_1: Squat over a medicine ball.
how_to_2: Explode up and drop under it.
how_to_3: Catch at the chest in a squat and stand.

how_to_2: Reach the other foot in multiple directions.

name: Single-Leg Clock Reach
how_to_1: Stand on one leg.
how_to_2: Reach the free foot to clock positions.

name: Slackline Walk
how_to_1: Step onto a low slackline.
how_to_2: Walk heel to toe with arms out.
watch_for: Looking down. Stiff legs. Unsafe height.

name: Balance Beam Walk
how_to_1: Step onto a beam.
how_to_2: Walk heel to toe.

name: Slider Mountain Climber
how_to_1: Plank with feet on sliders.
how_to_2: Slide knees in alternately.

name: Slider Pike
how_to_1: Plank with feet on sliders.
how_to_2: Pike hips up, sliding feet in.

name: Slider Knee Tuck
how_to_1: Plank with feet on sliders.
how_to_2: Tuck both knees in.

name: Slider Body Saw
how_to_1: Forearm plank on sliders.
how_to_2: Slide back and forward.

name: Slider Hamstring Curl
how_to_1: Lie with heels on sliders, hips up.
how_to_2: Slide heels in.

name: Slider Reverse Lunge
how_to_1: One foot on a slider.
how_to_2: Slide it back into a lunge.

name: Slider Lateral Lunge
how_to_1: One foot on a slider.
how_to_2: Slide it out sideways and sit back.

name: Slider Curtsy Lunge
how_to_1: One foot on a slider.
how_to_2: Slide it back diagonally into a curtsy lunge.

name: Slider Push-Up Fly
how_to_1: Plank with hands on sliders.
how_to_2: Slide one hand out as you lower.
how_to_3: Push up pulling it back; alternate.

name: Slider Plank Jack
how_to_1: Plank with feet on sliders.
how_to_2: Slide feet out and in.

name: Slider Bear Crawl
how_to_1: Bear position with hands on sliders.
how_to_2: Crawl forward sliding your hands.

name: Slider Skater
how_to_1: One foot on a slider.
how_to_2: Slide it behind into a curtsy-skater.

name: Slider Walk-Out
how_to_1: Stand with hands on sliders on the floor.
how_to_2: Slide hands out to a plank.

name: Slider Oblique Pike
how_to_1: Plank with feet on sliders.
how_to_2: Pike hips up and to one side.

name: Ab Wheel Kneeling Rollout
how_to_1: Kneel holding the wheel.
how_to_2: Roll forward keeping your back flat.

name: Ab Wheel Standing Rollout
how_to_1: Stand holding the wheel.
how_to_2: Roll out toward the floor.

name: Ab Wheel Oblique Rollout
how_to_1: Kneel holding the wheel.
how_to_2: Roll out diagonally to one side.

name: Ab Wheel Pike
how_to_1: Feet on the wheel pedals in a plank.
how_to_2: Pike hips up.

name: Mace 360 (Mill)
tags: Shoulders · Core · Grip · Mace / Indian clubs
how_to_1: Hold the mace in front with both hands, one above the other.
how_to_2: Swing the head behind your back over one shoulder in a full circle.
how_to_3: Bring it back to the front and alternate sides.
watch_for: Using too heavy a mace. Arching the back. Letting the mace pull you off balance.

name: Mace 10-to-2
tags: Shoulders · Core · Lats · Mace / Indian clubs
how_to_1: Hold the mace upright in front.
how_to_2: Swing it behind one shoulder (10 o'clock) and back.
how_to_3: Swing to the other side (2 o'clock).

name: Mace Squat
tags: Quads · Glutes · Core · Mace / Indian clubs
how_to_1: Hold the mace upright at your chest.
how_to_2: Squat down.

name: Mace Lunge
how_to_1: Hold the mace in front.
how_to_2: Lunge.

name: Mace Front Press
how_to_1: Hold the mace at chest with head up.
how_to_2: Press it forward or up.

name: Mace Gravedigger
how_to_1: Hold the mace like a shovel.
how_to_2: Scoop it from one hip across the body.

name: Mace Uppercut
how_to_1: Hold the mace low at one side.
how_to_2: Swing it up and across like an uppercut.

name: Mace Barbarian Squat
tags: Quads · Shoulders · Core · Mace / Indian clubs
how_to_1: Do a mace 360.
how_to_2: Squat as the mace goes behind you.

name: Indian Club Arm Cast
tags: Shoulders · Rotator cuff · Mace / Indian clubs
how_to_1: Hold a light club in each hand.
how_to_2: Let clubs drop behind the shoulders and cast them forward.

name: Indian Club Mill
tags: Shoulders · Rotator cuff · Mobility · Mace / Indian clubs
how_to_1: Hold a club upright.
how_to_2: Swing it in a circle behind your head.

name: Indian Club Front Swing
how_to_1: Hold a club in each hand.
how_to_2: Swing them forward and up in arcs.

name: Indian Club Inside Circle
tags: Shoulders · Rotator cuff · Mace / Indian clubs
how_to_1: Hold a club.
how_to_2: Draw circles toward the body's centre.

name: Indian Club Outside Circle
tags: Shoulders · Rotator cuff · Mace / Indian clubs
how_to_1: Hold a club.
how_to_2: Draw circles away from the body.

name: Clubbell Shield Cast
tags: Shoulders · Core · Grip · Mace / Indian clubs
how_to_1: Hold the clubbell upright with both hands.
how_to_2: Cast it behind your head and back to the front.

name: Clubbell Swipe
how_to_1: Hold the clubbell at your shoulder.
how_to_2: Swipe it diagonally down across your body.

name: Clubbell Order
how_to_1: Hold the clubbell upright in front.
how_to_2: Hold it vertical (order position).

name: Clubbell Torch Press
how_to_1: Hold the clubbell upright like a torch.
how_to_2: Press it overhead.

name: Clubbell Pullover
how_to_1: Hold the clubbell with both hands overhead.
how_to_2: Lower it behind and pull it back over.

name: Persian Meel (Mugdar) Swing
tags: Shoulders · Lats · Core · Mace / Indian clubs
how_to_1: Hold a meel/mugdar upright.
how_to_2: Swing it behind your back in a controlled circle.

name: Gada (Mace) Swing
tags: Shoulders · Core · Grip · Mace / Indian clubs
how_to_1: Hold the gada with both hands.
how_to_2: Swing it behind your back in a full circle.
how_to_3: Return to the front and alternate.

name: Wrist Roller
how_to_1: Hold the wrist roller with arms straight in front.
how_to_2: Roll the rope up by turning your wrists.
watch_for: Bending elbows. Shrugging. Dropping the weight.

name: Plate Pinch
how_to_1: Pinch two plates smooth side out.
how_to_2: Lift and hold.

name: Hub Lift
how_to_1: Grip a plate by its hub with fingertips.
how_to_2: Lift it off the floor.

name: Thick-Bar Hold
how_to_1: Grip a thick bar.
how_to_2: Lift and hold.

name: Fat Grip Curl
how_to_1: Put fat grips on a bar or dumbbells.
how_to_2: Curl up.

name: Gripper (Hand Gripper) Squeeze
how_to_1: Hold a hand gripper.
how_to_2: Squeeze it fully closed.

name: Rice Bucket Training
how_to_1: Push your hand into a bucket of rice.
how_to_2: Open, close and rotate your hand.

name: Towel Hang
how_to_1: Drape towels over a bar.
how_to_2: Hang from them.

name: Rope Hang
how_to_1: Grip a vertical rope.
how_to_2: Hang.

name: Ball Hang
how_to_1: Hang from climbing balls.
how_to_2: Hold.

name: Finger Extension (Band)
how_to_1: Loop a band around your fingers.
how_to_2: Open your fingers against it.
watch_for: Rushing. Too much tension. Partial range.

name: Rolling Thunder Lift
how_to_1: Grip the rotating handle.
how_to_2: Lift it off the floor with one hand.

name: Two-Hands Pinch
how_to_1: Pinch two plates in each hand.
how_to_2: Lift and hold.

name: Wrist Curl (Any Implement)
how_to_1: Sit with forearm supported, palm up.
how_to_2: Curl the wrist.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
how_to_1: Sit with forearm supported, palm down.
how_to_2: Lift the back of the hand.

name: Pronation/Supination with Hammer
how_to_1: Hold a hammer by the handle end.
how_to_2: Rotate the head palm-up to palm-down.
watch_for: Holding too far down. Rushing. Moving elbow.

name: Leverage Bar (Sledgehammer) Levering
how_to_1: Hold a sledgehammer handle with head forward.
how_to_2: Tilt it up and down using only the wrist.
watch_for: Holding too far down. Bending elbow. Rushing.

name: Farmer's Hold for Time
how_to_1: Lift heavy weights at sides.
how_to_2: Stand still.

name: Dead Hang for Time
how_to_1: Hang from a bar.
how_to_2: Hold with straight arms.

name: Neck Bridge (Front)
how_to_1: Kneel with forehead on a padded mat.
how_to_2: Gently shift weight forward onto the head.
watch_for: Too much weight. Rolling. Neck pain — stop if felt.

name: Wrestler's Bridge (Back)
how_to_1: Lie on your back and lift onto your head and feet.
how_to_2: Hold the bridge on a padded surface.
watch_for: Advanced — high neck strain risk. Rushing. Hard surface.

name: Neck Harness Extension
how_to_1: Wear a neck harness with light weight, hinge forward.
how_to_2: Lift your head up.

name: Manual Resistance Neck Flexion
how_to_1: Place your hand on your forehead.
how_to_2: Push your head forward against your hand.

name: Lying Neck Curl
how_to_1: Lie face up on a bench, head off the edge.
how_to_2: Curl your chin toward your chest.

name: Band Neck Extension
how_to_1: Loop a band behind your head, anchored in front.
how_to_2: Extend your head back.

name: Isometric Neck Hold (4-Way)
how_to_1: Place your hand on one side of your head.
how_to_2: Push your head into your hand without moving.
watch_for: Too much force. Holding breath. Jerking.

name: Wall Sit
how_to_1: Lean your back against a wall.
how_to_2: Slide down until knees are at 90°.
watch_for: Knees past toes. Hands on thighs. Too high.

name: Plank (Any Variation)
how_to_1: Choose a plank variation.
how_to_2: Hold a straight line from head to heels.

name: Side Plank
how_to_1: Lie on your side on one forearm, feet stacked.
how_to_2: Lift your hips into a straight line.

name: Hollow Body Hold
how_to_1: Lie on your back with arms overhead.
how_to_2: Lift your shoulders and legs, pressing your lower back into the floor.
watch_for: Lower back lifting. Neck straining. Legs too low.

name: Superman Hold
tags: Lower back · Glutes · Upper back · Bodyweight
how_to_1: Lie face down with arms overhead.
how_to_2: Lift arms, chest and legs off the floor.
watch_for: Over-arching the neck. Bending knees. Holding breath.

name: Glute Bridge Hold
how_to_1: Lift into a glute bridge.
how_to_2: Hold the top position.

name: Split Squat Hold
how_to_1: Lower into a split squat.
how_to_2: Hold just above the floor.

name: Dead Hang
how_to_1: Grip a bar and hang with straight arms.
how_to_2: Relax your shoulders and breathe.

name: Flexed-Arm Hang
how_to_1: Pull up so your chin is over the bar.
how_to_2: Hold the top.
watch_for: Chin resting on the bar. Swinging. Shrugging.

name: L-Sit
how_to_1: Support on parallettes or the floor with straight arms.
how_to_2: Lift your legs straight out in front.

name: Static Lunge Hold
how_to_1: Hold a lunge position.
how_to_2: Keep both knees near 90°.

name: Isometric Push-Up Hold (Bottom)
how_to_1: Lower into a push-up.
how_to_2: Hold just above the floor.

name: Isometric Bicep Curl Hold (90 Degrees)
how_to_1: Curl a weight to 90°.
how_to_2: Hold the position.
watch_for: Leaning back. Elbows drifting. Holding breath.

name: Overcoming Isometric Mid-Thigh Pull
how_to_1: Set a bar under pins at mid-thigh.
how_to_2: Pull as hard as you can against the pins.
watch_for: Rounding. Jerking. Holding breath too long.

name: Overcoming Isometric Squat (Pins)
how_to_1: Set a bar under pins at your sticking point.
how_to_2: Push up hard against the pins.

name: Overcoming Isometric Bench (Pins)
how_to_1: Set pins just above your sticking point.
how_to_2: Press as hard as you can into the pins.

name: Copenhagen Hold
how_to_1: Side plank with top leg on a bench.
how_to_2: Hold the hips up.
watch_for: Hips dropping. Rolling. Too long too soon.

name: Calf Raise Hold
how_to_1: Rise onto your toes.
how_to_2: Hold the top.

name: Horse Stance
how_to_1: Take a wide stance, toes forward.
how_to_2: Sink until thighs are near parallel.

name: Chair Pose Hold
how_to_1: Stand with feet together.
how_to_2: Sit back as if into a chair, arms overhead.

name: Spanish Squat
how_to_1: Loop a band behind both knees, anchored in front.
how_to_2: Sit back into a squat with shins vertical.
watch_for: Knees moving forward. Rounding. Band slipping.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift Hold
how_to_1: Hinge on one leg.
how_to_2: Hold the bottom position.

name: Pallof Hold
how_to_1: Press a band or cable out from your chest.
how_to_2: Hold arms extended, resisting rotation.

name: Isometric Neck Hold
how_to_1: Place your hand against your head.
how_to_2: Push gently without moving.
watch_for: Too much force. Holding breath. Jerking.

name: Treadmill Walk
how_to_1: Step on and start at a comfortable walking speed.
how_to_2: Walk with an upright posture, arms swinging naturally.
watch_for: Holding the handrails. Looking down. Overstriding.

name: Treadmill Incline Walk
how_to_1: Set the incline (e.g. 5–15%).
how_to_2: Walk at a steady pace.
watch_for: Leaning on rails. Hunching. Too steep too soon.

name: 12-3-30 Treadmill Workout
how_to_1: Set incline 12% and speed 3 mph (about 4.8 km/h).
how_to_2: Walk for 30 minutes.
watch_for: Holding rails. Starting without a base. Hunching.

name: Treadmill Jog
how_to_1: Set an easy jogging speed.
how_to_2: Jog relaxed.

name: Treadmill Run
how_to_1: Set your running speed.
how_to_2: Run with good posture.
watch_for: Overstriding. Heel striking hard. Tense shoulders.

name: Treadmill Sprint Intervals
how_to_1: Warm up first.
how_to_2: Sprint at high speed for short intervals, stepping off to the side rails between.
watch_for: Jumping on/off unsafely. No warm-up. Too fast.

name: Treadmill Backward Walk
how_to_1: Set a slow speed.
how_to_2: Walk backward holding lightly to the rails.
watch_for: Too fast. Letting go. Looking back.

name: Treadmill Side Shuffle
tags: Glute medius · Adductors · Cardio · Cardio machine
how_to_1: Set a slow speed.
how_to_2: Shuffle sideways.

name: Curved / Manual Treadmill Sprint
how_to_1: Step onto the curved treadmill.
how_to_2: Sprint on the front of the curve to speed it up.

name: Elliptical Cross-Trainer
how_to_1: Step on and grip the handles.
how_to_2: Push and pull while striding.

name: Elliptical (Reverse)
how_to_1: On the elliptical.
how_to_2: Stride backward.

name: Stationary Upright Bike
how_to_1: Adjust the seat to hip height.
how_to_2: Pedal at a steady cadence.

name: Recumbent Bike
how_to_1: Sit back and adjust the seat.
how_to_2: Pedal steadily.
watch_for: Seat too close. Knees locking. Slouching.

name: Spin Bike (Indoor Cycling)
how_to_1: Set seat and handlebar heights.
how_to_2: Pedal with resistance, seated or standing.
watch_for: Seat too low. Bouncing. Too little resistance standing.

name: Air / Assault / Echo Bike
how_to_1: Adjust the seat.
how_to_2: Push and pull arms while pedalling.
watch_for: Seat too low. Legs only. Hunching.

name: BikeErg
how_to_1: Set seat height and pedal.
how_to_2: Keep a steady cadence at the set damper.
how_to_3: Ride the set distance or time.

name: Rowing Machine (Erg)
how_to_1: Strap in.
how_to_2: Drive legs, lean back, pull arms.
watch_for: Arms first. Rounding. Shins vertical at catch.

name: SkiErg
how_to_1: Hold the handles overhead.
how_to_2: Pull down by hinging and driving arms.

name: Stair Climber (StairMaster)
how_to_1: Step on and set the speed.
how_to_2: Climb with full steps, upright posture.
watch_for: Leaning on rails. Tiptoes only. Hunching.

name: Stepper (Step Mill)
how_to_1: Step on the stepper.
how_to_2: Step with full range.
watch_for: Leaning on rails. Short steps. Hunching.

name: Jacob's Ladder
how_to_1: Climb onto the angled ladder machine.
how_to_2: Climb continuously using hands and feet.

name: VersaClimber
how_to_1: Grip the handles and place your feet.
how_to_2: Climb with opposite arm and leg.

name: Arc Trainer
how_to_1: Step on and grip handles.
how_to_2: Stride in an arc motion.

name: Upper-Body Ergometer (Arm Bike)
how_to_1: Sit facing the arm bike.
how_to_2: Crank the handles in circles.

name: Hand Cycle
how_to_1: Sit and grip the hand pedals.
how_to_2: Crank continuously.

name: Rope Climber Machine (Marpo)
how_to_1: Stand or sit at the rope trainer.
how_to_2: Pull the rope hand over hand.

name: Vertical Climber
how_to_1: Grip handles and place feet.
how_to_2: Climb with opposite arms and legs.

name: AirRunner / Self-Powered Treadmill
how_to_1: Step onto the curved belt.
how_to_2: Run near the front to accelerate.

name: Water Rower
how_to_1: Strap in.
how_to_2: Row with legs–body–arms sequence.

name: Cross-Country Ski Machine (NordicTrack)
how_to_1: Step onto the skis.
how_to_2: Slide legs and pull arms in rhythm.

name: Skateboard / Skate Slide Board
tags: Glute medius · Adductors · Cardio · Cardio machine
how_to_1: Wear slide booties on the slide board.
how_to_2: Push off side to side like a speed skater.
watch_for: Knee caving. Standing tall. Short pushes.

name: Hydraulic Circuit Machine
how_to_1: Sit or stand at the hydraulic station.
how_to_2: Push and pull for the work interval.

name: Jumping Jacks
how_to_1: Stand with feet together, arms at sides.
how_to_2: Jump feet out while raising arms overhead.
how_to_3: Jump back to start and repeat.
watch_for: Landing on heels. Arms not fully up. Knees locked.

name: Half Jacks
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Jump feet out while raising arms to shoulder height.

name: Seal Jacks
how_to_1: Stand with arms out in front.
how_to_2: Jump feet out while opening arms wide.
how_to_3: Jump back, clapping hands in front.

name: Cross Jacks
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Jump and cross arms and legs in front.
how_to_3: Jump out and alternate the cross.

name: Squat Jacks
how_to_1: Squat low.
how_to_2: Jump feet out and in while staying low.
watch_for: Standing up. Knees caving. Heavy landings.

name: Star Jumps
how_to_1: Squat slightly.
how_to_2: Explode up into a star shape.

name: High Knees
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Run on the spot driving knees to hip height.
watch_for: Leaning back. Low knees. Landing on heels.

name: Butt Kicks
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Run on the spot kicking heels to glutes.

name: Mountain Climbers
how_to_1: High plank.
how_to_2: Drive knees to chest alternately at speed.

name: Skaters
how_to_1: Stand on one leg.
how_to_2: Leap sideways onto the other leg.
watch_for: Knee caving. Heavy landings. Short leaps.

name: Fast Feet
how_to_1: Half-squat on your toes.
how_to_2: Tap your feet as quickly as possible.
watch_for: Standing tall. Heels down. Big steps.

name: Jogging in Place
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Jog on the spot.

name: Marching in Place
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: March lifting knees.

name: Grapevine
how_to_1: Step sideways.
how_to_2: Cross the trailing foot behind, step again, and tap.

name: Step Touch
how_to_1: Step to one side.
how_to_2: Bring the other foot to touch beside it.

name: Box Step
how_to_1: Step forward, cross, step back, step back in a box pattern.
how_to_2: Repeat to the music.

name: Knee Lift (Low-Impact)
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Lift one knee to hip height.

name: Hamstring Curl Step
how_to_1: Step to the side.
how_to_2: Curl the other heel toward your glute.

name: Heel Digs
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Tap one heel forward.

name: Side Shuffle
how_to_1: Get into a half-squat.
how_to_2: Shuffle sideways without crossing your feet.
watch_for: Crossing feet. Standing up. Heavy steps.

name: Carioca
how_to_1: Move sideways.
how_to_2: Cross the trailing leg in front, then behind, alternately.

name: A-Skip
tags: Cardio · Hip flexors · Calves · Pull-up bar
how_to_1: Skip forward.
how_to_2: Drive one knee up while the other foot strikes under the hip.
watch_for: Leaning back. Low knees. Heel striking.

name: B-Skip
tags: Cardio · Hamstrings · Hip flexors · Pull-up bar
how_to_1: Do an A-skip.
how_to_2: Extend the leg out and paw it back down.

name: Power Skip
how_to_1: Skip forward.
how_to_2: Drive the knee and push off for maximum height.
watch_for: Leaning back. Low knees. Heavy landings.

name: Frog Hops
how_to_1: Squat with hands on the floor.
how_to_2: Hop forward.

name: Bunny Hops
how_to_1: Stand with feet together.
how_to_2: Hop forward with small quick jumps.
watch_for: Heavy landings. Bending knees too much. Rushing.

name: Tuck Jumps
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Jump and pull knees to chest.

name: Burpees
how_to_1: Squat and put hands down.
how_to_2: Jump feet back, chest to floor, push up.
how_to_3: Jump feet in and jump up.
watch_for: Sagging. Stiff landing. Not standing fully.

name: Squat Thrusts
how_to_1: Squat, hands down.
how_to_2: Jump feet back to plank.

name: Shadow Boxing
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Throw combinations in the air while moving your feet.
watch_for: Dropping hands. Locking elbows. Flat feet.

name: Kick-Back Jacks
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Kick one leg back while raising arms.

name: Punch Jacks
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Jump feet out while punching forward.

name: Lateral Step-Outs
how_to_1: Half-squat.
how_to_2: Step one foot out to the side and back.

name: Speed Bag Arms
how_to_1: Raise fists in front of your face.
how_to_2: Rotate them around each other quickly.

name: Plank Jacks
how_to_1: High plank.
how_to_2: Jump feet out and in.

name: Invisible Jump Rope
how_to_1: Hold imaginary handles.
how_to_2: Jump as if skipping.
watch_for: Heavy landings. Jumping too high. Rushing.

name: Toe Taps (Step / Bench)
how_to_1: Stand facing a step.
how_to_2: Tap one foot on top, then switch quickly.

name: Wall Climbers
how_to_1: Plank with feet against a wall.
how_to_2: Climb feet up and down alternately.

name: Sprawls
how_to_1: Stand in a fighting stance.
how_to_2: Drop and shoot your legs back.

name: Tabata Intervals
how_to_1: Choose one exercise.
how_to_2: Work 20 seconds hard, rest 10 seconds.
watch_for: Pacing too slow. Sloppy form. Skipping rests.

name: HIIT Circuit
how_to_1: Choose 4–8 exercises.
how_to_2: Do each for a work period with short rests.
watch_for: No warm-up. Sloppy form. Poor pacing.

name: Low-Impact Aerobics Routine
how_to_1: Warm up with marching.
how_to_2: Follow low-impact moves (step touch, knee lifts, grapevine) to music.

name: Step Aerobics (Basic Step)
how_to_1: Stand facing the step.
how_to_2: Step up right, up left, down right, down left.
watch_for: Stepping on the edge. Looking down. Leaning.

name: Step Aerobics (V-Step)
how_to_1: Stand at the step.
how_to_2: Step wide up onto each corner, then down to centre.
watch_for: Stepping on edge. Rushing. Looking down.

name: Step Aerobics (Over the Top)
how_to_1: Stand beside the step.
how_to_2: Step up and over to the other side.

name: Step Aerobics (Turn Step)
how_to_1: Start at one end of the step.
how_to_2: Step up and turn as you step down the other side.

name: Step Aerobics (Repeater)
how_to_1: Step up with one foot.
how_to_2: Lift the other knee repeatedly before stepping down.

name: Walking
how_to_1: Stand tall and walk at a comfortable pace.
how_to_2: Swing your arms naturally and land heel-to-toe.
how_to_3: Continue for the set time or distance.
watch_for: Looking down at the phone. Slouching. Overstriding.

name: Brisk / Power Walking
how_to_1: Walk fast with short quick steps.
how_to_2: Bend elbows to 90° and swing arms strongly.
how_to_3: Keep a pace where talking is harder.

name: Race Walking
how_to_1: Walk fast with one foot always on the ground.
how_to_2: Keep the front leg straight from heel strike until it passes under the body.
watch_for: Running (both feet off). Bent front knee. Hunching.

name: Nordic Walking
how_to_1: Hold Nordic poles angled backward.
how_to_2: Plant the pole opposite the front foot and push back.
watch_for: Poles too far forward. Not pushing through. Short stride.

name: Hiking
how_to_1: Wear proper footwear and plan your route.
how_to_2: Walk trails at a steady pace, shortening steps uphill.

name: Rucking (Weighted Backpack)
how_to_1: Pack a weighted backpack high and tight.
how_to_2: Walk briskly with good posture.
watch_for: Pack too low. Too heavy too soon. Hunching.

name: Stair / Step Climbing
how_to_1: Find a set of stairs.
how_to_2: Walk or run up using full steps.
watch_for: Leaning on rails. Rushing down. Tiptoes only.

name: Hill Walking
how_to_1: Walk up an incline.
how_to_2: Lean slightly forward with short steps.
watch_for: Hunching. Long strides uphill. Rushing down.

name: Easy Run (Zone 2)
how_to_1: Run at a pace where you can hold a conversation.
how_to_2: Keep relaxed shoulders and short steps.
watch_for: Running too fast. Overstriding. Tense shoulders.

name: Tempo Run
how_to_1: Warm up.
how_to_2: Run at a comfortably hard pace for a sustained period.
watch_for: Starting too fast. Skipping warm-up. Tensing up.

name: Threshold Run
how_to_1: Warm up.
how_to_2: Run at roughly your 1-hour race effort for set intervals or a block.
watch_for: Going too hard. Poor pacing. Skipping recovery.

name: Interval Run (e.g., 400 m repeats)
how_to_1: Warm up.
how_to_2: Run fast for the set distance.
how_to_3: Recover with an easy jog or walk, then repeat.
watch_for: No warm-up. Starting too fast. Skipping recovery.

name: Fartlek
how_to_1: Warm up.
how_to_2: Mix fast surges with easy running, unstructured.
watch_for: Going too hard each surge. No easy sections. Skipping warm-up.

name: Hill Sprints
how_to_1: Find a moderate hill.
how_to_2: Sprint up hard for 8–15 seconds.
watch_for: Too steep. Leaning back. Short recovery.

name: Hill Repeats
how_to_1: Warm up.
how_to_2: Run up a hill at a hard effort.

name: Long Run
how_to_1: Plan the distance and hydration.
how_to_2: Run at an easy, sustainable pace.
watch_for: Starting too fast. No fuel or water. Increasing distance too quickly.

name: Recovery Run
how_to_1: Run very easily.
how_to_2: Keep it short and relaxed.
watch_for: Running too fast. Too long. Ignoring pain.

name: Progression Run
how_to_1: Start at an easy pace.
how_to_2: Gradually speed up through the run.
watch_for: Starting too fast. Jumping pace. Skipping warm-up.

name: Strides
how_to_1: After an easy run.
how_to_2: Accelerate smoothly over 80–100 m to near sprint.
watch_for: Sprinting all-out. Tense form. Too few recoveries.

name: Sprint (100 m / 200 m)
how_to_1: Warm up thoroughly.
how_to_2: Sprint all-out for the distance.

name: Shuttle Run
how_to_1: Mark two lines a set distance apart.
how_to_2: Sprint to one line, touch it, turn and sprint back.
watch_for: Rounding the turn. Not touching the line. Slowing down early.

name: Trail Running
how_to_1: Choose a trail and proper shoes.
how_to_2: Run with short steps, watching the ground ahead.
watch_for: Looking at feet. Overstriding downhill. Poor footwear.

name: Beach / Sand Running
how_to_1: Run on firm sand first.
how_to_2: Keep steps short.
watch_for: Too much soft sand. Achilles strain. Too long too soon.

name: Stadium Stairs
how_to_1: Warm up.
how_to_2: Run up the stadium steps.

name: Outdoor Cycling (Road)
how_to_1: Set up the bike and wear a helmet.
how_to_2: Ride at your chosen pace.
watch_for: No helmet. Poor bike fit. Riding without lights.

name: Mountain Biking
how_to_1: Choose a trail with a helmet.
how_to_2: Ride with weight centred, standing on descents.
watch_for: Over-braking front. Locked arms. No helmet.

name: Inline Skating / Rollerblading
how_to_1: Wear skates and protective gear.
how_to_2: Push out to the sides with bent knees.
watch_for: Standing upright. No pads. Leaning back.

name: Ice Skating
how_to_1: Wear fitted skates.
how_to_2: Push sideways with bent knees.
watch_for: Standing tall. Looking down. Leaning back.

name: Cross-Country Skiing
how_to_1: Wear skis and use poles.
how_to_2: Kick and glide while pushing with poles.
watch_for: Short glides. Poor pole timing. Hunching.

name: Snowshoeing
how_to_1: Strap on snowshoes.
how_to_2: Walk with a slightly wider stance.
watch_for: Tripping on the frames. Short steps. Poor clothing.

name: Rowing (On Water)
how_to_1: Sit in the boat with feet secured.
how_to_2: Drive legs, swing back, pull oars.

name: Kayaking
how_to_1: Sit in the kayak holding the paddle.
how_to_2: Rotate your torso to paddle each side.
watch_for: Arm-only paddling. Hunching. No life jacket.

name: Stand-Up Paddleboarding
how_to_1: Stand on the board with knees soft.
how_to_2: Paddle using your core and rotate.

name: Rock Climbing
how_to_1: Harness up and tie in with a trained belayer.
how_to_2: Climb using legs to push and arms to balance.
watch_for: Overgripping. Not using legs. Unsafe belay.

name: Bouldering
how_to_1: Choose a problem over crash pads.
how_to_2: Climb using footwork and body position.

name: Skipping / Jump Rope (Outdoor)
how_to_1: Use a rope sized to your height.
how_to_2: Jump lightly on the balls of your feet.
watch_for: Jumping too high. Arms wide. Hard surfaces.

name: Basic Bounce (Two-Foot)
how_to_1: Hold handles at hip height, rope behind you.
how_to_2: Turn the rope with your wrists and hop over it with both feet.
watch_for: Jumping too high. Landing on heels. Arms swinging wide.

name: Alternate Foot Step (Boxer Skip)
how_to_1: Turn the rope.
how_to_2: Hop on one foot then the other in a jogging rhythm.

name: Boxer Step
how_to_1: Turn the rope.
how_to_2: Shift weight side to side, two light bounces per foot.

name: High Knees (Rope)
how_to_1: Turn the rope.
how_to_2: Run in place driving knees high.

name: Side Swing
how_to_1: Hold both handles together.
how_to_2: Swing the rope to one side of your body.
how_to_3: Swing to the other side, then jump through.

name: Criss-Cross
how_to_1: Lie with hands behind head.
how_to_2: Rotate elbow toward the opposite knee, extending the other leg.

name: Double-Under
how_to_1: Jump slightly higher.
how_to_2: Spin the rope twice per jump.
watch_for: Piking. Arms wide. Jumping too high.

name: Triple-Under
how_to_1: Jump higher with fast wrists.
how_to_2: Spin the rope three times per jump.

name: Single-Leg Hop (Rope)
how_to_1: Turn the rope.
how_to_2: Hop on one foot.

name: Side-to-Side Jump
how_to_1: Turn the rope.
how_to_2: Jump side to side over an imaginary line.

name: Front-to-Back Jump
how_to_1: Turn the rope.
how_to_2: Jump forward and back.

name: Bell Jump
how_to_1: Turn the rope.
how_to_2: Jump forward and back like a bell.

name: Scissors (Rope)
how_to_1: Turn the rope.
how_to_2: Jump and alternate feet front and back.

name: Heel-Toe (Rope)
how_to_1: Turn the rope.
how_to_2: Alternate tapping a heel forward then a toe back.

name: Toad
how_to_1: Turn the rope.
how_to_2: Cross one arm under the opposite lifted leg as you jump.

name: EB (Crossover Variation)
how_to_1: Turn the rope.
how_to_2: Cross one arm in front and one behind your back.

name: Backward Skip
how_to_1: Turn the rope backward.
how_to_2: Jump as it passes under.

name: Mummy Kicks
how_to_1: Turn the rope.
how_to_2: Kick legs alternately forward.

name: Jump Rope Sprint
how_to_1: Turn the rope as fast as possible.
how_to_2: Skip at maximum speed.
watch_for: Sloppy form. Tripping. Jumping too high.

name: Weighted Rope Skip
how_to_1: Use a weighted rope.
how_to_2: Skip at a steady pace.
watch_for: Arms wide. Jumping too high. Shoulder fatigue.

name: Heavy Rope Slams (Skipping)
how_to_1: Use a heavy rope.
how_to_2: Skip with big, forceful turns.
watch_for: Rounding. Arms wide. Jumping too high.

name: One-In Ladder Run
how_to_1: Stand at the end of an agility ladder.
how_to_2: Run through placing one foot in each square.
watch_for: Looking down. Heavy steps. Skipping squares.

name: Two-In Ladder Run (Quick Feet)
how_to_1: Stand at the ladder.
how_to_2: Place both feet in each square quickly.

name: Lateral Two-In
how_to_1: Stand side-on to the ladder.
how_to_2: Step both feet into each square moving sideways.
watch_for: Crossing feet. Looking down. Heavy steps.

name: Ickey Shuffle
how_to_1: Stand at the ladder.
how_to_2: In-in-out pattern moving forward, alternating sides.
watch_for: Losing rhythm. Looking down. Heavy steps.

name: In-In-Out-Out
how_to_1: Face the ladder.
how_to_2: Step both feet in, then both out to the sides.

name: Lateral In-Out
how_to_1: Stand side-on.
how_to_2: Step in and out of each square moving sideways.

name: Crossover Ladder
how_to_1: Stand side-on.
how_to_2: Cross one foot over into the next square.

name: Hopscotch Ladder
how_to_1: Face the ladder.
how_to_2: Hop one foot in, then two feet out.

name: Single-Leg Ladder Hop
how_to_1: Stand on one leg.
how_to_2: Hop into each square.

name: Carioca Ladder
how_to_1: Stand side-on.
how_to_2: Carioca through the ladder.

name: Centipede
how_to_1: Face the ladder.
how_to_2: Shuffle laterally in a zig-zag pattern.

name: Slalom Hops
how_to_1: Stand beside the ladder.
how_to_2: Hop side to side moving forward.

name: T-Drill
how_to_1: Set cones in a T shape.
how_to_2: Sprint forward, shuffle left, shuffle right, shuffle back to centre.
watch_for: Crossing feet. Not touching cones. Rounding turns.

name: 5-10-5 Pro Agility Shuttle
how_to_1: Start at the middle cone.
how_to_2: Sprint 5 yards one way, 10 yards back, 5 yards to finish.
how_to_3: Touch the line at each turn.
watch_for: Rounding turns. Not touching lines. Standing upright.

name: L-Drill (3-Cone)
how_to_1: Set 3 cones in an L.
how_to_2: Sprint, turn and weave around the cones in pattern.
watch_for: Rounding turns. Standing upright. Missing cones.

name: Box Drill
how_to_1: Set 4 cones in a square.
how_to_2: Sprint, shuffle, backpedal and shuffle around the box.

name: Zig-Zag Cone Run
how_to_1: Set cones in a zig-zag.
how_to_2: Sprint to each cone and cut.

name: Star Drill
how_to_1: Set cones in a star around a centre.
how_to_2: Sprint out to each cone and back to centre.

name: Illinois Agility Run
how_to_1: Set out the Illinois course.
how_to_2: Run the course weaving between centre cones.
watch_for: Clipping cones. Rounding turns. Standing upright.

name: Figure-8 Run
how_to_1: Set two cones apart.
how_to_2: Run a figure-8 around them.

name: Mirror Drill (Partner)
how_to_1: Face a partner in an athletic stance.
how_to_2: Mirror their side-to-side moves.
watch_for: Crossing feet. Standing tall. Reacting late.

name: Reaction Ball Drill
how_to_1: Throw a reaction ball at a wall.
how_to_2: React to the random bounce and catch it.
watch_for: Standing flat-footed. Throwing too hard. Rushing.

name: Backpedal Sprint
how_to_1: Start in an athletic stance.
how_to_2: Backpedal for a set distance.
watch_for: Leaning back. Heels down. Slow turn.

name: Drop Step Drill
how_to_1: Athletic stance.
how_to_2: Open your hips and step back to one side.
watch_for: Slow hip turn. Standing upright. Rushing.

name: Defensive Slide
how_to_1: Low athletic stance.
how_to_2: Slide sideways without crossing feet.
watch_for: Standing up. Crossing feet. Heavy steps.

name: Wall Drive / Acceleration Drill
how_to_1: Lean into a wall at 45° with hands on it.
how_to_2: Drive one knee up and switch quickly.

name: Falling Start Sprint
how_to_1: Stand tall and lean forward.
how_to_2: Fall until you must step, then sprint.
watch_for: Standing up too soon. Overstriding. Slow first step.

name: Flying Sprint
how_to_1: Build up speed over a run-in zone.
how_to_2: Sprint flat out through the timed zone.
watch_for: No run-in. Tensing up. Stopping suddenly.

name: Resisted Band Sprint
how_to_1: Band around your waist held by a partner.
how_to_2: Sprint forward against it.
watch_for: Leaning too far. Short strides. Band snapping.

name: Parachute Sprint
how_to_1: Attach a speed chute.
how_to_2: Sprint forward.

name: Hurdle Mobility Step-Over
how_to_1: Set hurdles in a row.
how_to_2: Step over each with high knees and open hips.

name: Mini-Hurdle Run
how_to_1: Set mini-hurdles in a line.
how_to_2: Run over them with quick knee drive.
watch_for: Heavy steps. Looking down. Hitting hurdles.

name: Beep Test (Multistage)
how_to_1: Set markers 20 m apart and play the beep test audio.
how_to_2: Run between markers, reaching each before the beep.
how_to_3: Continue as levels speed up until you can't keep pace.
watch_for: Starting too fast. Rounding turns. Missing lines.

name: Yo-Yo Intermittent Recovery Test
how_to_1: Set markers 20 m apart plus a recovery zone.
how_to_2: Run shuttles to the beeps with 10 s active recovery between.
watch_for: Starting too fast. Skipping recovery. Missing lines.

name: Jab
how_to_1: Stand in a fighting stance, hands up.
how_to_2: Extend the lead hand straight out, rotating the fist palm-down.
how_to_3: Snap it back to your guard.
watch_for: Dropping the other hand. Locking the elbow. Pushing instead of snapping.

name: Cross
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Rotate your rear hip and pivot the back foot as you punch straight with the rear hand.
watch_for: Arm-only punching. Dropping the guard. Leaning forward.

name: Lead Hook
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Rotate on the lead foot and swing the lead arm in a horizontal hook, elbow bent at 90°.
watch_for: Winding up. Dropping the elbow. Swinging wide.

name: Rear Hook
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Rotate the rear hip and throw a hook with the rear hand.

name: Lead Uppercut
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Dip slightly and drive the lead fist upward.
watch_for: Dropping the hand first. Over-dipping. Leaning back.

name: Rear Uppercut
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Rotate the hip and drive the rear fist up.
watch_for: Winding up. Dropping guard. Leaning back.

name: Overhand
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Loop the rear hand over the top in an arc.

name: Body Hook
how_to_1: Bend at the knees to lower your level.
how_to_2: Throw a hook to the body.
watch_for: Leaning too far. Dropping guard. Arm-only.

name: 1-2 Combo
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Throw a jab, then a cross.

name: 1-2-3 Combo
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Throw jab, cross, lead hook.

name: Slip
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Rotate and bend knees slightly to move your head off the centre line.
watch_for: Leaning too far. Bending at the waist. Dropping hands.

name: Roll (Bob and Weave)
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Bend your knees and move your head in a U shape under an imaginary punch.
watch_for: Bending at the waist. Dropping hands. Looking down.

name: Pivot
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Rotate on the ball of the lead foot to change angle.
watch_for: Crossing feet. Losing balance. Dropping hands.

name: Shadow Boxing
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Throw combinations in the air while moving your feet.
watch_for: Dropping hands. Locking elbows. Flat feet.

name: Heavy Bag Work
tags: Shoulders · Core · Cardio · Power · Bag / gloves (optional)
how_to_1: Wear wraps and gloves.
how_to_2: Strike the bag with combinations, moving around it.
watch_for: No wraps. Pushing the bag. Dropping hands.

name: Speed Bag
how_to_1: Stand facing the speed bag at chin height.
how_to_2: Strike it in a rhythmic circular motion.
watch_for: Hitting too hard. Bag too low. Losing rhythm.

name: Double-End Bag
how_to_1: Stand in range of the double-end bag.
how_to_2: Strike and slip as it rebounds.
watch_for: Hitting too hard. Standing still. Dropping hands.

name: Focus Mitts (Pad Work)
how_to_1: Partner holds mitts and calls combos.
how_to_2: Strike the mitts with good technique.
watch_for: Dropping hands. Rushing. Partner holding mitts poorly.

name: Teep (Push Kick)
tags: Hip flexors · Quads · Core · Bag / gloves (optional)
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Lift the knee and push the ball of your foot straight into the target.
watch_for: Leaning back too far. Low knee. Dropping hands.

name: Front Kick
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Raise the knee and snap the lower leg forward.
watch_for: Locking knee. Leaning back. Dropping hands.

name: Roundhouse Kick
tags: Obliques · Hip flexors · Glutes · Bag / gloves (optional)
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Pivot on the standing foot and swing the leg around, hitting with the shin.
watch_for: Not pivoting. Dropping hands. Kicking with the foot.

name: Low Kick
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Pivot and swing the shin into the thigh height target.

name: Switch Kick
tags: Obliques · Hip flexors · Agility · Bag / gloves (optional)
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Quickly switch your feet and throw a lead-leg roundhouse.
watch_for: Slow switch. Dropping hands. Not pivoting.

name: Side Kick
tags: Glutes · Glute medius · Core · Bag / gloves (optional)
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Chamber the knee and drive the heel out sideways.
watch_for: Leaning over. Toes up. Losing balance.

name: Back Kick
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Turn and drive the heel straight back.

name: Spinning Back Kick
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Spin, look over your shoulder and drive the heel back.

name: Axe Kick
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
