how_to_2: Raise a straight leg high and bring the heel down.

name: Knee Strike
how_to_1: Clinch or stance.
how_to_2: Drive the knee up and forward.

name: Elbow Strike
how_to_1: Close range stance.
how_to_2: Rotate and strike with the point of the elbow.

name: Muay Thai Clinch
tags: Neck · Upper back · Core · Bag / gloves (optional)
how_to_1: Clasp hands behind your partner's head.
how_to_2: Control their posture with elbows in.
watch_for: Interlacing fingers. Elbows wide. Neck strain.

name: Sprawl
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Shoot legs back, dropping hips to the floor.

name: Shrimping (Hip Escape)
how_to_1: Lie on your side.
how_to_2: Push off with your foot to move your hips backward.
watch_for: Not using hips. Rushing. Lifting head.

name: Bridge and Roll (Upa)
how_to_1: Lie on your back.
how_to_2: Bridge your hips up and over one shoulder.

name: Technical Stand-Up
how_to_1: Sit with one hand behind you and one foot planted.
how_to_2: Lift your hips and sweep the leg back.

name: Double-Leg Takedown Shot
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Change level and step deep, driving your shoulder into the target.
how_to_3: Wrap both legs and drive through.
watch_for: Bending at waist. Looking down. Short penetration step.

name: Single-Leg Takedown Shot
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Change level and shoot to one leg.
watch_for: Bending at waist. Head down. Short step.

name: Penetration Step
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Drop your level and step forward deeply onto the lead knee.
how_to_3: Bring the rear foot up and stand.
watch_for: Bending at waist. Knee slamming. Head down.

name: Granby Roll
how_to_1: Kneel on all fours.
how_to_2: Roll over your shoulders across your back.
how_to_3: Come up facing the other way.
watch_for: Rolling on the neck. Rushing. Poor technique.

name: Forward Roll
how_to_1: Squat with hands on the mat.
how_to_2: Tuck your chin and roll over your back.
watch_for: Rolling on the head. Not tucking chin. Hard surface.

name: Backward Roll
how_to_1: Squat.
how_to_2: Roll backward over one shoulder.
how_to_3: Come to your knees or feet.
watch_for: Rolling on the neck. Rushing. Hard surface.

name: Break Fall
how_to_1: Squat or kneel.
how_to_2: Fall back, tucking chin and slapping the mat with arms.
watch_for: Not tucking chin. Hard surface. Landing on elbows.

name: Tire Sledgehammer Strike
how_to_1: Stand facing a tire.
how_to_2: Swing the sledgehammer overhead and strike.

name: Grappling Dummy Throws
how_to_1: Lift the dummy.
how_to_2: Execute throws (hip toss, suplex).

name: Kata / Forms Practice
how_to_1: Learn the form's sequence.
how_to_2: Perform each technique with control.

name: Kickboxing Combos
how_to_1: Fighting stance.
how_to_2: Combine punches and kicks in sequence.

name: Cardio Kickboxing
how_to_1: Follow a class or routine.
how_to_2: Punch and kick to music at speed.

name: Boxercise
how_to_1: Follow a boxing-style fitness routine.
how_to_2: Combine punches, pad work and conditioning.

name: Arm Circles
how_to_1: Stand with arms out to the sides.
how_to_2: Make small circles, gradually getting bigger.

name: Shoulder Rolls
how_to_1: Stand tall with arms relaxed.
how_to_2: Roll shoulders up, back and down in circles.
watch_for: Rushing. Tensing the neck. Small range.

name: Neck Rolls
how_to_1: Stand or sit tall.
how_to_2: Slowly roll your head in a half circle from shoulder to shoulder.
watch_for: Rolling the head backward forcefully. Rushing. Forcing range.

name: Leg Swings (Front-to-Back)
how_to_1: Hold a wall for balance.
how_to_2: Swing one leg forward and back in a relaxed arc.
watch_for: Arching the back. Forcing height. Swinging too fast early.

name: Leg Swings (Side-to-Side)
how_to_1: Face a wall holding it.
how_to_2: Swing one leg across your body and out to the side.
watch_for: Twisting the torso. Forcing range. Rushing.

name: Walking Knee Hug
how_to_1: Walk forward.
how_to_2: Pull one knee to your chest and rise onto your toes.

name: Walking Quad Pull
how_to_1: Walk forward.
how_to_2: Pull one heel to your glute, knee pointing down.
watch_for: Leaning forward. Knee flaring out. Rushing.

name: Frankenstein Walk (Toy Soldier)
how_to_1: Walk forward with arms out in front.
how_to_2: Kick a straight leg up toward the opposite hand.
watch_for: Rounding to reach. Bending the knee. Forcing height.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
tags: Hips · Thoracic spine · Hamstrings · Mobility · Bodyweight
how_to_1: Step into a deep lunge, hands inside the front foot.
how_to_2: Drop the elbow toward the instep, then rotate and reach the arm up.
how_to_3: Return, straighten the front leg for a hamstring stretch, and switch sides.
watch_for: Rushing. Back knee collapsing. Forcing rotation.

name: Inchworm
how_to_1: Stand and hinge to put your hands on the floor.
how_to_2: Walk your hands out to a plank.
how_to_3: Walk the hands back and stand.
watch_for: Bending knees a lot. Sagging. Rushing.

name: Spiderman Lunge with Rotation
how_to_1: Step into a lunge with hands on the floor inside the front foot.
how_to_2: Rotate and reach the inside arm up to the ceiling.

name: Hip Circles
how_to_1: Stand with hands on hips.
how_to_2: Circle your hips in large circles.

name: Hip CARs (Controlled Articular Rotations)
how_to_1: Stand or kneel on all fours.
how_to_2: Slowly draw the largest circle possible with your knee, keeping the body still.
watch_for: Moving the pelvis. Rushing. Forcing range.

name: Shoulder CARs
how_to_1: Stand tall with fist clenched and body braced.
how_to_2: Slowly rotate the arm through its full circle.

name: Spine CARs
tags: Thoracic spine · Lower back · Mobility · Bodyweight
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Slowly roll down, sideways and back through the spine in a circle.

name: 90/90 Hip Switch
how_to_1: Sit with both knees bent at 90°, one in front and one to the side.
how_to_2: Rotate both knees to the other side.

name: Cossack Shift
how_to_1: Wide stance.
how_to_2: Shift into one leg into a deep side squat.

name: Deep Squat Hold (Goblet Prying)
how_to_1: Hold a weight at your chest and squat deep.
how_to_2: Use your elbows to gently push your knees apart.

name: Cat-Cow
tags: Thoracic spine · Lower back · Mobility · Bodyweight
how_to_1: On all fours.
how_to_2: Round your back up (cat), then let it sag and lift your head (cow).
watch_for: Rushing. Moving only the neck. Forcing.

name: Thread the Needle
how_to_1: On all fours.
how_to_2: Thread one arm under, resting shoulder down.

name: Open Book
how_to_1: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms out in front.
how_to_2: Open the top arm across to the other side, rotating your upper back.

name: Thoracic Rotation (Quadruped)
how_to_1: On all fours with one hand behind your head.
how_to_2: Rotate the elbow down then up toward the ceiling.

name: Wall Slides
how_to_1: Stand with your back against a wall, arms in a W.
how_to_2: Slide arms up the wall keeping contact.
watch_for: Arching off the wall. Shrugging. Forcing.

name: Scapular Push-Up
how_to_1: High plank with straight arms.
how_to_2: Let your shoulder blades come together, then push them apart.

name: Ankle Rocks (Knee-to-Wall)
how_to_1: Kneel facing a wall, front foot a few cm away.
how_to_2: Push the knee forward to touch the wall, heel down.

name: Lateral Lunge Stretch
how_to_1: Wide stance.
how_to_2: Shift into one leg and hold the stretch.

name: Walking Lunge with Overhead Reach
how_to_1: Walk forward into a lunge.
how_to_2: Reach both arms overhead.

name: Hip Opener (Gate Opener)
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Lift one knee and rotate it out to the side.

name: Hip Closer (Gate Closer)
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Lift the knee out to the side and rotate it in across the front.

name: Torso Twist
how_to_1: Stand with arms out.
how_to_2: Rotate gently side to side.

name: Jefferson Curl (Light)
how_to_1: Stand on a box holding a very light weight.
how_to_2: Roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.

name: Band Dislocates
how_to_1: Hold a band wide.
how_to_2: Raise it over your head and behind your back.
watch_for: Grip too narrow. Bending elbows. Arching.

name: Sun Salutation Flow
how_to_1: Stand at the top of the mat.
how_to_2: Flow through forward fold, plank, cobra/upward dog and downward dog.
watch_for: Rushing. Sagging in plank. Holding breath.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
how_to_1: Stand and place one heel slightly forward, toes up.
how_to_2: Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Bouncing. Locking the knee.

name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
how_to_1: Sit with one leg straight, other bent.
how_to_2: Hinge forward toward the straight leg's foot.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
how_to_1: Stand holding support.
how_to_2: Pull one heel to your glute, knees together.

name: Lying Quad Stretch
how_to_1: Lie on your side.
how_to_2: Pull the top heel toward your glute.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
how_to_1: Kneel in a half-kneeling position.
how_to_2: Squeeze the back glute and shift hips forward.
watch_for: Arching the back. Leaning forward. Forcing.

name: Couch Stretch
how_to_1: Kneel with the back shin up against a wall or couch.
how_to_2: Bring the front foot forward and lift your torso.

name: Pigeon Stretch
how_to_1: From plank, bring one knee forward behind the wrist, back leg straight.
how_to_2: Lower hips toward the floor.

name: Figure-4 (Supine Piriformis) Stretch
how_to_1: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the other knee.
how_to_2: Pull the bottom leg toward your chest.

name: Butterfly Stretch
how_to_1: Sit with soles of the feet together.
how_to_2: Gently press knees down and lean forward.

name: Frog Stretch
how_to_1: Kneel with knees wide, shins parallel.
how_to_2: Push hips back.

name: Straddle (Pancake) Stretch
how_to_1: Sit with legs wide.
how_to_2: Hinge forward from the hips.

name: Front Splits
how_to_1: From a lunge, slide the front leg forward and back leg back.
how_to_2: Lower as far as comfortable.

name: Middle Splits
how_to_1: Stand with legs wide.
how_to_2: Slide feet out to lower.

name: Calf Stretch (Wall)
how_to_1: Hands on a wall, one leg back straight.
how_to_2: Press the back heel down.
watch_for: Heel lifting. Bending back knee. Toes turned out.

name: Soleus Stretch
how_to_1: Same as calf stretch.
how_to_2: Bend the back knee with heel down.

name: Achilles Stretch
how_to_1: Stand with the ball of the foot on a step.
how_to_2: Lower the heel gently.

name: Glute Stretch (Seated Twist)
how_to_1: Sit with one leg crossed over the other.
how_to_2: Hug the knee and twist toward it.

name: IT Band Stretch
how_to_1: Stand and cross one leg behind the other.
how_to_2: Lean your hips to the side.

name: Adductor Stretch
how_to_1: Wide stance.
how_to_2: Shift into one side, other leg straight.

name: Child's Pose
how_to_1: Kneel and sit back on your heels.
how_to_2: Stretch arms forward and rest your forehead down.
watch_for: Forcing hips down. Shrugging. Holding breath.

name: Cobra Stretch
how_to_1: Lie face down, hands under shoulders.
how_to_2: Press up, lifting your chest, hips down.

name: Chest Doorway Stretch
how_to_1: Place forearms on a door frame.
how_to_2: Step forward until you feel a chest stretch.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
how_to_1: Bring one arm across your chest.
how_to_2: Pull it in with the other arm.

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
how_to_1: Raise one arm and bend the elbow behind your head.
how_to_2: Gently push the elbow down.
watch_for: Arching. Pushing the head forward. Forcing.

name: Sleeper Stretch
how_to_1: Lie on your side, bottom arm at 90°.
how_to_2: Gently press the forearm down.

name: Lat Stretch (Kneeling on Bench)
how_to_1: Kneel with elbows on a bench.
how_to_2: Sink your chest down.

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
how_to_1: Extend one arm, palm up.
how_to_2: Pull the fingers back gently.

name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
how_to_1: Extend one arm, palm down.
how_to_2: Pull the hand down gently.

name: Neck Side Stretch
how_to_1: Sit or stand tall.
how_to_2: Tilt your ear toward one shoulder.
watch_for: Shrugging. Forcing with the hand. Rushing.

name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
how_to_1: Turn your head 45° and look down toward your armpit.
how_to_2: Gently pull with the hand.

name: Upper Trap Stretch
how_to_1: Sit tall holding the chair edge.
how_to_2: Tilt head away.

name: Supine Spinal Twist
how_to_1: Lie on your back.
how_to_2: Bring one knee across your body, arm out.

name: Knee-to-Chest Stretch
how_to_1: Lie on your back.
how_to_2: Hug one or both knees to your chest.

name: Happy Baby
how_to_1: Lie on your back.
how_to_2: Hold the outsides of your feet, knees wide.

name: Tibialis Anterior Stretch
how_to_1: Kneel sitting on your heels with feet flat.
how_to_2: Lean back slightly.

name: Toe Stretch (Kneeling)
how_to_1: Kneel with toes tucked under.
how_to_2: Sit back on your heels.

name: Scorpion Stretch
how_to_1: Lie face down, arms out.
how_to_2: Swing one foot over toward the opposite hand.

name: Bretzel Stretch
tags: Hip flexors · Quads · Thoracic spine · Bodyweight
how_to_1: Lie on your side.
how_to_2: Hold the top knee down and the bottom foot back, rotating your chest open.

name: Lizard Stretch
how_to_1: Lunge forward with both hands inside the front foot.
how_to_2: Lower hips and forearms.

name: Foam Roll – Quads
how_to_1: Lie face down with the roller under your thighs.
how_to_2: Roll slowly from hip to just above the knee.
watch_for: Rolling over the knee. Rushing. Holding breath.

name: Foam Roll – Hamstrings
how_to_1: Sit with the roller under your thighs.
how_to_2: Roll from glutes to above the knee.
watch_for: Rolling the back of the knee. Rushing. Too much pressure.

name: Foam Roll – IT Band
how_to_1: Lie on your side with the roller under the outer thigh.
how_to_2: Roll from hip to above the knee.
watch_for: Rolling over the knee. Too much pressure. Rushing.

name: Foam Roll – Calves
how_to_1: Sit with the roller under your calves.
how_to_2: Roll from ankle to below the knee.
watch_for: Rolling the back of the knee. Rushing. Too much pressure.

name: Foam Roll – Glutes
how_to_1: Sit on the roller, cross one ankle over the other knee.
how_to_2: Roll the glute of the crossed leg.
watch_for: Rushing. Rolling the lower back. Too much pressure.

name: Foam Roll – Upper Back (Thoracic)
tags: Thoracic spine · Upper back · Foam roller
how_to_1: Lie with the roller under your upper back, hands behind head.
how_to_2: Roll from mid-back to shoulders.
watch_for: Rolling the lower back. Neck strain. Rushing.

name: Foam Roll – Lats
how_to_1: Lie on your side with the roller under your armpit.
how_to_2: Roll down the side of your back.
watch_for: Rushing. Rolling the ribs hard. Too much pressure.

name: Foam Roll – Adductors
how_to_1: Lie face down with one thigh out on the roller.
how_to_2: Roll along the inner thigh.
watch_for: Rushing. Too much pressure. Rolling the knee.

name: Lacrosse Ball – Pecs
how_to_1: Place a ball between your chest and a wall.
how_to_2: Lean in and roll small circles.
watch_for: Pressing on bone. Too much pressure. Rushing.

name: Lacrosse Ball – Plantar Fascia
how_to_1: Stand with a ball under your foot.
how_to_2: Roll it from heel to toes.
watch_for: Too much pressure. Rushing. Rolling the heel bone hard.

name: Lacrosse Ball – Glutes
how_to_1: Sit on a ball under one glute.
how_to_2: Roll small circles.
watch_for: Sitting on the sciatic nerve area painfully. Rushing. Too much pressure.

name: Peanut Ball – Thoracic Spine
how_to_1: Lie with a peanut ball under your upper back, spine in the gap.
how_to_2: Do small crunches or arm reaches over it.
how_to_3: Move up a segment and repeat.
watch_for: Rolling the neck. Rushing. Lower back.

name: Massage Gun Release
how_to_1: Turn on the massage gun at low speed.
how_to_2: Glide it over the muscle for 30–60 seconds.
watch_for: Using on bones or joints. Too long in one spot. High speed on sore areas.

name: PNF Stretching (Contract-Relax)
how_to_1: Stretch a muscle to a comfortable end range.
how_to_2: Contract it against resistance for 5–6 seconds.
how_to_3: Relax and stretch a little further.

name: Active Isolated Stretching
how_to_1: Contract the opposite muscle to move into a stretch.
how_to_2: Hold for about 2 seconds.

name: Diaphragmatic Breathing
how_to_1: Lie or sit with one hand on your chest and one on your belly.
how_to_2: Breathe in through the nose so the belly rises.

name: 90/90 Breathing
how_to_1: Lie with feet on a wall, hips and knees at 90°.
how_to_2: Breathe in through the nose, feeling the ribs expand.

name: Box Breathing
how_to_1: Sit comfortably.
how_to_2: Inhale 4 seconds, hold 4, exhale 4, hold 4.
watch_for: Straining on holds. Shallow breaths. Rushing.

name: Mountain Pose (Tadasana)
how_to_1: Stand with feet together or hip-width, arms by your sides.
how_to_2: Spread your weight evenly, lengthen your spine and relax your shoulders.
watch_for: Locking the knees. Leaning forward. Holding breath.

name: Chair Pose (Utkatasana)
how_to_1: Stand with feet together.
how_to_2: Bend knees and sit back, arms raised overhead.
watch_for: Knees past toes. Arching the lower back. Shrugging.

name: Warrior 1 (Virabhadrasana I)
tags: Quads · Hip flexors · Shoulders · Yoga mat
how_to_1: Step one foot back and angle it 45°.
how_to_2: Bend the front knee over the ankle, hips facing forward, arms up.
watch_for: Front knee caving. Arching. Back heel lifting.

name: Warrior 2 (Virabhadrasana II)
how_to_1: Step feet wide, front foot forward, back foot parallel to the mat edge.
how_to_2: Bend the front knee and extend arms out at shoulder height.
how_to_3: Gaze over the front hand and hold.

name: Warrior 3 (Virabhadrasana III)
how_to_1: Stand on one leg.
how_to_2: Hinge forward, lifting the back leg until body is parallel to the floor.
watch_for: Hips opening. Rounding. Locking the knee.

name: Reverse Warrior
how_to_1: From Warrior II.
how_to_2: Slide the back hand down the back leg and reach the front arm overhead.

name: Triangle (Trikonasana)
how_to_1: Feet wide, front foot forward.
how_to_2: Reach forward then lower the front hand to the shin or block, top arm up.
watch_for: Rounding. Locking knee. Collapsing the side.

name: Revolved Triangle
how_to_1: Feet in a shorter stance.
how_to_2: Hinge and rotate, placing the opposite hand down, top arm up.

name: Extended Side Angle
how_to_1: From Warrior II.
how_to_2: Rest the front forearm on the thigh or hand down, reach top arm over the ear.

name: Revolved Side Angle
how_to_1: From a high lunge.
how_to_2: Twist and hook the elbow outside the front knee, palms together.

name: Half Moon (Ardha Chandrasana)
tags: Glute medius · Balance · Obliques · Yoga mat
how_to_1: From triangle, shift onto the front leg.
how_to_2: Lift the back leg parallel to the floor, open hips and reach top arm up.
watch_for: Hips closing. Locking knee. Losing balance.

name: Tree Pose (Vrksasana)
how_to_1: Stand on one leg.
how_to_2: Place the other foot on the inner calf or thigh (not the knee), hands at heart or overhead.
watch_for: Foot on the knee. Leaning. Holding breath.

name: Eagle Pose (Garudasana)
how_to_1: Bend knees slightly and wrap one leg around the other.
how_to_2: Wrap the arms the same way and lift the elbows.

name: Dancer's Pose (Natarajasana)
how_to_1: Stand on one leg and hold the other foot behind you.
how_to_2: Kick the foot into your hand and lean forward, reaching the free arm.
watch_for: Arching the lower back. Losing balance. Forcing.

name: Standing Forward Fold (Uttanasana)
how_to_1: Stand with feet hip-width.
how_to_2: Hinge at the hips and fold forward, knees soft.
watch_for: Forcing straight legs. Rounding hard. Bouncing.

name: Wide-Legged Forward Fold
how_to_1: Stand with feet wide.
how_to_2: Fold forward from the hips.

name: Pyramid Pose (Parsvottanasana)
how_to_1: Stand with one foot forward, hips square.
how_to_2: Fold over the front leg.

name: Goddess Pose
how_to_1: Stand wide with toes turned out.
how_to_2: Bend knees deeply, arms in a cactus shape.

name: Garland Pose (Malasana)
tags: Hips · Ankles & feet · Adductors · Yoga mat
how_to_1: Squat deep with feet close and toes out.
how_to_2: Bring palms together, elbows pressing knees apart.

name: High Lunge
how_to_1: Step into a lunge on the back toes.
how_to_2: Raise arms overhead.
watch_for: Knee caving. Arching. Back knee locking.

name: Low Lunge (Anjaneyasana)
how_to_1: Lunge with the back knee on the mat.
how_to_2: Sink hips forward and raise arms.

name: Crescent Lunge
tags: Quads · Hip flexors · Shoulders · Yoga mat
how_to_1: High lunge with arms overhead.
how_to_2: Lift the chest and sink hips.

name: Extended Hand-to-Big-Toe Pose
how_to_1: Stand on one leg.
how_to_2: Hold the big toe of the other leg and extend it forward.
watch_for: Rounding. Bending standing knee. Losing balance.

name: Standing Split
how_to_1: From a forward fold.
how_to_2: Lift one leg high behind you.

name: Downward-Facing Dog
how_to_1: Start on all fours.
how_to_2: Lift your hips up and back into an inverted V, pressing heels toward the floor.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Shrugging. Locking knees.

name: Upward-Facing Dog
how_to_1: Lie face down, hands beside the ribs.
how_to_2: Press up to straight arms, lifting thighs off the floor.
watch_for: Shrugging. Hips on the floor. Crunching the lower back.

name: Cobra (Bhujangasana)
how_to_1: Lie face down, hands under shoulders.
how_to_2: Lift your chest using the back, elbows bent.
watch_for: Shrugging. Pushing with arms only. Forcing.

name: Sphinx Pose
how_to_1: Lie face down on forearms.
how_to_2: Lift the chest.

name: Chaturanga
how_to_1: From plank, shift slightly forward.
how_to_2: Lower until elbows are at 90°, tucked by your ribs.
watch_for: Sagging. Elbows flaring. Dropping too low.

name: Plank Pose
how_to_1: Hands under shoulders, body straight.
how_to_2: Hold.

name: Side Plank (Vasisthasana)
how_to_1: From plank, roll onto one hand and the side of one foot.
how_to_2: Stack feet and lift the top arm.

name: Child's Pose (Balasana)
how_to_1: Kneel and sit back on your heels.
how_to_2: Fold forward, arms extended or by your sides.

name: Cat-Cow (Marjaryasana-Bitilasana)
tags: Thoracic spine · Lower back · Yoga mat
how_to_1: On all fours.
how_to_2: Inhale into cow (back dips), exhale into cat (back rounds).

name: Staff Pose (Dandasana)
how_to_1: Sit with legs straight forward.
how_to_2: Sit tall, hands beside hips, flex the feet.

name: Seated Forward Bend (Paschimottanasana)
how_to_1: Sit with legs straight.
how_to_2: Hinge forward from the hips reaching for your feet.

name: Head-to-Knee (Janu Sirsasana)
how_to_1: Sit with one leg straight and the other foot on the inner thigh.
how_to_2: Fold over the straight leg.

name: Bound Angle (Baddha Konasana)
how_to_1: Sit with soles together.
how_to_2: Sit tall and gently fold forward.

name: Cow Face (Gomukhasana)
how_to_1: Sit with knees stacked.
how_to_2: Reach one arm up and the other behind to clasp hands.

name: Hero Pose (Virasana)
how_to_1: Kneel and sit between your heels (or on a block).
how_to_2: Sit tall.

name: Lotus (Padmasana)
how_to_1: Sit and place each foot on the opposite thigh.
how_to_2: Sit tall.
watch_for: Forcing the knees. Knee pain — use half lotus instead. Rounding.

name: Easy Pose (Sukhasana)
how_to_1: Sit cross-legged.
how_to_2: Sit tall with hands on knees.

name: Half Lord of the Fishes (Ardha Matsyendrasana)
how_to_1: Sit and cross one foot over the opposite knee.
how_to_2: Twist toward the raised knee.
watch_for: Rounding. Forcing with the arm. Holding breath.

name: Boat Pose (Navasana)
how_to_1: Sit and lean back slightly.
how_to_2: Lift your legs so the body forms a V.
watch_for: Rounding the back. Holding breath. Shrugging.

name: Pigeon (Eka Pada Rajakapotasana)
tags: Glutes · Hips · Hip flexors · Yoga mat
how_to_1: Bring one shin forward and extend the other leg back.
how_to_2: Lower hips and fold forward if comfortable.

name: Camel (Ustrasana)
tags: Hip flexors · Abs · Chest · Yoga mat
how_to_1: Kneel with hips over knees.
how_to_2: Lean back reaching for your heels, hips forward.
watch_for: Crunching the lower back. Forcing. Neck dropping hard.

name: Bridge (Setu Bandha)
tags: Glutes · Hamstrings · Lower back · Resistance band
how_to_1: Lie on your back, knees bent.
how_to_2: Lift your hips and clasp hands under you.

name: Wheel (Urdhva Dhanurasana)
tags: Shoulders · Lower back · Hip flexors · Yoga mat
how_to_1: Lie with hands by ears, feet flat.
how_to_2: Press up into a full backbend.

name: Bow (Dhanurasana)
tags: Lower back · Quads · Chest · Yoga mat
how_to_1: Lie face down and hold your ankles.
how_to_2: Kick feet into hands to lift chest and thighs.

name: Locust (Salabhasana)
how_to_1: Lie face down, arms by sides.
how_to_2: Lift chest, arms and legs.
watch_for: Overarching neck. Holding breath. Bending knees.

name: Fish (Matsyasana)
how_to_1: Lie on your back, hands under hips.
how_to_2: Lift your chest and lightly rest the crown of the head.
watch_for: Weight on the head. Neck strain. Forcing.

name: Plow (Halasana)
tags: Lower back · Hamstrings · Neck · Yoga mat
how_to_1: From shoulder stand.
how_to_2: Lower your feet over your head to the floor.
watch_for: Neck strain. Turning the head. Forcing.

name: Shoulder Stand (Sarvangasana)
how_to_1: Lie on your back.
how_to_2: Lift legs and hips, supporting your back with hands.
watch_for: Weight on the neck. Turning the head. Rushing.

name: Headstand (Sirsasana)
how_to_1: Interlace fingers and place the crown of the head down.
how_to_2: Walk feet in and lift legs up.
watch_for: Weight on the neck. Kicking up. Arching.

name: Forearm Stand (Pincha Mayurasana)
how_to_1: Place forearms on the floor.
how_to_2: Kick or press up into an inverted balance.

name: Handstand (Adho Mukha Vrksasana)
how_to_1: Place hands down near a wall.
how_to_2: Kick up and stack your body.

name: Crow (Bakasana)
how_to_1: Squat with hands down, knees on the upper arms.
how_to_2: Lean forward until feet lift.
watch_for: Falling forward. Wrist strain. Looking down.

name: Side Crow
how_to_1: Squat and twist, placing hands beside one hip.
how_to_2: Rest the knees on one arm and lean forward.

name: Firefly (Tittibhasana)
how_to_1: Squat with hands behind your heels.
how_to_2: Lean back and extend your legs forward over the arms.

name: Eight-Angle Pose
how_to_1: Hook one leg over the arm and cross the ankles.
how_to_2: Lean forward and extend legs sideways.

name: Peacock (Mayurasana)
how_to_1: Kneel with hands pointing back, elbows into your belly.
how_to_2: Lean forward and lift your legs.

name: Reclined Bound Angle
how_to_1: Lie on your back with soles together.
how_to_2: Let knees fall open.
watch_for: Forcing. Lower back arching. Holding breath.

name: Happy Baby (Ananda Balasana)
how_to_1: Lie on your back and hold the outsides of your feet.
how_to_2: Knees wide toward armpits.
watch_for: Lifting the head. Forcing. Tail lifting.

name: Legs-Up-the-Wall (Viparita Karani)
how_to_1: Lie with your hips near a wall.
how_to_2: Rest your legs up the wall.
watch_for: Hips too far away. Forcing. Holding breath.

name: Supine Twist
how_to_1: Lie on your back.
how_to_2: Bring one knee across the body.

name: Corpse Pose (Savasana)
how_to_1: Lie flat with arms and legs relaxed.
how_to_2: Close your eyes and breathe naturally.

name: Wild Thing
tags: Chest · Shoulders · Lower back · Yoga mat
how_to_1: From downward dog, lift one leg and flip onto that foot.
how_to_2: Arch your back and reach the arm overhead.

name: Reverse Table Top
how_to_1: Sit with hands behind you and knees bent.
how_to_2: Lift your hips into a table shape.

name: Upward Plank (Purvottanasana)
how_to_1: Sit with legs straight, hands behind.
how_to_2: Lift hips into a straight line.

name: Gate Pose
how_to_1: Kneel and extend one leg to the side.
how_to_2: Side-bend over the extended leg.

name: Monkey Pose (Hanumanasana)
how_to_1: From a low lunge.
how_to_2: Slide into front splits, using blocks.

name: Lizard Pose
how_to_1: Low lunge with hands inside the front foot.
how_to_2: Lower forearms if possible.

name: Thread the Needle
how_to_1: On all fours.
how_to_2: Thread one arm under, resting shoulder down.

name: Surya Namaskar A (Sun Salutation A)
how_to_1: Stand in Mountain Pose.
how_to_2: Flow: arms up, fold, half lift, plank, chaturanga, upward dog, downward dog.
how_to_3: Step forward and rise back to standing.
watch_for: Rushing. Sagging in chaturanga. Holding breath.

name: Surya Namaskar B
how_to_1: Start in Chair Pose.
how_to_2: Flow through chaturanga, upward dog and downward dog with Warrior I on each side.
watch_for: Rushing. Knee caving in Warrior. Holding breath.

name: Chandra Namaskar (Moon Salutation)
how_to_1: Stand tall.
how_to_2: Flow through side bends, goddess, triangle, lunges and back.

name: Vinyasa Flow
how_to_1: Link poses with breath.
how_to_2: Move through a sequence, one breath per movement.

name: Ashtanga Primary Series
how_to_1: Follow the set Ashtanga sequence.
how_to_2: Move with breath through standing, seated and finishing poses.

name: Yin Yoga Holds
how_to_1: Choose a passive floor pose.
how_to_2: Relax into it for 3–5 minutes.
watch_for: Forcing. Holding too long early. Bouncing.

name: Kapalbhati
how_to_1: Sit tall.
how_to_2: Exhale forcefully through the nose by snapping the belly in; inhale passively.
watch_for: Straining. Dizziness — stop if felt. Moving the shoulders.

name: Anulom Vilom (Alternate Nostril)
how_to_1: Sit tall, right hand near the nose.
how_to_2: Inhale through one nostril while closing the other.
how_to_3: Exhale through the opposite nostril and alternate.

name: Bhastrika
how_to_1: Sit tall.
how_to_2: Breathe in and out forcefully through the nose with equal effort.

name: Bhramari
how_to_1: Sit tall, close your ears with your thumbs.
how_to_2: Inhale deeply.
how_to_3: Exhale making a humming bee sound.
watch_for: Pressing ears too hard. Rushing. Straining.

name: Ujjayi Breath
how_to_1: Sit or move in poses.
how_to_2: Slightly constrict the throat and breathe through the nose with an ocean sound.
watch_for: Straining the throat. Breathing through the mouth. Rushing.

name: Sheetali
how_to_1: Sit tall and curl your tongue into a tube.
how_to_2: Inhale through the tongue.
how_to_3: Close the mouth and exhale through the nose.

name: The Hundred
how_to_1: Lie on your back, legs in tabletop or extended, head and shoulders lifted.
how_to_2: Pump your straight arms up and down.
how_to_3: Breathe in for 5 pumps and out for 5, for 100 pumps.
watch_for: Neck straining. Lower back arching. Legs too low.

name: Roll-Up
how_to_1: Lie flat with arms overhead.
how_to_2: Roll up one vertebra at a time to reach toward your toes.

name: Roll-Over
how_to_1: Lie flat with legs up.
how_to_2: Roll your legs over your head, then open and lower.

name: Single-Leg Circles
how_to_1: Lie flat with one leg up.
how_to_2: Circle the leg keeping the pelvis still.

name: Rolling Like a Ball
how_to_1: Sit in a tight ball holding your shins.
how_to_2: Roll back to the shoulder blades.
watch_for: Rolling onto the neck. Losing the shape. Rushing.

name: Single-Leg Stretch
how_to_1: Lie with head lifted, one knee in.
how_to_2: Switch legs, pulling the other knee in.

name: Double-Leg Stretch
how_to_1: Lie with head lifted, knees in.
how_to_2: Extend arms and legs out together.
how_to_3: Circle the arms back and pull knees in.
watch_for: Arching. Neck strain. Legs too low.

name: Single Straight-Leg Stretch (Scissors)
how_to_1: Lie with head lifted, legs straight up.
how_to_2: Pull one leg toward you while lowering the other.

name: Double Straight-Leg Stretch (Lower Lift)
how_to_1: Lie with hands behind head, legs straight up.
how_to_2: Lower legs slowly.
watch_for: Lower back arching. Neck pulling. Too low.

name: Criss-Cross (Pilates)
how_to_1: Lie with hands behind head.
how_to_2: Rotate elbow toward the opposite knee, extending the other leg.

name: Spine Stretch Forward
how_to_1: Sit tall with legs wide.
how_to_2: Round forward, reaching between the legs.

name: Open-Leg Rocker
how_to_1: Balance holding ankles, legs in a V.
how_to_2: Roll back.
watch_for: Rolling onto neck. Bending knees. Rushing.

name: Corkscrew
how_to_1: Lie with legs up.
how_to_2: Circle legs to one side, down and around.

name: Saw
how_to_1: Sit with legs wide, arms out.
how_to_2: Twist and reach to the opposite foot.

name: Swan Dive
how_to_1: Lie face down.
how_to_2: Press up into extension, then rock forward.
watch_for: Crunching the lower back. Forcing. Rushing.

name: Single-Leg Kick
how_to_1: Lie on forearms face down.
how_to_2: Kick one heel to the glute twice.

name: Double-Leg Kick
tags: Hamstrings · Lower back · Upper back · Mat
how_to_1: Lie face down, hands behind your back.
how_to_2: Kick both heels three times.

name: Neck Pull
how_to_1: Lie with hands behind head.
how_to_2: Roll up and forward.
watch_for: Pulling the neck. Using momentum. Feet lifting.

name: Jackknife (Pilates)
how_to_1: Lie flat.
how_to_2: Roll legs overhead, then press them to the ceiling.

name: Side Kick Series
how_to_1: Lie on your side.
how_to_2: Kick the top leg forward and back, up and down.

name: Teaser
how_to_1: Lie flat.
how_to_2: Roll up into a V, arms parallel to legs.

name: Hip Circles (Pilates)
how_to_1: Sit with hands behind you, legs up.
how_to_2: Circle the legs in a wide arc.

name: Swimming (Pilates)
how_to_1: Lie face down.
how_to_2: Lift and flutter opposite arms and legs.

name: Leg Pull Front
how_to_1: High plank.
how_to_2: Lift one leg.

name: Leg Pull Back
how_to_1: Reverse plank.
how_to_2: Kick one leg up.

name: Kneeling Side Kick
how_to_1: Kneel with one hand down and the other leg extended.
how_to_2: Kick the leg forward and back.

name: Side Bend (Mermaid)
how_to_1: Sit with legs to one side.
how_to_2: Reach the arm overhead and bend.

name: Boomerang
how_to_1: Sit with legs crossed.
how_to_2: Roll back, switch crossed legs, roll up into teaser.

name: Seal
how_to_1: Sit balancing in a ball, hands through legs holding ankles.
how_to_2: Clap feet, roll back and up.
watch_for: Rolling onto the neck. Rushing. Losing shape.

name: Control Balance
how_to_1: Roll over with legs overhead.
how_to_2: Hold one foot and lift the other leg.

name: Push-Up (Pilates)
how_to_1: Stand and roll down to the floor.
how_to_2: Walk out to plank and do push-ups.

name: Shoulder Bridge
how_to_1: Lie on your back and bridge up.
how_to_2: Lift one leg and kick it up and down.

name: Spine Twist
how_to_1: Sit tall with legs together, arms out.
how_to_2: Twist to one side.

name: Pelvic Curl
how_to_1: Lie with knees bent.
how_to_2: Curl the pelvis and roll the spine up to a bridge.
how_to_3: Roll down one vertebra at a time.

name: Chest Lift
how_to_1: Lie with hands behind head.
how_to_2: Lift the head and shoulders.

name: Toe Taps (Pilates)
how_to_1: Lie with legs in tabletop.
how_to_2: Lower one toe to tap the floor.

name: Clam (Pilates)
how_to_1: Lie on your side, knees bent.
how_to_2: Open the top knee.

name: Reformer Footwork
how_to_1: Lie on the reformer carriage with feet on the footbar.
how_to_2: Press the carriage out by straightening the legs.
watch_for: Locking knees. Carriage slamming. Lifting hips.

name: Reformer Hundred
how_to_1: Lie on the carriage holding straps.
how_to_2: Lift the head and pump the arms.
watch_for: Neck strain. Arching. Legs too low.

name: Reformer Long Stretch
how_to_1: Plank with hands on the footbar, feet on the shoulder rest.
how_to_2: Push the carriage back.

name: Reformer Elephant
how_to_1: Hands on the footbar, feet on the carriage, hips high.
how_to_2: Push the carriage back with the legs.
how_to_3: Pull it in with the abs.

name: Reformer Knee Stretches
how_to_1: Kneel on the carriage, hands on the footbar.
how_to_2: Push the carriage back with the knees.

name: Reformer Rowing Series
how_to_1: Sit on the carriage holding straps.
how_to_2: Perform rowing arm patterns.

name: Reformer Short Box Series
how_to_1: Sit on the short box with feet under the strap.
how_to_2: Round back, flat back, twist and side reach.

name: Reformer Long Box Pulling Straps
tags: Upper back · Lower back · Plyo box
how_to_1: Lie face down on the long box holding straps.
how_to_2: Pull straps back, lifting the chest.

name: Reformer Feet in Straps
how_to_1: Lie with feet in straps.
how_to_2: Perform frogs, circles and openings.

name: Reformer Stomach Massage
how_to_1: Sit on the carriage with feet on the footbar.
how_to_2: Press the carriage out and in with a rounded back.

name: Reformer Running
how_to_1: Lie with feet on the footbar.
how_to_2: Alternate lowering heels like running.

name: Reformer Side Splits
how_to_1: Stand on the carriage and platform.
how_to_2: Slide the carriage out into a straddle.

name: Reformer Front Splits
tags: Hip flexors · Hamstrings · Balance · Pilates reformer
how_to_1: Kneel or stand in a split stance on the reformer.
how_to_2: Slide into a split.

name: Reformer Snake/Twist
how_to_1: Kneel or stand on the carriage, hands on the footbar.
how_to_2: Twist and lift into an arch.

name: Cadillac Roll-Back Bar
how_to_1: Sit holding the roll-back bar.
how_to_2: Roll back against the springs.

name: Cadillac Leg Springs
how_to_1: Lie with feet in leg springs.
how_to_2: Do circles, frogs and beats.

name: Wunda Chair Footwork
how_to_1: Sit on the chair with feet on the pedal.
how_to_2: Press the pedal down and up.

name: Wunda Chair Pike
how_to_1: Hands on the pedal, standing on the chair.
how_to_2: Lift hips into a pike as the pedal presses.

name: Ladder Barrel Swan
how_to_1: Lie face down over the barrel, feet on the ladder.
how_to_2: Lift into extension.

name: Magic Circle Inner-Thigh Squeeze
how_to_1: Place the ring between your thighs.
how_to_2: Squeeze it together.

name: Zumba
how_to_1: Join a class or follow a video.
how_to_2: Follow Latin-inspired dance steps to the music.
how_to_3: Keep moving for the session, matching your own intensity.
watch_for: Twisting on a planted foot. Skipping warm-up. Overdoing jumps early.

name: Aerobics (High-Impact)
how_to_1: Warm up with low-impact moves.
how_to_2: Follow jumping and running-based routines to music.
watch_for: Heavy landings. Locking knees. No warm-up.

name: Aerobics (Low-Impact)
how_to_1: Warm up.
how_to_2: Follow steps with one foot always on the floor.

name: Step Aerobics
how_to_1: Set the step to a suitable height.
how_to_2: Follow step patterns to the beat.
watch_for: Stepping on the edge. Step too high. Looking down.

name: Spin / Indoor Cycling Class
how_to_1: Set up the bike correctly.
how_to_2: Follow the instructor's cadence and resistance cues.
watch_for: Poor bike setup. Too little resistance standing. Bouncing.

name: Body Pump
how_to_1: Set up a barbell, plates and step.
how_to_2: Follow the high-rep barbell tracks to music.
how_to_3: Choose weights you can control for the full track.
watch_for: Too heavy. Sloppy form. Skipping tracks.

name: Body Combat
how_to_1: Follow the martial-arts inspired class.
how_to_2: Punch, kick and move to the music.
watch_for: Locking elbows. Dropping hands. Overextending kicks.

name: Body Attack
how_to_1: Follow the sports-inspired cardio class.
how_to_2: Perform running, jumping and strength moves.

name: Body Balance
how_to_1: Follow the yoga/tai chi/Pilates blend.
how_to_2: Move through flowing poses with breath.

name: Body Jam
how_to_1: Follow the dance class.
how_to_2: Learn and perform dance combinations.
watch_for: Twisting on planted feet. Rushing. No warm-up.

name: Bollywood Dance Fitness
how_to_1: Follow a Bollywood dance routine.
how_to_2: Perform energetic steps and arm movements.
watch_for: Twisting knees. Skipping warm-up. Overdoing jumps.

name: Bhangra Fitness
how_to_1: Follow a Bhangra routine.
how_to_2: Perform bouncing steps with raised arms.

name: Hip-Hop Dance Workout
how_to_1: Follow a hip-hop routine.
how_to_2: Perform grooves and combinations.

name: Jazzercise
how_to_1: Follow the Jazzercise class.
how_to_2: Combine dance, Pilates and strength moves.

name: Barre
how_to_1: Stand at a barre.
how_to_2: Perform small, controlled ballet-inspired pulses and holds.
watch_for: Locking knees. Arching. Gripping the barre.

name: Piloxing
how_to_1: Follow the class.
how_to_2: Combine Pilates, boxing and dance.

name: Tabata Class
how_to_1: Follow the instructor.
how_to_2: Work 20 s on, 10 s off for each block.
watch_for: Sloppy form. Going too hard. No warm-up.

name: Bootcamp
how_to_1: Join a group session.
how_to_2: Perform circuits of strength and cardio drills.
watch_for: Sloppy form. Ignoring modifications. No warm-up.

name: Circuit Training
how_to_1: Set up several stations.
how_to_2: Move through each station for a set time or reps.

name: Aqua Aerobics
how_to_1: Stand in chest-deep water.
how_to_2: Follow aerobic moves using water resistance.

name: Aqua Zumba
how_to_1: Stand in shallow water.
how_to_2: Dance Zumba moves in the pool.

name: Kickboxing Class
how_to_1: Wear wraps and gloves if used.
how_to_2: Follow punch and kick combinations.

name: Pole Fitness
how_to_1: Warm up wrists and shoulders.
how_to_2: Learn spins, climbs and holds on the pole.
watch_for: Skipping warm-up. Grip slipping. Advanced moves too soon.

name: Aerial Yoga
how_to_1: Set up the hammock at the right height.
how_to_2: Perform supported yoga poses and inversions.
watch_for: Inverting too long. Poor setup. Rushing.

name: Aerial Silks
how_to_1: Learn basic climbs with an instructor.
how_to_2: Perform wraps, climbs and drops.
watch_for: Training without a mat or instructor. Grip fatigue. Advanced drops early.

name: Trampoline Fitness (Rebounding)
how_to_1: Stand on a mini trampoline.
how_to_2: Bounce, jog and jump to a routine.
watch_for: Bouncing off the edge. Locking knees. Too high.

name: Salsa / Latin Dance
how_to_1: Learn the basic step.
how_to_2: Dance with a partner or solo to the rhythm.

name: Ballet Fitness
how_to_1: Hold a barre or chair.
how_to_2: Perform pliés, tendus and relevés.

name: Hula Hoop Fitness
how_to_1: Use a weighted fitness hoop.
how_to_2: Spin it at your waist by shifting your hips.
watch_for: Too heavy a hoop. Bruising. Rushing.

name: Kangoo Jumps
how_to_1: Wear Kangoo rebound boots.
how_to_2: Bounce, jog and dance to the routine.
watch_for: Losing balance. Locking knees. Too intense early.

name: Strong Nation
how_to_1: Follow the class.
how_to_2: Do HIIT moves synced to music.
watch_for: Sloppy form. Heavy landings. No warm-up.

name: Les Mills Grit
how_to_1: Follow the 30-minute class.
how_to_2: Perform high-intensity intervals.
watch_for: Going too hard. Sloppy form. No modifications.

name: F45-Style Session
how_to_1: Join the station-based class.
how_to_2: Rotate through timed stations.

name: Orangetheory-Style Session
how_to_1: Wear a heart-rate monitor.
how_to_2: Rotate between treadmill, rower and floor blocks.
watch_for: Chasing heart rate with poor form. Skipping warm-up. Too hard.

name: Prenatal Fitness Class
how_to_1: Get clearance from your doctor first.
how_to_2: Follow a class with pregnancy-safe modifications.
watch_for: Lying flat for long after the first trimester without advice. Overheating. Pushing through discomfort.

name: Senior Chair Exercise
how_to_1: Sit on a stable chair.
how_to_2: Follow seated strength, mobility and cardio moves.

name: Freestyle (Front Crawl)
how_to_1: Float face down with a long, straight body.
how_to_2: Alternate arm strokes while kicking from the hips, rotating to breathe to the side.
watch_for: Lifting the head to breathe. Crossing arms over the centre. Kicking from the knees.

name: Backstroke
how_to_1: Float on your back with ears in the water.
how_to_2: Alternate straight-arm strokes with a steady flutter kick.
how_to_3: Rotate the body with each stroke.
watch_for: Sitting in the water. Bending knees too much. Arms crossing.

name: Breaststroke
how_to_1: Float face down.
how_to_2: Sweep arms out and in, then whip-kick the legs.
how_to_3: Glide with arms extended before the next stroke.
watch_for: Lifting head too high. Scissor kick. No glide.

name: Butterfly
how_to_1: Float face down.
how_to_2: Pull both arms together while doing a dolphin kick.
how_to_3: Breathe forward as the arms recover.
watch_for: Lifting head too high. Late kick. Flat body.

name: Sidestroke
how_to_1: Lie on your side in the water.
how_to_2: Pull with the lower arm and scissor kick.

name: Elementary Backstroke
how_to_1: Float on your back.
how_to_2: Bring arms up along your sides and push out, with a frog kick.

name: Treading Water
how_to_1: Stay upright in deep water.
how_to_2: Scull with your hands and eggbeater or scissor kick.
watch_for: Panicking. Using only arms. Fatigue — stay near the edge.

name: Kickboard Kicks
tags: Cardio · Quads · Hip flexors · Swimming pool
how_to_1: Hold a kickboard with arms extended.
how_to_2: Flutter kick from the hips.
watch_for: Kicking from the knees. Head lifted. Bending arms.

name: Pull Buoy Swim
how_to_1: Place a pull buoy between your thighs.
how_to_2: Swim freestyle using only your arms.

name: Underwater Swim
how_to_1: Push off the wall underwater.
how_to_2: Glide and kick underwater.
watch_for: Hyperventilating before. Swimming alone. Going too far.

name: Flip Turns
how_to_1: Approach the wall swimming freestyle.
how_to_2: Tuck and somersault, pushing off with your feet.
watch_for: Too close or far from the wall. Breathing in water. No streamline.

name: Water Jogging (Deep-Water Running)
how_to_1: Wear a flotation belt in deep water.
how_to_2: Mimic running form without touching the bottom.
watch_for: Leaning forward. Paddling with hands. Short strides.

name: Water Walking
how_to_1: Stand in waist- to chest-deep water.
how_to_2: Walk forward with long strides.

name: Aqua Jumping Jacks
how_to_1: Stand in chest-deep water.
how_to_2: Perform jumping jacks.

name: Pool Push-Ups (Edge)
how_to_1: Place hands on the pool edge.
how_to_2: Lower and push up out of the water.

name: Pool Leg Swings
tags: Hip flexors · Hamstrings · Mobility · Swimming pool
how_to_1: Hold the pool edge.
how_to_2: Swing one leg forward and back.

name: Aqua Dumbbell Curls
how_to_1: Hold foam aqua dumbbells underwater.
how_to_2: Curl them up against the water.

name: Flutter Kick (Pool Edge)
tags: Cardio · Quads · Hip flexors · Swimming pool
how_to_1: Hold the pool edge face down.
how_to_2: Flutter kick from the hips.
watch_for: Kicking from the knees. Arching. Rushing.

name: Water Squat Jumps
how_to_1: Stand in chest-deep water.
how_to_2: Squat and jump up.

name: Noodle Cycling
how_to_1: Sit on a pool noodle in deep water.
how_to_2: Pedal your legs as if cycling.

name: Chin Tuck
how_to_1: Sit or stand tall.
how_to_2: Pull your chin straight back, making a double chin.
watch_for: Tilting the head down. Forcing. Rushing.

name: Scapular Retraction
how_to_1: Sit or stand tall.
how_to_2: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and down.

name: Scapular Wall Slide
how_to_1: Back against a wall, arms in a W.
how_to_2: Slide arms up keeping contact.

name: Prone I-Y-T Raise
muscles_worked: Rear delts · Upper back · Rotator cuff
tags: Rear delts · Upper back · Rotator cuff · Bodyweight
how_to_1: Lie face down.
how_to_2: Lift arms in I, Y and T shapes.

name: Serratus Wall Slide
how_to_1: Forearms on a wall, a foam roller under them.
how_to_2: Slide up the wall while pushing into it.

name: Serratus Punch
how_to_1: Lie on your back holding a light weight up.
how_to_2: Punch it toward the ceiling, lifting the shoulder blade.
watch_for: Bending the elbow. Rushing. Too heavy.

name: Band External Rotation (Rotator Cuff)
how_to_1: Elbow at side, band anchored beside you.
how_to_2: Rotate the forearm outward.
watch_for: Elbow leaving the side. Too much tension. Twisting.

name: Sleeper Stretch
how_to_1: Lie on your side, bottom arm at 90°.
how_to_2: Gently press the forearm down.

name: Pendulum Swing (Codman)
how_to_1: Lean forward supporting yourself with one hand.
how_to_2: Let the other arm hang and swing it in small circles.
watch_for: Using muscles to swing. Big circles. Rushing.

name: Clamshell
how_to_1: Lie on your side, knees bent, feet together.
how_to_2: Lift the top knee while keeping feet together.
watch_for: Rolling the hips back. Rushing. Feet separating.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
how_to_1: Lie on your side.
how_to_2: Lift the top leg slightly behind the body.
watch_for: Rolling back. Swinging. Toes pointing up.

name: Glute Bridge
how_to_1: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
how_to_2: Lift your hips until body is straight from shoulders to knees.
watch_for: Arching the back. Feet too far. Rushing.

name: Bird Dog
how_to_1: On hands and knees.
how_to_2: Extend opposite arm and leg out straight.

name: Dead Bug
how_to_1: Lie on your back, arms up, knees at 90°.
how_to_2: Extend opposite arm and leg out while keeping lower back flat.
watch_for: Lower back arching. Rushing. Holding breath.

name: McGill Curl-Up
how_to_1: Lie on your back with one knee bent, hands under your lower back to keep its natural curve.
how_to_2: Lift head and shoulders slightly as one unit, without flattening the back.
watch_for: Tucking the chin. Flattening the lower back. Lifting too high.

name: McGill Side Bridge
how_to_1: Lie on your side on one forearm, knees bent or legs straight.
how_to_2: Lift your hips so the body is straight.
how_to_3: Hold 8–10 seconds and lower; repeat and switch.
watch_for: Hips dropping. Rolling forward. Holding breath.

name: Pelvic Tilt
how_to_1: Lie on your back with knees bent.
how_to_2: Flatten your lower back into the floor by tilting the pelvis.

name: Heel Slide
how_to_1: Lie on your back with legs straight.
how_to_2: Slide one heel toward your glute.

name: Quad Set
how_to_1: Sit with leg straight.
how_to_2: Tighten the thigh, pushing the knee down.
watch_for: Holding breath. Lifting the heel. Rushing.

name: Straight Leg Raise
how_to_1: Lie with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
how_to_2: Tighten the thigh and lift the straight leg to the other knee's height.

name: Terminal Knee Extension
how_to_1: Loop a band behind the knee, anchored in front.
how_to_2: Straighten the knee fully against the band.
watch_for: Moving the hip. Rushing. Too little tension.

name: Short-Arc Quad
how_to_1: Lie with a rolled towel under the knee.
how_to_2: Straighten the knee lifting the heel.

name: Spanish Squat
how_to_1: Loop a band behind both knees, anchored in front.
how_to_2: Sit back into a squat with shins vertical.
watch_for: Knees moving forward. Rounding. Band slipping.

name: Step-Down (Eccentric)
how_to_1: Stand on a step on one leg.
how_to_2: Slowly lower the other heel toward the floor.

name: Eccentric Heel Drop (Alfredson)
how_to_1: Stand on a step on both feet, rise up.
how_to_2: Shift onto one leg and slowly lower the heel below the step.
how_to_3: Use both feet to rise again.
watch_for: Rushing the lowering. Bouncing. Doing it through sharp pain.

name: Towel Toe Scrunch
how_to_1: Sit with a towel under your foot.
how_to_2: Scrunch the towel toward you with your toes.

name: Short Foot Exercise
how_to_1: Sit or stand with the foot flat.
how_to_2: Draw the ball of the foot toward the heel, lifting the arch without curling toes.
watch_for: Curling toes. Lifting the heel. Rushing.

name: Ankle Alphabet
how_to_1: Sit with your foot off the floor.
how_to_2: Draw the letters of the alphabet with your toes.
watch_for: Moving the leg. Rushing. Small range.

name: Single-Leg Balance
how_to_1: Stand on one leg.
how_to_2: Balance with soft knee.

name: Tibialis Raise
how_to_1: Stand with your back against a wall, heels forward.
how_to_2: Lift your toes.

name: Wrist Flexion/Extension (Light)
how_to_1: Forearm supported, light weight in hand.
how_to_2: Curl the wrist up, then extend down.

name: Tyler Twist (FlexBar)
how_to_1: Hold a FlexBar vertically.
how_to_2: Twist it with the injured wrist while holding with the other hand.
watch_for: Too much resistance. Rushing. Twisting the elbow.

name: Copenhagen Adductor (Short Lever)
how_to_1: Side plank with the top knee on a bench.
how_to_2: Lift hips.

name: Hip Hinge Drill (Dowel)
how_to_1: Hold a dowel along your back (head, upper back, tailbone).
how_to_2: Hinge forward keeping all three contact points.
watch_for: Losing contact. Bending knees too much. Rounding.

name: Kegel / Pelvic Floor Contraction
how_to_1: Sit or lie comfortably.
how_to_2: Contract the pelvic floor muscles as if stopping urine flow.
how_to_3: Hold for a few seconds and relax fully.
watch_for: Holding breath. Squeezing glutes or thighs. Not relaxing between reps.
